					if n >= #s then return s end
					local out = s:sub(1, n)
					for i = n + 1, #s do
						local ch = s:sub(i, i)
						if ch == " " then
							out = out .. " "
						else
							local k = math.random(1, #GL)
							out = out .. GL:sub(k, k)
						end
					end
					return out
				end
				local function iaccent() -- same accent logic as the main intro (disco palette by default)
					local m, c = cfg("IntroColorMode"), nil
					if m == 2 then
						c = Util.ParseHex and Util.ParseHex(cfg("IntroColor"))
					elseif m == 3 then
						c = WHITE
					elseif m == 4 and Util.Color then
						c = Util.Color.Cur
					elseif Util.DiscoColor then
						c = Util.DiscoColor(os.clock() * 0.48)
					end
					return typeof(c) == "Color3" and c or WHITE
				end
				local function mk(class, parent, props)
					local o = Instance.new(class)
					o.Name = Util.RandomString and Util.RandomString(10) or class
					for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
					o.Parent = parent
					return o
				end
				local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

				-- ── stage + world (world takes the zoom punch / shake) ──
				local stage = mk("Frame", sg, {
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = false,
				})
				local world = mk("Frame", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Interactable = false,
				})
				local worldZoom = mk("UIScale", world, {})

				-- ── warp streaks ──
				local stars = {}
				for i = 1, 26 do
					local f = mk("Frame", world, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
						BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Interactable = false,
					})
					stars[i] = {f = f, a = math.random() * math.pi * 2, r = math.random(), v = 0.15 + math.random() * 0.35, hot = i % 4 == 0}
				end

				-- ── 3D triangle ──
				local mark = mk("Frame", world, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 240),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3,
				})
				local ms = mk("UIScale", mark, {Scale = 0.01})
				local okT, tri = pcall(FX.NewTriangle3D, mark, {
					ZIndex = 4, Interactive = false, IsVisible = function() return sg.Parent ~= nil end,
				})
				if okT and tri then
					T = tri
					T.baseSpin = 2.2
					pcall(T.PopIn, T)
					pcall(function() T.yawVel = T.yawVel + 14 end)
				end

				-- ── scanline + glitch tears ──
				local scan = mk("Frame", world, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
				})
				mk("UIGradient", scan, {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6)})})
				local scanLine = mk("Frame", scan, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false,
				})
				local tears = {}
				for i = 1, 3 do
					tears[i] = mk("Frame", world, {
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Visible = false,
						BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Interactable = false,
					})
				end

				-- ── chromatic title (R / B ghosts + main), subtitle, boot lines ──
				local name = (tostring(cfg("IntroTitle")):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
				if name == "" then name = "NOOBY" end
				local subText = "DELTA  //  CUSTOMIZATION ONLINE"
				local bootLines = {
					"> EXECUTOR ....... " .. string.upper(D.Executor ~= "" and D.Executor or "DELTA"),
					"> CUSTOMIZER ..... " .. (D.Api and "LINKED" or "WAITING"),
					"> MOTION ......... " .. (cfg("DeltaMotion") == true and "ON" or "OFF"),
				}
				local bootAt = {2.35, 2.85, 3.35}
				local box = mk("Frame", world, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Interactable = false,
				})
				local function big(z, color)
					return mk("TextLabel", box, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Arcade, TextColor3 = color,
						TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
					})
				end
				local lblR, lblB, lblM = big(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 80)), big(2, Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 255)), big(3, WHITE)
				lblM.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
				local sub = mk("TextLabel", world, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
					TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = 6, Interactable = false,
				})
				local boot = mk("TextLabel", world, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
					TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = 6, Interactable = false,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
				})

				-- ── letterbox bars, vignette, corner HUD, progress bar, skip, flash ──
				local barTop = mk("Frame", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
					BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12, Interactable = false,
				})
				local barBot = mk("Frame", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
					BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12, Interactable = false,
				})
				local vign = {}
				for _, v in ipairs({
					{0, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 110), 90},
					{0, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 110), -90},
					{0, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, 0), 0},
					{1, 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, 0), 180},
				}) do
					local f = mk("Frame", stage, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(v[1], v[2]), Position = v[3], Size = v[4], BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10, Interactable = false,
					})
					mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = v[5], Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
					vign[#vign + 1] = f
				end
				local hud = {}
				for _, c in ipairs({{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do
					local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
					local host = mk("Frame", stage, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 14, Interactable = false,
					})
					local h = mk("Frame", host, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
						BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 14,
					})
					local v = mk("Frame", host, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
						BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 14,
					})
					hud[#hud + 1] = {host = host, h = h, v = v, ax = ax, ay = ay}
				end
				local function hudText(ax, ay, pos, w)
					return mk("TextLabel", stage, {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1,
						ZIndex = 15, Text = "", Interactable = false,
						TextXAlignment = ax == 0 and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
					})
				end
				local tcL = hudText(0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 12), 420)
				local nowL = hudText(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 46, 1, -52), 420)
				local modL = hudText(1, 1, UDim2.new(1, -46, 1, -34), 420)
				local ctrL = hudText(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 46, 1, -34), 420)
				nowL.Text = "LOADING: DELTA CUSTOMIZER"
				local progBg = mk("Frame", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 15, Interactable = false,
				})
				local progFill = mk("Frame", progBg, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 16, Interactable = false})
				local progDot = mk("Frame", progFill, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 17, Interactable = false,
				})
				mk("UICorner", progDot, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
				local skipBtn = mk("TextButton", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 30),
					BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
					TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
				})
				local skipStroke = mk("UIStroke", skipBtn, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 1})
				local skipScale = mk("UIScale", skipBtn, {})
				local flash = mk("Frame", stage, {
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false,
				})

				-- ── state + effects ──
				local pulse, flashK, punch, glitch, shake, lastBeat = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1
				local lsx, lsy, U, CY = 0, 0, 1, 0
				local titleDone, subDone, bootDone, lastN, ev = false, false, false, 0, 1
				local t0
				local function layout(sx, sy)
					U = math.clamp(sy / 720, 0.55, 1.2)
					CY = sy * 0.36
					local th = 56 * U
					local ty0 = CY + 158 * U
					box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, ty0)
					box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(sx * 0.86, 820), th)
					local subY = ty0 + th * 0.5 + 16
					sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY)
					sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(sx * 0.9, 640), 20)
					boot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY + 20)
					boot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 54)
				end
				local function impact(k, c)
					punch = math.max(punch, 0.03 + 0.03 * k)
					shake = math.max(shake, 5 + 6 * k)
					flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.12 + 0.2 * k)
					glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.4 + 0.3 * k)
					pulse = 1
					if T then T.pulse = 1 end
					pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 300 + 200 * k, 0.6, 2 + k)
					pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, math.floor(6 + 5 * k), 130 + 80 * k, 0.6)
				end
				local function bootTick() pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.5) end
				local EV = {
					{0.04, function()
						flashK = 0.5
						pcall(FX.Play, "open", 1.1)
						if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12 * inten, 0.12, 1.8) end
					end},
					{0.35, function()
						local c = iaccent()
						pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 420, 0.7, 3)
						pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, 10, 200, 0.7)
						pcall(FX.Play, "release", 1)
					end},
					{1.05, function() glitch = 0.8 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end},
					{1.45, function() glitch = 0.6 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.9) end},
					{1.95, function()
						impact(1, iaccent())
						pcall(function() T.yawVel = T.yawVel + 10 end)
						pcall(FX.Play, "hit", 1)
					end},
					{bootAt[1], bootTick}, {bootAt[2], bootTick}, {bootAt[3], bootTick},
					{3.95, function() impact(0.6, iaccent()) pcall(FX.Play, "reform", 1) end},
					{TH, function()
						local s = sg.AbsoluteSize
						tx, ty, tsz = s.X * 0.5, math.min(46, s.Y * 0.1), 40
						local b = D.Button
						if b and b.Parent then
							local p, bs = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
							tx, ty, tsz = p.X + bs.X / 2, p.Y + bs.Y / 2, math.max(bs.X, bs.Y)
						end
						pcall(FX.Play, "release", 0.9)
						if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.1, 0.6) end
					end},
				}

				local function step(t, dt, sx, sy)
					while ev <= #EV and t >= EV[ev][1] do
						if t - EV[ev][1] < 0.4 then pcall(EV[ev][2]) end -- a skip never replays the missed effects
						ev = ev + 1
					end
					if sx ~= lsx or sy ~= lsy then
						lsx, lsy = sx, sy
						layout(sx, sy)
					end
					local u, col = U, iaccent()
					local outK = clamp01((t - TH) / (DUR - TH))
					local inK = clamp01(t / 0.35)
					local vis = inK * (1 - eIn(outK))
					local fo = 1 - clamp01(outK * 3)
					pulse = pulse * math.exp(-7 * dt)
					punch = punch * math.exp(-8 * dt)
					shake = shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
					flashK = math.max(0, flashK - dt * 3.2)
					glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 2.4)
					local beat = math.floor(t / PERIOD)
					if beat ~= lastBeat then
						lastBeat = beat
						pulse = 1
						if T then T.pulse = math.max(T.pulse or 0, 0.55) end
					end

					-- stage fade + vignette
					stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.94 * vis
					if inK < 1 or outK > 0 then
						for i = 1, #vign do vign[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vis end
					end

					-- warp streaks: rush in the first 1.5 s, then calm down
					local R = math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) * 0.5
					local sp = (0.35 + 3.2 * math.exp(-((t - 0.9) / 0.55) ^ 2)) * (1 - outK * 0.8)
					local ex = 0.8 * vis
					for i = 1, #stars do
						local s = stars[i]
						s.r = s.r + s.v * sp * dt * 0.6
						if s.r > 1 then
							s.r = math.random() * 0.08
							s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
						end
						local rr = s.r * s.r
						local f = s.f
						f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5 + math.cos(s.a) * rr * R, sy * 0.5 + math.sin(s.a) * rr * R)
						f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + sp * rr * 46, 2)
						f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, rr * 2.5) * ex
						if s.hot then f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
					end

					-- triangle: pops in, floats, then flies into the Delta icon
					local k = eInOut(outK)
					mark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sx * 0.5, tx, k), lerp(CY + math.sin(t * 2.2) * 4 * u * (1 - outK), ty, k))
					ms.Scale = math.max(0.01, eBack(clamp01((t - 0.12) / 0.8)) * lerp(u, tsz / 240 * 1.1, k) * (1 + pulse * 0.035 * (1 - outK)))

					-- title: scramble-resolve + misregistered R / B ghosts that lock together
					local tIn = clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.75)
					local lockK = eOut(clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.9))
					if not titleDone and t >= 1.0 then
						local n = math.floor(#name * tIn)
						if n ~= lastN then
							lastN = n
							if n > 0 and n % 2 == 0 then pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end
						end
						local s = scr(name, tIn)
						lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
						titleDone = tIn >= 1
					end
					local c = (1 - lockK) * 22 * u + pulse * 3
					lblR.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -c, 0.5, 0)
					lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, c, 0.5, 0)
					local ta = clamp01((t - 1.0) / 0.12) * fo
					lblM.TextTransparency = 1 - ta
					lblR.TextTransparency = 1 - ta * (0.12 + 0.43 * (1 - lockK))
					lblB.TextTransparency = lblR.TextTransparency

					-- subtitle + boot lines
					if not subDone and t >= 2.0 then
						sub.Text = scr(subText, (t - 2.05) / 0.6)
						subDone = t >= 2.65
					end
					local blink = (t > 3.95 and t < TH) and (math.floor(t * 4) % 2 == 0 and 1 or 0.55) or 1
					sub.TextColor3 = col
					sub.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - 2.05) / 0.2) * fo * blink
					if not bootDone and t >= bootAt[1] then
						local parts = {}
						for i = 1, #bootLines do
							local f = clamp01((t - bootAt[i]) / 0.3)
							if f > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = scr(bootLines[i], f) end
						end
						boot.Text = table.concat(parts, "\n")
						bootDone = t >= bootAt[#bootAt] + 0.3
					end
					boot.TextColor3 = col
					boot.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - bootAt[1]) / 0.15) * fo * 0.9

					-- scanline sweep + glitch tears
					if t >= 1.0 and t < 1.95 then
						scan.Visible = true
						scan.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * ((t - 1.0) / 0.95) - 60)
						scan.BackgroundColor3, scanLine.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
					elseif scan.Visible then
						scan.Visible = false
					end
					for i = 1, #tears do
						local f = tears[i]
						if glitch > 0.05 and math.random() < glitch * 0.8 then
							f.Visible = true
							f.Position = UDim2.new(0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 40 * glitch, 0, math.random() * sy)
							f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2, 10))
							f.BackgroundColor3 = math.random() < 0.5 and col or WHITE
							f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.45
						elseif f.Visible then
							f.Visible = false
						end
					end

					-- letterbox, corner HUD, progress bar, skip button
					local bh = sy * 0.085 * eOut(clamp01(t / 0.6)) * (1 - eIn(outK))
					barTop.Size, barBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh)
					local hin = eOut(clamp01((t - 0.1) / 0.7))
					local inset = (22 + (1 - hin) * 80) * u
					for i = 1, #hud do
						local b = hud[i]
						b.host.Position = UDim2.new(b.ax, b.ax == 0 and inset or -inset, b.ay, b.ay == 0 and inset or -inset)
						local tr = 1 - hin * (1 - outK)
						if math.random() < 0.04 then tr = math.min(1, tr + 0.5) end
						b.h.BackgroundTransparency, b.v.BackgroundTransparency = tr, tr
						b.h.BackgroundColor3, b.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
					end
					tcL.Text = string.format("DELTA // BOOT  %04.2f / %04.2f", math.min(t, DUR), DUR)
					modL.Text = D.Api and "CUSTOMIZER LINKED" or "CUSTOMIZER WAITING"
					ctrL.Text = string.format("SYS.INIT  %03d%%", math.floor(clamp01(t / TH) * 100))
					local hudA = math.min(1, 1 - hin * 0.85 * fo + (1 - fo))
					for _, l in ipairs({tcL, nowL, modL, ctrL}) do
						l.TextColor3 = col
						l.TextTransparency = hudA
					end
					progFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / TH), 0, 1, 0)
					progFill.BackgroundColor3, progDot.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
					local pf = clamp01(outK * 1.5)
					progFill.BackgroundTransparency = pf
					progDot.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(pf, math.clamp(0.15 - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1))
					progDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6 + pulse * 5, 6 + pulse * 5)
					progBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.1 * vis
					local sv = fo * vis
					skipBtn.TextColor3, skipStroke.Color = col, col
					skipBtn.TextTransparency = 1 - sv
					skipBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.7 * sv
					skipStroke.Transparency = math.min(1, 0.2 + 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3) + (1 - sv))

					-- impact flash + camera punch / shake
					local endF = clamp01((t - (DUR - 0.3)) / 0.3) * 0.25
					flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35)
					flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.max(math.min(0.8, flashK * math.clamp(inten, 0, 1.2)), endF * math.clamp(inten, 0.4, 1))
					worldZoom.Scale = 1 + punch * inten
					if shake > 0.1 then
						world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten)
					elseif shake ~= 0 then
						shake = 0
						world.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
					end
				end

				-- ── input: Space / Enter / Esc or the SKIP button jump to the hand-off ──
				local function doSkip()
					if t0 and os.clock() - t0 < TH then t0 = os.clock() - TH end
				end
				conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if not t0 or os.clock() - t0 < 0.4 then return end
					if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
						local kc = input.KeyCode
						if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Space or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Return or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then doSkip() end
					end
				end)
				conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.Activated:Connect(doSkip)
				conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.2, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1.12}) end)
				conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end)

				-- ── run ──
				t0 = os.clock()
				local last = t0
				while sg.Parent do
					local now = os.clock()
					local t = now - t0
					if t >= DUR then break end
					local dt = math.min(0.1, now - last)
					last = now
					local sz = sg.AbsoluteSize
					if sz.X >= 2 and sz.Y >= 2 then step(t, dt, sz.X, sz.Y) end
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				-- hand-off done: the real Delta logo takes over with a bloom + ring
				D.IntroHold = false
				pcall(D.SyncLogo)
				if D.Logo then pcall(D.Logo.Bloom, D.Logo) end
				if D.LogoHost then pcall(FX.Ring, D.LogoHost, iaccent(), math.max(tsz * 1.8, 90), 0.7, 2) end
				if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 5, 0.06, 0.5) end
			end)

			for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
			D.IntroHold = false
			pcall(D.SyncLogo)
			if T then pcall(function() T:Destroy() end) end
			pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
			if not ok then error(err, 0) end
		end

		-- connects to Nooby's own intro: waits until FX.IntroActive ends, then plays
		function D.PlayIntro(force)
			if D.IntroBusy or not (D.Detected and D.Active) then return end
			if not force and (D.IntroPlayed or cfg("DeltaIntro") ~= true or FX.IsLowEnd()) then return end
			D.IntroBusy, D.IntroPlayed = true, true
			task.spawn(function()
				local t0 = os.clock()
				while FX.IntroActive and not force and os.clock() - t0 < 120 do task.wait(0.1) end
				local ok, err = pcall(D.RunIntro)
				if not ok then
					D.IntroHold = false
					pcall(D.SyncLogo)
					warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta intro error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
				end
				D.IntroBusy = false
			end)
		end

		function D.Apply() -- called by the Customization page whenever a Delta option changes
			if D.Detected and D.Active then pcall(D.ApplyLogo) end
		end

		function D.Start()
			if D.Started then return end
			D.Started = true
			if not D.Detected then
				D.Status = "skipped (executor: " .. (D.Executor ~= "" and D.Executor or "unknown") .. ")"
				return
			end
			if cfg("DeltaEnabled") == false then
				D.Status = "turned off on the Customization page (applies on the next start)"
				return
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				if not D.Boot() then error(D.Status, 0) end
				local btn, api = D.WaitIcon(20)
				if not btn then error("Delta icon not found", 0) end
				D.Button, D.Api = btn, api
				D.Main = btn:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
				D.Active = true
				D.Status = "active"
				D.ApplyLogo()
				D.BindMotion()
				D.PlayIntro(false)
			end)
			if not ok then
				D.Active = false
				D.Status = tostring(err)
				warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta bridge off (script unaffected): " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end

		pcall(D.Detect)
		FX.OnLowEnd(function() pcall(D.Apply) end)
		return D
	end)()

	return FX
end)()

Util.LoopedHSV = function(h, s, v)
	h %= 1
	s = math.clamp(s, 0, 1)
	v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
end
-- [v48] DISCO PALETTE (the theme song's mood: golden-hour disco): hot pink > tangerine > gold > aqua > violet, looping.
Util.DiscoPalette = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 160), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 48), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90),
	Color3.fromRGB(70, 222, 255), Color3.fromRGB(160, 110, 255),
}
Util.DiscoColor = function(step)
	local p = Util.DiscoPalette
	local n = #p
	step = step % n
	local i = math.floor(step)
	return p[i + 1]:Lerp(p[(i + 1) % n + 1], step - i)
end
Util.Instance = function(cl, p)
	local i = Instance.new(cl)
	i.Name = Util.RandomString()
	i.Parent = p
	return i
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2C = function(a, b)
	a.Destroying:Once(function()
		b:Disconnect()
	end)
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2I = function(a, b)
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(b, a.Destroying:Once(function()
		task.defer(b.Destroy, b)
	end))
end
Util.ClearAllChildrenGui = function(a)
	for _,v in a:GetChildren() do
		if v:IsA("GuiObject") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
end
Util.GetTransparency = function(part)
	return 1 - (1 - part.Transparency) * (1 - part.LocalTransparencyModifier)
end
Util.ScaleCFrame = function(cf, scale)
	return cf + cf.Position * (scale - 1)
end
Util.IsGuiVisible = function(guiObject)
	if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
	while guiObject do
		if not guiObject.Visible then
			return false
		end
		guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
	end
	return true
end
Util.IsGuiInteractable = function(guiObject)
	if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
	while guiObject do
		if not guiObject.Visible or not guiObject.Interactable then
			return false
		end
		guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
	end
	return true
end
Util.WillGuiSinkInput = function(guiObject)
	return Util.IsGuiInteractable(guiObject) and (guiObject.Active or guiObject:IsA("GuiButton"))
end
Util.UDim2ToVector2Scale = function(x)
	return Vector2.new(x.X.Scale, x.Y.Scale)
end
Util.UDim2ToVector2Offset = function(x)
	return Vector2.new(x.X.Offset, x.Y.Offset)
end
Util.Vector2ToUDim2Scale = function(x)
	return UDim2.fromScale(x.X, x.Y)
end
Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset = function(x)
	return UDim2.fromOffset(x.X, x.Y)
end
Util.ForceTextSize = function(inst)
	if inst:IsA("TextLabel") then
		local original = inst.TextSize
		local conn conn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
			local size = GuiService.PreferredTextSize.Name
			if size == "Medium" then
				inst.TextSize = original
			elseif size == "Large" then
				inst.TextSize = original - 4
			elseif size == "Larger" then
				inst.TextSize = original - 9
			elseif size == "Largest" then
				inst.TextSize = original - 14
			end
		end)
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(inst, conn)
	end
end
Util.QueryPlayerSelector = function(query, excludespeaker)
	if #query == 0 then return end
	query = query:lower()
	local t = {}
	for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player ~= Player or not excludespeaker then
			local a = player.DisplayName:lower():find(query)
			local b = player.Name:lower():find(query)
			if a then table.insert(t, {player, 1, a}) end
			if b then table.insert(t, {player, 0, b}) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(t, function(a, b)
		if a[2] == b[2] then
			return a[3] < b[3]
		end
		return a[2] < b[2]
	end)
	if t[1] then
		return t[1][1]
	end
	return nil
end

		local assetsdownload = 0
		local downloadfile = function(meta)
			local fil = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. meta.name
			if not redownloadeverything then
				local s, d = pcall(isfile, fil)
				if s and d then
					downloaded += 1
					return
				end
			end
			if not pcall(function()
				writefile(fil, game:HttpGet(meta.download_url))
			end) then skipped += 1 end
			downloaded += 1
		end
		local Downloading = Util.Instance("TextLabel", UIMainFrame)
		Downloading.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		Downloading.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		Downloading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		Downloading.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		Downloading.ClipsDescendants = true
		Downloading.BorderSizePixel = 0
		Downloading.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		Downloading.TextSize = 20
		Downloading.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		Downloading.Text = "Fetching Assets metadata..."
		Util.ForceTextSize(Downloading)
		TweenService:Create(Downloading, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
		}):Play()
		task.wait(0.5)
		local s, assetsof = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, "https://api.github.com/repos/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/contents/uiassets/")
		if s and assetsof then
			s, assetsof = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, assetsof)
			if s and assetsof then
				for i,file in assetsof do
					if not table.find(AllFileNames, file.name) then
						continue
					end
					assetsdownload += 1
					task.spawn(downloadfile, file)
				end
				repeat
					Downloading.Text = `Downloading assets {downloaded}/{assetsdownload}... ({skipped} skipped)`
					Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
					task.wait()
				until downloaded == assetsdownload
				Downloading.Text = "Download complete! \\(^o^)/"
				Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
				theresassetsmissing = false
			end
		end
		SaveData.CDNVersion = CDNVersion
		if theresassetsmissing then
			Downloading.Text = "Asset downloading failed. 3:"
			Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
		end
		TweenService:Create(Downloading, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		}):Play()
		task.wait(0.5)
		Downloading:Destroy()
	end
end

Util.GetCDNAsset = function(filename)
	local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. filename
	local s, id = pcall(isfile, path)
	if s and id then
		s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
		if s then return id end
	end
	return ""
end

Util.MakeTriforce = function(tris, color, dur)
	dur = dur or 8
	local function CreateTriangle(parent, radius, width, rotation, color)
		local height = (math.sqrt(3) / 2) * width
		local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
		pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		pivot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
		pivot.Rotation = rotation
		local tri = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", pivot)
		tri.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		tri.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 - radius, 0)
		tri.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, height, 0)
		tri.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tri.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tri.Image = Util.GetCDNAsset("letriangul.graphic.png")
		local grey = math.max(color.R, color.G, color.B) * 0.5
		tri.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(grey, grey, grey)
		TweenService:Create(tri, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			ImageColor3 = color
		}):Play()
	end
	local radius = 0.1
	local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
	pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	local width = 2 * radius * math.sin(math.pi / tris) * 2
	for i=1, tris do
		CreateTriangle(pivot, radius, width, (i / tris) * 360, color)
	end
	return pivot
end
Util.MakeText = function(text)
	text = text:upper()
	local ls = "BCDEIKOPQRSTUVYZ\\_`N^MJ"
	local lt = ""
	-- !, ", #, $, %, &, ', (, ), *, +, ,, -, ., /
	lt ..= "DDDDD@DFF@@@@@FSFSFSF@@@@@@@@@@@@@@EMMUKKTDD@@@@@DEEEEEDDBBBBBD@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@DE@@@G@@@@@@@@@DABBDEEI"
	-- numbers
	lt ..= "GJJJJJGDVDDDDSGJAGIISRAAGAARWJJSAAASIIRAARGIIRJJGSAABBDDGJJGJJGGJJHAAG"
	-- :, ;, <, =, >, ?, @
	lt ..= "@DD@DD@@DD@DE@@BDEDB@@@G@G@@@EDBDE@GJABD@D@@@@@@@"
	-- capital letters
	lt ..= "DFJSJJJRJJRJJRGJIIIJGRJJJJJRSIIRIISSIIRIIIHIILJJHJJJSJJJGDDDDDGAAAAAJHJKMOMKJIIIIIISJQNJJJJJJPNLJJGJJJJJGRJJRIIIGJJJNGCRJJRMKJGJIGAJGSDDDDDDJJJJJJGJJJJJFDJJJNQJJJJFDFJJJJFDDDDSABDEIS"
	local pixs = {}
	local totalsize = 0
	for i=0, 6 do
		local row = {}
		for j=1, text:len() do
			local c = text:byte(j, j)
			local w = 0
			if c ~= 0x20 then
				local k = (c - 33) * 7 + i
				w = lt:byte(k + 1, k + 1)
				if w ~= nil and w > 64 then
					w = ls:byte(w - 64, w - 64) - 65
				else
					w = 0
				end
			end
			for k=0, 5 do
				local h = (j - 1) * 6 + (4 - k)
				totalsize = math.max(totalsize, h + 1)
				local p = (w // math.pow(2, k)) % 2
				if p > 0 then
					row[h] = true
				end
			end
		end
		pixs[i] = row
	end
	local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
	pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	pivot.Size = UDim2.new(0, totalsize, 0, 7)
	pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	for i=0, 6 do
		local row = pixs[i]
		local olde = nil
		local olds = 0
		for j=0, totalsize - 1 do
			local pix = row[j]
			if pix == true then
				if olde ~= nil then
					olds += 1
					olde.Size = UDim2.new(olds / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
				else
					olde = Util.Instance("Frame", pivot)
					olde.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
					olde.Position = UDim2.new(j / totalsize, 0, i / 7, 0)
					olde.Size = UDim2.new(1 / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
					olde.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					olde.BorderSizePixel = 0
					olds = 1
				end
			else
				olde = nil
				olds = 0
			end
		end
	end
	return pivot
end
Util.SetTextColor = function(text, color, tran)
	for _,v in text:GetChildren() do
		v.BackgroundColor3 = color
		v.BackgroundTransparency = tran
	end
end

			"",
			"",
			"",
		}
	end
	-- [v49b] integrity samples of the bundled MP3 (1-based offset, 16 bytes as hex): every decoded copy is verified against these
	TS.Samples = {
		{1000, "d42551e1b7414b4ba6baf0835b935e67"},
		{1000000, "8365c04271d307e66c425a28ab859286"},
		{2000000, "459d03839255d5b56f38c7e1eeae86d7"},
		{3000000, "8d9c69aeaa7a6710a80ec2e190442ce5"},
	}
	TS.Progress = 0 -- 0..1 while the bundled data is being decoded (shown on the intro's loading line)
	TS.Why = nil -- reason of the last failure (also shown as an in-UI notification)
	-- base64 lookup tables indexed by the character's byte; the four partial values add up to one little-endian 24-bit word
	local B64, La, Lb, Lc, Ld = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	do
		local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
		for i = 1, 64 do
			local v, ch = i - 1, alphabet:byte(i)
			B64[ch] = v
			La[ch] = v * 4
			Lb[ch] = v // 16 + (v % 16) * 4096
			Lc[ch] = (v // 4) * 256 + (v % 4) * 4194304
			Ld[ch] = v * 65536
		end
		B64[61], La[61], Lb[61], Lc[61], Ld[61] = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 -- '='
	end
	local function hex(s)
		return (s:gsub(".", function(ch) return string.format("%02x", ch:byte()) end))
	end
	local function verify(body) -- size + MP3 header + 4 sampled slices: rejects any damaged / truncated / mis-decoded copy
		if type(body) ~= "string" or #body ~= TS.Bytes or body:sub(1, 3) ~= "ID3" then return false end
		for _, sm in ipairs(TS.Samples) do
			if hex(body:sub(sm[1], sm[1] + 15)) ~= sm[2] then return false end
		end
		return true
	end
	-- 1) the executor's own base64 decoder (instant) - tried through whichever name this executor uses
	local function decodeNative(chunks)
		local joined = table.concat(chunks)
		local getters = {
			function() return crypt.base64decode end,
			function() return crypt.base64_decode end,
			function() return crypt.base64.decode end,
			function() return syn.crypt.base64.decode end,
			function() return base64_decode end,
			function() return base64decode end,
			function() return base64.decode end,
		}
		for _, get in ipairs(getters) do
			local okG, fn = pcall(get)
			if okG and type(fn) == "function" then
				local okD, res = pcall(fn, joined)
				if okD and verify(res) then return res end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	-- 2) pure Luau, time-sliced (~20 ms of work, then a yield) so the game never hitches while it decodes
	local function decodeLua(chunks)
		local sbyte, schar, concat = string.byte, string.char, table.concat
		local nchars = 0
		for _, s in ipairs(chunks) do nchars = nchars + #s end
		local lastChunk = chunks[#chunks]
		local pad = (lastChunk:sub(-2) == "==") and 2 or ((lastChunk:sub(-1) == "=") and 1 or 0)
		local size = nchars // 4 * 3 - pad
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local total = #chunks
		if type(buffer) == "table" and buffer.create and buffer.writeu32 and buffer.readstring then
			local buf = buffer.create(size + 8)
			local writeu32 = buffer.writeu32
			local pos = 0
			for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
				for i = 1, #s, 4 do
					local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
					writeu32(buf, pos, La[a] + Lb[b] + Lc[c] + Ld[d])
					pos = pos + 3
				end
				TS.Progress = ci / total
				if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
					task.wait()
					t0 = os.clock()
				end
			end
			return buffer.readstring(buf, 0, size)
		end
		local out = {}
		for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
			local parts, pn = {}, 0
			for i = 1, #s, 4 do
				local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
				local v = (B64[a] or 0) * 262144 + (B64[b] or 0) * 4096 + (B64[c] or 0) * 64 + (B64[d] or 0)
				pn = pn + 1
				parts[pn] = schar(v // 65536, (v // 256) % 256, v % 256)
			end
			out[ci] = concat(parts)
			TS.Progress = ci / total
			if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
				task.wait()
				t0 = os.clock()
			end
		end
		local body = concat(out)
		if pad > 0 then body = body:sub(1, #body - pad) end
		return body
	end
	-- the verified MP3 bytes from the bundled data, or nil (+ TS.Why)
	local function unpack64(chunks)
		local okN, res = pcall(decodeNative, chunks)
		if okN and res then return res end
		local okL, body = pcall(decodeLua, chunks)
		if okL and verify(body) then return body end
		TS.Why = okL and "bundled data failed verification (script text damaged?)" or ("decode error: " .. tostring(body))
		return nil
	end
	TS.Path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. TS.File
	TS.Period = 60 / TS.Bpm
	local busy, failed = false, false
	local function url()
		local u = _G.UhhhhhhThemeSongUrl
		if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then u = THEME_SONG_URL end
		u = tostring(u):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		if u:match("^https?://%S+$") then return u end
		return nil
	end
	local verified = false
	function TS.Cached() -- [v49b] the file exists AND is not a stub / half-written leftover (checked once per session)
		if verified then return true end
		local ok, v = pcall(isfile, TS.Path)
		if not (ok and v == true) then return false end
		if type(readfile) == "function" then
			local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
			if okR and type(data) == "string" and #data < TS.MinBytes then
				pcall(function() if type(delfile) == "function" then delfile(TS.Path) end end) -- broken leftover: write it again
				return false
			end
		end
		verified = true
		return true
	end
	local function fetch(u)
		local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, u)
		if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then return body end
		if type(request) == "function" then
			local ok2, res = pcall(request, {Url = u, Method = "GET"})
			if ok2 and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or res.Success == true) and type(res.Body) == "string" then
				return res.Body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function looksLikeMp3(b) -- rejects HTML error / share pages that are not a direct link
		if #b < TS.MinBytes then return false end
		if b:sub(1, 3) == "ID3" then return true end
		local b1, b2 = b:byte(1, 2)
		return b1 == 0xFF and b2 ~= nil and b2 >= 0xE0
	end
	-- true when the cached file is usable. Waits up to `wait` seconds for the (single) download; never starts a second one.
	function TS.Ensure(wait)
		if TS.Cached() then return true end
		local u = url()
		local chunks = THEME_SONG_DATA()
		local bundled = type(chunks) == "table" and #chunks > 0
		if failed or not (u or bundled) then return false end
		if not busy then
			busy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local function sizeOk() -- the file on disk must have the full size (some executors silently cut big writes)
					if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return true end
					local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
					return okR and type(data) == "string" and #data == TS.Bytes
				end
				local function save(body)
					pcall(function()
						if not isfolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") then makefolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") end
					end)
					local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, TS.Path, body)
					if okW and sizeOk() then return true end
					if type(appendfile) == "function" then -- fallback: write it in pieces
						local okP = pcall(function()
							for i = 1, #body, 262144 do
								local piece = body:sub(i, i + 262143)
								if i == 1 then writefile(TS.Path, piece) else appendfile(TS.Path, piece) end
							end
						end)
						if okP and sizeOk() then return true end
					end
					TS.Why = "could not write " .. TS.Path .. (okW and " (file came out the wrong size)" or (": " .. tostring(errW)))
					return false
				end
				local ok = pcall(function()
					if bundled then -- [v49] 1) the MP3 that ships inside this script (verified: size, header, sampled bytes)
						local body = unpack64(chunks)
						if body and save(body) then return end
					end
					if u then -- 2) optional direct-URL fallback
						for attempt = 1, 2 do
							local body = fetch(u)
							if body and looksLikeMp3(body) and save(body) then return end
							if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.5) end
						end
					end
				end)
				if not (ok and TS.Cached()) then
					failed = true -- one attempt per session: no repeated writes / downloads
					local why = TS.Why or "no bundled data and no valid THEME_SONG_URL"
					warn("[Uhhhhhh] theme song unavailable - " .. why .. ". Using the old default track.")
					pcall(function() Util.UINotify("Theme song unavailable: " .. why) end)
				end
				busy = false
			end)
		end
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while busy and os.clock() - t0 < (wait or 0) do task.wait(0.1) end
		return TS.Cached()
	end
	function TS.IsPlaying(snd) -- PlayMusic names the Sound after the track
		local ok, r = pcall(function() return snd.Name == TS.Title and snd.IsPlaying end)
		return ok and r == true
	end
	function TS.Beat(pos) -- song position (s) -> beat index, 0..1 phase inside the beat
		local n = (pos - TS.Offset) / TS.Period
		local i = math.floor(n)
		return i, n - i
	end
	return TS
end)()
task.spawn(Util.ThemeSong.Ensure, 0) -- start the one-time download right away (no-op when cached or no URL)

pcall(function()
	local future = table.clone(MusicPlayer.Database)
	if isfile("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik/nobuiltin") then
		table.clear(future)
	end
	for _,file in listfiles("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik") do
		if isfile(file) and file:sub(-4, -1) == ".mp3" then

	end

-- [v48] the theme song is always entry 1 (also when a custom Muzik folder replaced the built-in list)
table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {Util.ThemeSong.Path, Util.ThemeSong.Title, Theme = true})
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
MusicPlayer.UserPicked = false -- [v48] set by the manual song pickers: the default theme never overrides a manual choice
MusicPlayer.Last = 1
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic = function(i)
	if MusicPlayer.Switching then return end
	MusicPlayer.Switching = true
	local last = MusicPlayer.LastMusic
	if not i then
		i = last
		while i == last or (MusicPlayer.Database[i].Theme and not Util.ThemeSong.Cached()) do -- random never picks a missing theme
			i = math.random(1, #MusicPlayer.Database)
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	MusicPlayer.LastMusic = i
	local hi = MusicPlayer.Database[i]
	local soundid, soundname = hi[1], hi[2]
	if hi.Theme then pcall(Util.ThemeSong.Ensure, 40) end -- [v48] picked before the one-time download finished: wait for it
	local s, id = pcall(isfile, soundid)
	if s and id then
		s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, soundid)
		if s then
			soundid = id
		else
			soundid = ""
		end
	else
		soundid = ""
	end
	if #soundid == 0 then
		MusicPlayer.Switching = false
		return MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
	end
	UISound.Music.SoundId = soundid
	UISound.Music.Name = soundname
	UISound.Music:Stop()
	task.wait()
	UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
	task.wait()
	UISound.Music:Play()
	task.wait()
	MusicPlayer.Switching = false
end
MusicPlayer.PlayDefault = function() -- [v48] startup music: the theme song when available, otherwise the old random pick
	if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end
	local ok = Util.ThemeSong.Ensure(40)
	if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end -- a song was picked by hand while the download was running
	MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(ok and 1 or nil)
end
UISound.Music.Ended:Connect(function()
	MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
end)

-- ═════ DYNAMIC COLOUR SYSTEM (v24) ═════
-- One live palette (Accent / Secondary / Tertiary / Bg / Text) that every UI element, the minigame HUDs and the Arcade follow.
-- Modes: 1 Theme, 2 Picked, 3 Rainbow, 4 Harmony cycle, 5 Aurora, 6 Music reactive, 7 Day/Night.  No hex typing needed: use the colour picker.
Util.Color = (function()
	local C = {}
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	C.Modes = {"Theme (follow UI theme)", "Picked color", "Rainbow", "Harmony cycle", "Aurora", "Music reactive", "Day / Night"}
	C.Harmonies = {"Analogous", "Complementary", "Triadic", "Split complementary", "Monochrome"}
	C.Cur = WHITE
	C.ThemeCol = WHITE
	local function cfg() return (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {} end
	local function hsv(c) return c:ToHSV() end
	local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
	local function hueLerp(a, b, k)
		local d = ((b - a + 0.5) % 1) - 0.5
		return (a + d * k) % 1
	end
	function C.Init()
		local st = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
		if st and st.AccentMode == nil and type(st.UIAccent) == "string" and st.UIAccent ~= "" then
			Util.FX.SetCfg("AccentMode", 2) -- v23 users who had picked an accent keep it
		end
	end
	function C.Base()
		local c = cfg()
		return Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
	end
	function C.HarmonyHues(h)
		local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
		if m == 2 then return {h, (h + 0.5) % 1}
		elseif m == 3 then return {h, (h + 1 / 3) % 1, (h + 2 / 3) % 1}
		elseif m == 4 then return {h, (h + 0.42) % 1, (h + 0.58) % 1}
		elseif m == 5 then return {h}
		end
		return {h, (h + 0.08) % 1, (h - 0.08) % 1}
	end
	local function music()
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			local s = Util.FX and Util.FX.UISound and Util.FX.UISound.Music
			if s and s.IsPlaying ~= false then return s.PlaybackLoudness end
			return 0
		end)
		return ok and v or 0
	end
	-- t = time, theme = the colour the selected UI theme would use. Returns the accent colour for this frame.
	function C.Resolve(t, theme)
		local c = cfg()
		C.ThemeCol = theme or C.ThemeCol
		local mode = c.AccentMode or 1
		local sp = c.ColorSpeed or 1
		local out = C.ThemeCol
		local base = C.Base()
		local bh, bs, bv = base:ToHSV()
		if mode == 2 then
			out = Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
		elseif mode == 3 then
			out = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.1 * sp) % 1, 0.8, 1)
		elseif mode == 4 then
			local hues = C.HarmonyHues(bh)
			local pos = (t * 0.12 * sp) % #hues
			local i = math.floor(pos)
			local k = pos - i
			k = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
			local h = hueLerp(hues[i + 1], hues[(i + 1) % #hues + 1], k)
			out = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(bs, 0.55), math.max(bv, 0.85))
		elseif mode == 5 then
			local h = bh + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.5 * sp) + 0.07 * math.sin(t * 0.31 * sp + 1.7)
			out = Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.9 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 0.8 * sp))
		elseif mode == 6 then
			local l = clamp(music() / 700, 0, 1)
			C._ml = (C._ml or 0) + (l - (C._ml or 0)) * 0.25
			out = Color3.fromHSV((bh + C._ml * 0.28) % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.7 + 0.3 * C._ml)
		elseif mode == 7 then
			local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) + tonumber(os.date("%M")) / 60
			local stops = {{0, 0.64, 0.7}, {5, 0.62, 0.8}, {7, 0.06, 1}, {12, 0.53, 1}, {17, 0.08, 1}, {19.5, 0.92, 0.9}, {22, 0.7, 0.75}, {24, 0.64, 0.7}}
			local a, b = stops[1], stops[2]
			for i = 1, #stops - 1 do if hr >= stops[i][1] and hr <= stops[i + 1][1] then a, b = stops[i], stops[i + 1] end end
			local k = (hr - a[1]) / math.max(0.001, b[1] - a[1])
			out = Color3.fromHSV(hueLerp(a[2], b[2], k), 0.75, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k)
		end
		if (c.ColorSat or 1) == 1 and (c.ColorBright or 1) == 1 then C.Cur = out return out end
		local h, s, v = out:ToHSV()
		out = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * (c.ColorSat or 1), 0, 1), clamp(v * (c.ColorBright or 1), 0, 1))
		C.Cur = out
		return out
	end
	function C.Palette(t)
		local a = C.Cur
		local h, s, v = a:ToHSV()
		local hues = C.HarmonyHues(h)
		local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
		local sec, ter
		if m == 5 then
			sec = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, math.max(0.35, v * 0.7))
			ter = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.4, 1)
		else
			sec = Color3.fromHSV(hues[2] or h, s, v)
			ter = Color3.fromHSV(hues[3] or ((h + 0.25) % 1), s * 0.85, v)
		end
		return {Accent = a, Secondary = sec, Tertiary = ter, Bg = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * 0.55, 0, 0.6), 0.07), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(a, 0.12)}
	end
	return C
end)()

pcall(Util.Color.Init)

		local function mk(class, props, parent, theme)
			local o = Instance.new(class)
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
			o.Parent = parent
			if theme == "accent" then accents[#accents + 1] = o
			elseif theme == "bg" then bgs[#bgs + 1] = o
			elseif theme == "text" then texts[#texts + 1] = o end
			return o
		end

			mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(1, 0)}, parent)

		}, root, "accent")

			Name = "Orbit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE + 8, SIZE + 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
		}, root)
		round(orbit)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, orbit, "accent")

		-- the button: dark disc with a comet border that keeps circling

			Name = "UhAdminButton", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.12, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, ZIndex = 3,
		}, root, "bg")

		local grad = mk("UIGradient", {
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),

				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.8),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
			}),

		}, btn)

		-- the 3D triangle (same engine as the hero triangle on the home page)

		local okTri, errTri = pcall(function()
			tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(btn, {
				Interactive = false,

		if not okTri or not tri then
			glyph.Visible = true
			warn("[UhAdmin] 3D triangle failed, using the flat one: " .. tostring(errTri))
		end

		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() S.hover = true end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() S.hover = false end)

		-- ── position / drag (mouse + touch) ──
		local function vpSize()
			local v = sg.AbsoluteSize
			if v.X < 50 or v.Y < 50 then v = Util.GetScreenSize() end
			return v
		end
		local function placeAt(cx, cy) -- pixel centre, clamped so the triangle can never be lost off screen
			local v = vpSize()
			local half = SIZE / 2 + 10
			cx = math.clamp(cx, half, math.max(half, v.X - half))
			cy = math.clamp(cy, half, math.max(half, v.Y - half - 14))
			root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(cx / v.X, cy / v.Y)
		end
		local function loadPos()
			local sx, sy = tostring(FX.Cfg.AdminTriPos or ""):match("^([%d%.]+),([%d%.]+)$")
			sx, sy = tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy)
			if sx and sy then
				root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(sx, 0.03, 0.97), math.clamp(sy, 0.03, 0.95))
			else
				root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) -- default: middle of the screen
			end
		end
		U.ResetTriPos = function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", "")
			loadPos()
		end
		loadPos()

		local function isPress(i)
			return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		end
		local dragInput, dragStart, startCX, startCY
		local moved, swallow, holdToken, suppressUntil = false, false, 0, 0

		btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) then return end
			local v = vpSize()
			dragInput, dragStart, moved, swallow = input, input.Position, false, false
			startCX = root.Position.X.Scale * v.X
			startCY = root.Position.Y.Scale * v.Y
			holdToken += 1
			local mine = holdToken
			task.delay(0.7, function() -- held still = hide the triangle
				if holdToken == mine and dragInput == input and not moved then
					dragInput, moved, swallow = nil, true, true
					FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", true)
					pcall(Util.Notify, FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
						and "Command triangle hidden. Tap the little tab at the top edge (or type showtri) to bring it back."
						or "Command triangle hidden. Type showtri (prefix + showtri) or use the Customization page to bring it back.")
				end
			end)
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragInput then return end
			local same = input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)
			if not same then return end
			local d = input.Position - dragStart
			if not moved and d.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
			if moved then placeAt(startCX + d.X, startCY + d.Y) end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragInput then return end
			local same = input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
			if not same then return end
			holdToken += 1
			if moved then
				suppressUntil = os.clock() + 0.3 -- a drag never counts as a tap
				FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", string.format("%.4f,%.4f", root.Position.X.Scale, root.Position.Y.Scale))
			end
			dragInput = nil
		end)

		-- tap = open the command bar (the admin core plugs U.OpenBar in once it is ready)
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if swallow or os.clock() < suppressUntil then return end
			if U.OpenBar then
				local ok, e = pcall(U.OpenBar)
				if not ok then warn("[UhAdmin] open bar failed: " .. tostring(e)) end
			else
				S.shake = 1
				if U.CoreError then
					pcall(Util.Notify, "Commands failed to load at '" .. tostring(U.Stage) .. "': " .. tostring(U.CoreError):sub(1, 180))
				else
					pcall(Util.Notify, "Commands are still loading (" .. tostring(U.Stage or "waiting") .. "), tap again in a moment.")
				end
			end
		end)

		-- tiny restore tab at the top edge while the triangle is hidden
		local tab = mk("TextButton", {
			Name = "UhRestoreTab", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false,
			Text = "\u{25BC}", TextSize = 9, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 3,
		}, sg, "accent")
		round(tab, UDim.new(0, 8))
		U.RestoreTab = tab
		tab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", false)
		end)

		-- hide / show (cfg AdminTriHidden: Customization switch + hidetri / showtri / tri commands)
		S.applied = nil
		local function applyHidden(hidden)
			if S.applied == hidden then return end
			local first = S.applied == nil
			S.applied = hidden
			if hidden then
				S.shown = false
				S.hover = false
				if first then
					scale.Scale = 0
					root.Visible = false
					if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
				else
					TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0}):Play()
					task.delay(0.37, function()
						if S.applied == true then
							root.Visible = false
							if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				root.Visible = true
				S.shown = true
				if tri then
					tri:SetActive(true)
					tri:PopIn()
				end
				TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
				pcall(FX.Ring, btn, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 90, 0.6, 2)
				flashLabel(3)
			end
		end

		-- live theme (follows the UI color / accent override)
		local themeT = 0
		local function applyTheme(t)
			if t - themeT < 0.05 then return end
			themeT = t
			local cfg = FX.Cfg
			local a, b, c
			if U.GetTheme then
				local ok, x, y, z = pcall(U.GetTheme, t)
				if ok and x then a, b, c = x, y, z end
			end
			a = a or Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1)
			b = b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			c = c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			if cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then a = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or a end
			for _, o in ipairs(accents) do
				if o:IsA("UIStroke") then o.Color = a else o.BackgroundColor3 = a end
			end
			for _, o in ipairs(bgs) do o.BackgroundColor3 = b end
			for _, o in ipairs(texts) do o.TextColor3 = c end
		end

		-- one driver for everything that moves (also drives the command bar's comet border + scan line)
		local drvAcc = 0
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			-- [v34] low end: the launcher / command bar animations update at a capped rate (default 30 fps)
			if FX.IsLowEnd() then
				drvAcc = drvAcc + dt
				if drvAcc < 1 / FX.LowEndUIFPS then return end
				dt, drvAcc = drvAcc, 0
			else
				drvAcc = 0
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local t = os.clock()
				applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
				local showTab = S.applied == true and FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
				tab.Visible = showTab
				if showTab then
					tab.Position = UDim2.new(root.Position.X.Scale, 0, 0, 0)
					tab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.15
				end
				applyTheme(t)

				S.boost = math.max(0, S.boost - dt * 1.6)
				S.flash = math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.2)
				S.shake = math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 3)

				-- every registered triangle (button + bar logo) spins faster the more is going on
				local want = 0.9 + (S.hover and 1.1 or 0) + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 2.5 + S.flash * 3
				for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
					local T = e.tri
					if T and T.active then
						T.baseSpin = T.baseSpin + (want * e.mult - T.baseSpin) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
						T.scaleBase = e.scale * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 2.3) + 0.12 * S.flash)
					end
				end

				if S.shown then
					local speed = 1.4 + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 3 + S.flash * 5
					U.orbitA = (U.orbitA or 0) + dt * speed
					local R = (SIZE + 8) / 2
					for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
						local a = U.orbitA + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 3)
						d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * R, 0.5, math.sin(a) * R)
					end
					U.btnGrad = ((U.btnGrad or 0) + dt * (90 + S.boost * 220 + (S.open and 120 or 0))) % 360
					grad.Rotation = U.btnGrad
					local pulse = SIZE + 14 + math.sin(t * 2) * 4 + S.flash * 18
					aura.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pulse, pulse)
					aura.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 - S.flash * 0.35 - (S.open and 0.07 or 0)
					btn.Rotation = S.shake > 0 and math.sin(t * 55) * 7 * S.shake or 0
					if glyph.Visible then glyph.Rotation = (t * 80 * want) % 360 end
				end

				-- command bar: rotating comet border, thicker while typing / running, scan line while open
				local g, bs = U.BarGrad, U.BarStroke
				if g and g.Parent then
					U.barGradA = ((U.barGradA or 0) + dt * (70 + (S.open and 90 or 0) + S.boost * 260)) % 360
					g.Rotation = U.barGradA
					bs.Thickness = 1.4 + S.boost * 1.2 + S.flash * 1.4
				end
				local sc = U.BarScan
				if sc and sc.Parent and S.open then
					U.scanT = ((U.scanT or 0) + dt / 1.5) % 1
					sc.Position = UDim2.new(0, -70 + U.scanT * 320, 1, 0)
				end
			end)
			if not ok and not U.tickWarned then
				U.tickWarned = true
				warn("[UhAdmin] driver error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)

		applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
	end)
	if not okL then
		warn("[UhAdmin] triangle launcher failed: " .. tostring(errL))
	end
end

-- [uh admin ext] COMMAND CORE now starts right here (on its own thread), BEFORE the intro / module loading,
-- so the triangle can open the command bar immediately instead of waiting for them.
 --[=[ NAMELESS ADMIN CORE — UH MOD INTEGRATION ]=]--
 -- spawned on its own thread so the mod's loading/websocket loops never block the admin core
 Util.UhAdmin.Stage = "core: starting"
 task.spawn(function()
 local okCore, errCore = xpcall(function()

 --[============================================================================[]--
   NAMELESS ADMIN x NOOBY'S UH MODDED REANIMATION — integrated core
   • Full Nameless Admin command set (every cmd) running inside the Uh mod
   • Nameless Admin UI stripped & rebuilt from scratch with the Uh mod theme
     (live animated accent / dark background, follows the Customization page)
   • Nameless Admin logo PNG replaced by the mod's dynamic 3D triangle
   • Discord startup notification removed
   • Storage forwarded: Nameless-Admin/* -> UhhhhhhReanim/*
 --[]============================================================================]--

 -- [uh integration] notifications routed through the mod's own notification system
 local Notification = {}
 Notification.Notify = function(t)
	 t = t or {}
	 local desc = tostring(t.Description or "")
	 local title = tostring(t.Title or "")
	 local msg = desc
	 if title ~= "" and title ~= "Nameless Admin" then
		 msg = title .. ": " .. desc
	 end
	 pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
 end
 local Notify = Notification.Notify

 -- [uh admin ext] shared state + helpers for the command triangle, command-bar FX, fling removal, hide/show.
 -- Everything lives in Util.UhAdmin so the admin core doesn't gain extra locals (Lua's 200-local limit).
 Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
	 Tris = {},
	 State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
 }
 -- extra command names to drop on top of the "anything with 'fling' in its name" rule below
 Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds = {punch = true}
 -- theme colours (accent, background, text). Uses the mod's live theme once it exists, a rainbow/black/white fallback before.
 Util.UhAdmin.Theme = function(t)
	 local th = Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme
	 if th then
		 local ok, a, b, c = pcall(th, t)
		 if ok and a then return a, b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
	 end
	 return Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
 end
	 Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked = function(aliases)
		 local allowed = {walkfling = true, wfling = true, unwalkfling = true, unwfling = true}
		 for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do
			 local l = tostring(n):lower()
			 if Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds[l] then return true end
			 if l:find("fling", 1, true) and not allowed[l] then return true end
		 end
		 return false
	 end
	 Util.UhAdmin.RegisterTri = function(tri, mult, scale)
	 if tri then
		 table.insert(Util.UhAdmin.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = mult or 1, scale = scale or 1})
	 end
 end
 -- events from the bar / list: open, close, type, run, unknown. Every registered triangle reacts.
 Util.UhAdmin.Fire = function(ev)
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 local S = U.State
	 local function each(f)
		 for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
			 if e.tri and e.tri.active then pcall(f, e.tri) end
		 end
	 end
	 if ev == "open" then
		 S.open = true
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 8 t.pulse = math.max(t.pulse, 0.7) end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "open", 1.2)
	 elseif ev == "close" then
		 S.open = false
	 elseif ev == "type" then
		 S.boost = math.min(1, S.boost + 0.3)
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 2.2 end)
	 elseif ev == "run" then
		 S.flash = 1
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 16 t.pulse = 1 t.prism = 1 end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "hit", 1.3)
	 elseif ev == "unknown" then
		 S.shake = 1
		 each(function(t)
			 t.yawVel = t.yawVel - 12
			 if not t.flipT then t.flipT = 0 end
		 end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "release", 0.8)
	 end
 end

 -- [uh integration] live theme engine for the rebuilt admin UI.
 -- Uses CollectionService tags so cloned template elements (autofill entries,
 -- command list rows, chat log lines) keep following the theme automatically.
 local UhCollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
 local UH_TAG_ACCENT = "UhAdmin_Accent"
 local UH_TAG_BG     = "UhAdmin_BG"
 local UH_TAG_TEXT   = "UhAdmin_Text"
 local function uhTag(obj, kind)
	 local tagName = (kind == "accent" and UH_TAG_ACCENT) or (kind == "bg" and UH_TAG_BG) or UH_TAG_TEXT
	 UhCollectionService:AddTag(obj, tagName)
 end
 do
	 local uhThemeLast = 0
	 game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		 local now = os.clock()
		 if now - uhThemeLast < 0.1 then return end
		 uhThemeLast = now
		 local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
		 local accent, bg, textCol = Util.UhAdmin.Theme(now)
		 if cfg and cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then
			 accent = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or accent
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_ACCENT)) do
			 if o:IsA("UIStroke") then
				 o.Color = accent
			 elseif o:IsA("GuiObject") then
				 o.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			 end
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_BG)) do
			 if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
				 o.BackgroundColor3 = bg
			 end
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_TEXT)) do
			 if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
				 o.TextColor3 = textCol
			 end
		 end
	 end)
 end

 -- [uh integration] programmatic rebuild of the Nameless Admin UI in the Uh theme.
 -- Keeps the exact instance hierarchy the command logic expects
 -- (CmdBar.CenterBar.Input, CmdBar.Autofill.Cmd, ChatLogs.Container.Logs, ...)
 -- so every original gui.* function works untouched, minus the remote UI model.
 local function uhNew(class, props, parent)
	 local o = Instance.new(class)
	 for k, v in pairs(props) do
		 o[k] = v
	 end
	 o.Parent = parent
	 return o
 end

 function BuildAdminUI()
	 local sg = uhNew("ScreenGui", {
		 Name = "UhAdmin",
		 IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		 ResetOnSpawn = false,
		 ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		 DisplayOrder = 2147483646,
	 })
	 local adminScale=uhNew("UIScale",{Scale=1},sg)
	 local function refreshAdminScale()
		 local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
		 if not cam then return end
		 local shortest=math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X,cam.ViewportSize.Y)
		 adminScale.Scale=math.clamp(shortest/720,0.78,1)
	 end
	 refreshAdminScale()
	 if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(refreshAdminScale) end

	 -- tooltip that follows the mouse (command descriptions)
	 local description = uhNew("TextLabel", {
		 Name = "Description",
		 Visible = false,
		 BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		 TextSize = 14,
		 Text = "",
		 ZIndex = 60,
	 }, sg)
	 uhTag(description, "bg") uhTag(description, "text")
	 uhTag(uhNew("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, description), "accent")
	 uhNew("UICorner", {}, description)
	 description.TextWrapped = true
	 description.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	 uhNew("UIPadding", {
		 PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8),
		 PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5),
	 }, description)

	 -- invisible strip the command bar animates on
	 local cmdBar = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "CmdBar",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		 Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -90),
		 Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 10),
		 BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		 Visible = true,
	 }, sg)

	 local centerBar = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "CenterBar",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		 Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 0),
		 BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 ClipsDescendants = true,
		 Visible = true,
		 ZIndex = 5,
	 }, cmdBar)
	 uhTag(centerBar, "bg")
	 -- [uh admin ext] animated comet border + scan line (driven by the triangle driver, reacts to typing / running)
	 local barStroke = uhNew("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, centerBar)
	 uhTag(barStroke, "accent")
	 local barGrad = uhNew("UIGradient", {
		 Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
		 Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			 NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.85),
			 NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.85), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		 }),
	 }, barStroke)
	 local barScan = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "Scan",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		 Position = UDim2.new(0, -70, 1, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 2),
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 ZIndex = 6,
	 }, centerBar)
	 uhTag(barScan, "accent")
	 uhNew("UIGradient", {
		 Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			 NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		 }),
	 }, barScan)
	 Util.UhAdmin.BarStroke, Util.UhAdmin.BarGrad, Util.UhAdmin.BarScan = barStroke, barGrad, barScan
	 uhNew("UICorner", {}, centerBar)

	 -- dynamic 3D triangle logo (replaces the Nameless Admin logo PNG)
	 local logoHolder = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "UhLogo",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		 Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
		 BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		 ZIndex = 7,
	 }, centerBar)

	 local cmdInput = uhNew("TextBox", {
		 Name = "Input",
		 Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(1, -72, 1, 0),
		 BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		 Font = Enum.Font.Code,
		 TextSize = 15,
		 Text = "",
		 PlaceholderText = "Command Bar...",
		 PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
		 ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		 TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		 ZIndex = 7,
	 }, centerBar)
	 uhTag(cmdInput, "text")

	 -- [uh admin ext] command-list button (touch friendly, opens the Commands window)
	 local listBtn = uhNew("TextButton", {
		 Name = "ListBtn",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		 Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 18),
		 BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 Text = "",
		 AutoButtonColor = false,
		 ZIndex = 8,
	 }, centerBar)
	 uhTag(listBtn, "bg")
	 uhNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)}, listBtn)
	 for i = 0, 2 do
		 uhTag(uhNew("Frame", {
			 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			 Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (i - 1) * 4),
			 Size = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 2),
			 BorderSizePixel = 0,
			 ZIndex = 9,
		 }, listBtn), "accent")
	 end
	 -- InputBegan (not Activated): the bar loses focus on press and starts collapsing, so wait-for-release would miss
	 listBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		 local ty = input.UserInputType
		 if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			 if Util.UhAdmin.OpenList then Util.UhAdmin.OpenList() end
		 end
	 end)

	 local leftFill = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "LeftFill",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		 Position = UDim2.new(-0.5, 100, 0.5, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(0, 125, 0, 2),
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 ZIndex = 4,
	 }, cmdBar)
	 uhTag(leftFill, "accent")
	 local rightFill = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "RightFill",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		 Position = UDim2.new(1.5, -100, 0.5, 0),
		 Size = UDim2.new(0, 125, 0, 2),
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 ZIndex = 4,
	 }, cmdBar)
	 uhTag(rightFill, "accent")

	 -- autofill dropdown (template "Cmd" with child "Input", as the original model had)
	 local cmdAutofill = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "Autofill",
		 AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		 Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 18),
		 Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 150),
		 BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	 }, cmdBar)
	 uhNew("UIListLayout", {
		 Name = "UIListLayout",

 --[[ COMMAND FUNCTIONS ]]--
 commandcount = 0
 cmd = {}
 cmd._lastError = nil
 cmd.add = function(...)
	local vars = {...}
	local aliases, info, func = vars[1], vars[2], vars[3]
	if type(aliases) ~= "table" or type(func) ~= "function" then return false end
	if Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked(aliases) then return false end
	local registration = {func, info or {}}
	local primary = aliases[1]
	if type(primary) ~= "string" or primary == "" then return false end
	Commands[primary:lower()] = registration
	for i = 2, #aliases do
		local alias = aliases[i]
		if type(alias) == "string" and alias ~= "" then Aliases[alias:lower()] = registration end
	end
	commandcount = commandcount + 1
	return true
 end

 cmd.run = function(args)
	cmd._lastError = nil
	if type(args) ~= "table" then cmd._lastError = "Invalid command arguments"; return false, cmd._lastError end
	local caller = type(args[1]) == "string" and args[1]:lower() or nil
	if not caller or caller == "" then cmd._lastError = "No command specified"; return false, cmd._lastError end
	local registration = Commands[caller] or Aliases[caller]
	if not registration then cmd._lastError = "Unknown command: " .. tostring(args[1]); return false, cmd._lastError end
	local arguments = {}
	for i = 2, #args do arguments[#arguments + 1] = args[i] end
	local success, err = _native_pcall(function() registration[1](table.unpack(arguments)) end)
	if not success then cmd._lastError = tostring(err); return false, cmd._lastError end
	return true
 end

 local wait = function(int)
	 if not int then int = 0 end
	 local t = tick()
	 repeat
		 RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(0)
	 until (tick() - t) >= int
	 return (tick() - t), t
 end

 -- [[ FUNCTION TO GET A PLAYER ]] --
 local getPlr = function(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local query = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	if query == "random" then if #players == 0 then return nil end; return players[math.random(1, #players)] end
	if query == "" then return nil end
	local prefixMatch, containsMatch
	for _, x in ipairs(players) do
		local user = x.Name:lower()
		local display = x.DisplayName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
		if user == query or display == query then return x end
		if not prefixMatch and (user:sub(1, #query) == query or display:sub(1, #query) == query) then prefixMatch = x end
		if not containsMatch and user:find(query, 1, true) then containsMatch = x end
	end
	return prefixMatch or containsMatch
end

function sFLY(vfly, requestedSpeed)
	speedofthefly = math.clamp(tonumber(requestedSpeed) or tonumber(speedofthefly) or 10, 1, 200)
	speedofthevfly = math.clamp(tonumber(requestedSpeed) or tonumber(speedofthevfly) or 10, 1, 200)
	pcall(unvfly)

	local player = cmdlp or Players.LocalPlayer
	if not player then return false end

	local keyboardControl = {F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0}
	local jumpUntil = 0
	local activeSpeed = tonumber(vfly and speedofthevfly or speedofthefly) or 10

	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then return end
		local k = input.KeyCode
		if k == Enum.KeyCode.W then keyboardControl.F = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then keyboardControl.B = -1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.A then keyboardControl.L = -1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = -1
		end
	end)

	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local k = input.KeyCode
		if k == Enum.KeyCode.W then keyboardControl.F = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then keyboardControl.B = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.A then keyboardControl.L = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = 0
		end
	end)

	local function getChar()
		local char = player.Character
		return char, char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	local function apply(root, hum)
		local bg = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyGyro") or Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "UHAdminFlyGyro"
		bg.P = 100000
		bg.D = 1000
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		bg.Parent = root

		local bv = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyVelocity") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "UHAdminFlyVelocity"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		bv.P = 10000
		bv.Parent = root

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cf = camera and camera.CFrame or root.CFrame

		local move = Vector3.zero
		move = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
		if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then move = move.Unit else move = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
		if right.Magnitude > 0.001 then right = right.Unit else right = Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
		move = move * (keyboardControl.F + keyboardControl.B)
			+ right * (keyboardControl.R + keyboardControl.L)
			+ Vector3.new(0, keyboardControl.Q + keyboardControl.E, 0)

		if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			bv.Velocity = move.Unit * activeSpeed
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		local flatLook = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			flatLook = flatLook.Unit
		else
			flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		end
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook, Vector3.yAxis)

		hum.AutoRotate = false
		if not vfly then
			hum.PlatformStand = true
		else
			hum.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end

	FLYING = true
	_G.__UH_FLY_MODE = "standard"

	_G.__UH_FLY_STEP = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not FLYING then return end
		local char, hum, root = getChar()
		if char and hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
			apply(root, hum)
		end
	end)

	local _, hum, root = getChar()
	if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
	if root then apply(root, hum) end

	return true
end

function unvfly()
	FLYING=false
	if _G.__UH_FLY_MODE == "standard" then _G.__UH_FLY_MODE = nil end
	pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN then _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED then _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_JUMP then _G.__UH_FLY_JUMP:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_STEP then _G.__UH_FLY_STEP:Disconnect() end end)

 -- [[ LIB FUNCTIONS ]] --
 lib.lock = function(instance, par)
	 locks[instance] = true
	 instance.Parent = par or instance.Parent
	 instance.Name = "RightGrip"
 end
 lock = lib.lock
 locks = {}
 
 lib.find = function(t, v)	-- mmmmmm
	 for i, e in pairs(t) do
		 if i == v or e == v then
			 return i
		 end
	 end
	 return nil
 end
 
 lib.parseText = function(text, watch)
	local parsed = {}
	if type(text) ~= "string" then return parsed end
	local delimiter = tostring(watch or " ")
	if delimiter == "" then return {text} end
	local token, quote, escape = {}, nil, false
	local function push() if #token > 0 then parsed[#parsed + 1] = table.concat(token); token = {} end end
	for i=1,#text do
		local ch=text:sub(i,i)
		if escape then token[#token+1]=ch; escape=false
		elseif ch=="\\" and quote then escape=true
		elseif quote then if ch==quote then quote=nil else token[#token+1]=ch end
		elseif ch=="'" or ch=='"' then quote=ch
		elseif delimiter==opt.prefix and ch==delimiter then push()
		elseif delimiter==opt.tupleSeparator and ch==delimiter then push()
		elseif delimiter==" " and ch:match("%s") then push()
		else token[#token+1]=ch end
	end
	push(); return parsed
end

lib.parseCommand = function(text, requirePrefix)
	if type(text) ~= "string" then return false end
	local prefix=tostring(opt.prefix or ";")
	if prefix == "" then prefix = ";" end
	local source=text
	if requirePrefix and source:sub(1,#prefix) ~= prefix then return false end
	while source:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix do source=source:sub(#prefix+1) end
	if source:match("^%s*$") then return false end
	local segments,current,quote={}, {}, nil
	for i=1,#source do
		local ch=source:sub(i,i)
		if ch=="'" or ch=='"' then if quote==ch then quote=nil elseif not quote then quote=ch end; current[#current+1]=ch
		elseif ch==";" and not quote then segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current); current={}
		else current[#current+1]=ch end
	end
	segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current)
	local ran=false
	for _,segment in ipairs(segments) do
		local args=lib.parseText(segment," ")
		if #args>0 then local ok,err=cmd.run(args); if ok then ran=true else Util.Notify("Command failed: "..tostring(err)) end end
	end
	return ran
end

 local connections = {}
 
 lib.connect = function(name, connection)	-- no :(
	 connections[name .. tostring(math.random(1000000, 9999999))] = connection
	 return connection
 end
 
 lib.disconnect = function(name)
	 for title, connection in pairs(connections) do
		 if title:find(name) == 1 then
			 connection:Disconnect()
		 end
	 end
 end
