										 end
					 if THumanoid.RootPart then
						 TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
					 else
					 end
					 
					 if THumanoid.Sit then
					 end
					 
					 local OldCFrame = RootPart.CFrame
					 
					 Humanoid:Destroy()
					 local NewHumanoid = Humanoid:Clone()
					 NewHumanoid.Parent = Character
					 NewHumanoid:UnequipTools()
					 NewHumanoid:EquipTool(Tool)
					 Tool.Parent = workspace
				 
					 local Timer = os.time()
				 
					 repeat
						 if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - RootPart.CFrame.p).Magnitude < 500 then
							 Tool.Grip = CFrame.new()
							 Tool.Grip = Handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(TRootPart.CFrame):Inverse()
						 end
						 firetouchinterest(Handle,TRootPart,0)
						 firetouchinterest(Handle,TRootPart,1)
						 game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
					 until Tool.Parent ~= Character or not TPlayer or not TRootPart or THumanoid.Health <= 0 or os.time() > Timer + .20
					 Player.Character = nil
					 NewHumanoid.Health = 0
					 player.CharacterAdded:wait(1)
					 repeat game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait() until Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					 Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = OldCFrame
		 end
			   
				 if not LoopKill then
					 Kill()
				 else
					 while LoopKill do
						 Kill()
					 end
				 end
			 until Loopkill == false
		 end
		 end)

				 Loopkill = false
			 end)

 local hiddenGUIS = {}
 cmd.add({"hideguis"}, {"hideguis", "Hides guis"}, function()
 function FindInTable(tbl,val)
	 if tbl == nil then return false end
	 for _,v in pairs(tbl) do
		 if v == val then return true end
	 end 
	 return false
 end
 
	 for i,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("PlayerGui"):GetDescendants()) do
		 if (v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ImageLabel") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) and v.Visible then
			 v.Visible = false
			 if not FindInTable(hiddenGUIS,v) then
				 table.insert(hiddenGUIS,v)
			 end
		 end
	 end
 end)

 end)

	 if not _G.FullBrightExecuted then
 
		 _G.FullBrightEnabled = false
	 
		 _G.NormalLightingSettings = {
			 Brightness = game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness,
			 ClockTime = game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime,
			 FogEnd = game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd,
			 GlobalShadows = game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows,
			 Ambient = game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient
		 }
	 
		 game:GetService("Lighting"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Brightness"):Connect(function()
			 if game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness ~= 1 and game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness ~= _G.NormalLightingSettings.Brightness then
				 _G.NormalLightingSettings.Brightness = game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness
				 if not _G.FullBrightEnabled then
					 repeat
						 wait()
					 until _G.FullBrightEnabled
				 end
				 game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness = 1
			 end
		 end)
	 
		 game:GetService("Lighting"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(function()
			 if game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime ~= 12 and game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime ~= _G.NormalLightingSettings.ClockTime then

				 if not _G.FullBrightEnabled then
					 repeat
						 wait()
					 until _G.FullBrightEnabled
				 end
				 game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = 12
			 end
		 end)
	 
		 game:GetService("Lighting"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("FogEnd"):Connect(function()
			 if game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd ~= 786543 and game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd ~= _G.NormalLightingSettings.FogEnd then
				 _G.NormalLightingSettings.FogEnd = game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd
				 if not _G.FullBrightEnabled then
					 repeat
						 wait()
					 until _G.FullBrightEnabled
				 end
				 game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd = 786543
			 end
		 end)
	 
		 game:GetService("Lighting"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("GlobalShadows"):Connect(function()
			 if game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows ~= false and game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows ~= _G.NormalLightingSettings.GlobalShadows then
				 _G.NormalLightingSettings.GlobalShadows = game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows
				 if not _G.FullBrightEnabled then

				 end

			 end
		 end)
	 
		 game:GetService("Lighting"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Ambient"):Connect(function()
			 if game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient ~= Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178) and game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient ~= _G.NormalLightingSettings.Ambient then
				 _G.NormalLightingSettings.Ambient = game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient
				 if not _G.FullBrightEnabled then
					 repeat
						 wait()
					 until _G.FullBrightEnabled
				 end
				 game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
			 end
		 end)
	 
		 game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness = 1
		 game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = 12
		 game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd = 786543
		 game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows = false

						 game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows = false

					 end
					 LatestValue = not LatestValue
				 end
			 end
		 end)
	 end

	 _G.FullBrightEnabled = not _G.FullBrightEnabled
 end)

 cmd.add({"chatspy"}, {"chatspy", "Spies on chat, enables chat, spies whispers etc."}, function()
	 
	 
	 
	 wait();
	 
	 Notify({
	 Description = "Chat spy enabled";
	 Title = "Nameless Admin";
	 Duration = 5;
	 
 });
 --This script reveals ALL hidden messages in the default chat
 --chat "/spy" to toggle!
 enabled = true
 --if true will check your messages too
 spyOnMyself = true
 --if true will chat the logs publicly (fun, risky)
 public = false
 --if true will use /me to stand out
 publicItalics = true
 --customize private logs
 privateProperties = {
	 Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255); 
	 Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold;
	 TextSize = 18;
 }
 --////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
 local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
 local Players = game:GetService("Players")
 local player = Players.LocalPlayer
 local saymsg = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"):WaitForChild("SayMessageRequest")
 local getmsg = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"):WaitForChild("OnMessageDoneFiltering")
 local instance = (_G.chatSpyInstance or 0) + 1
 _G.chatSpyInstance = instance
 
 local function onChatted(p,msg)
	 if _G.chatSpyInstance == instance then
		 if p==player and msg:lower():sub(1,4)=="/spy" then
			 enabled = not enabled
			 wait(0.3)
			 print("XD")
			 StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage",privateProperties)
		 elseif enabled and (spyOnMyself==true or p~=player) then
			 msg = msg:gsub("[\n\r]",''):gsub("\t",' '):gsub("[ ]+",' ')
			 local hidden = true
			 local conn = getmsg.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet,channel)
				 if packet.SpeakerUserId==p.UserId and packet.Message==msg:sub(#msg-#packet.Message+1) and (channel=="All" or (channel=="Team" and public==false and Players[packet.FromSpeaker].Team==player.Team)) then
					 hidden = false
				 end
			 end)
			 wait(1)
			 conn:Disconnect()
			 if hidden and enabled then
				 if public then
					 saymsg:FireServer((publicItalics and "/me " or '').."{SPY} [".. p.Name .."]: "..msg,"All")
				 else
					 privateProperties.Text = "{SPY} [".. p.Name .."]: "..msg
					 StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage",privateProperties)
				 end
			 end
		 end
	 end
 end
 
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	 p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) onChatted(p,msg) end)
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
	 p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) onChatted(p,msg) end)
 end)
 print("XD")
 StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage",privateProperties)
 local chatFrame = player.PlayerGui.Chat.Frame
 chatFrame.ChatChannelParentFrame.Visible = true
 chatFrame.ChatBarParentFrame.Position = chatFrame.ChatChannelParentFrame.Position+UDim2.new(UDim.new(),chatFrame.ChatChannelParentFrame.Size.Y)
 end)


 cmd.add({"bhop"}, {"bhop", "bhop bhop bhop bhop bhop bhop bhop bla bla bla idk what im saying"}, function()
	 -- [[ bhop functions ]] -- 
	 local player
	 local character
	 local collider
	 local camera
	 local input
	 local collider
	 local playerGrounded
	 local playerVelocity
	 local jumping
	 local moveInputSum
	 local dt = 1/60
	 local partYRatio
	 local partZRatio
	 local cameraYaw
	 local cameraLook
	 local movementPosition
	 local movementVelocity
	 local gravityForce
	 local airAccelerate
	 local airMaxSpeed
	 local groundAccelerate
	 local groundMaxVelocity
	 local friction
	 local playerTorsoToGround
	 local movementStickDistance
	 local jumpVelocity
	 local movementPositionForce
	 local movementVelocityForce
	 local maxMovementPitch
	 local rayYLength
	 local movementPositionD
	 local movementPositionP
	 local movementVelocityP
	 local gravity
	 
	 
	 
	 function init(Player, Camera, Input)
		 player = Player
		 character = player.Character
		 collider = character.HumanoidRootPart
		 camera = Camera
		 input = Input
		 playerVelocity = 0
		 playerGrounded = false
		 moveInputSum = {
		 ["forward"] = 0,
		 ["side"] 	= 0 --left is positive
		 }
		 
		 airAccelerate 			= 10000
		 airMaxSpeed 			= 2.4
		 groundAccelerate 		= 250
		 groundMaxVelocity 		= 20
		 friction			 	= 10
		 playerTorsoToGround 	= 3
		 movementStickDistance 	= 0.5
		 jumpVelocity 			= 52.5
		 movementPositionForce	= 400000
		 movementVelocityForce	= 300000
		 maxMovementPitch		= 0.6
		 rayYLength				= playerTorsoToGround + movementStickDistance
		 movementPositionD		= 125
		 movementPositionP		= 14000
		 movementVelocityP		= 1500
		 gravity					= 0.4
		 
	 end
	 
	 function initBodyMovers()
		 movementPosition = Instance.new("BodyPosition", collider)
		 movementPosition.Name = "movementPosition"
		 movementPosition.D = movementPositionD
		 movementPosition.P = movementPositionP
		 movementPosition.maxForce = Vector3.new()
		 movementPosition.position = Vector3.new()
		 
		 movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", collider)
		 movementVelocity.Name = "movementVelocity"
		 movementVelocity.P = movementVelocityP
		 movementVelocity.maxForce = Vector3.new()
		 movementVelocity.velocity = Vector3.new()
		 
		 gravityForce = Instance.new("BodyForce", collider)
		 gravityForce.Name = "gravityForce"
		 gravityForce.force = Vector3.new(0, (1-gravity)*196.2, 0) * getCharacterMass()
	 end
	 
	 function update(deltaTime)
		 dt = deltaTime
		 updateMoveInputSum()
		 cameraYaw = getYaw()
		 cameraLook = cameraYaw.lookVector	
		 if cameraLook == nil then
			 return
		 end
		 local hitPart, hitPosition, hitNormal, yRatio, zRatio = findCollisionRay()
		 partYRatio = yRatio
		 partZRatio = zRatio
		 
		 playerGrounded = hitPart ~= nil and true or false
		 playerVelocity = collider.Velocity - Vector3.new(0, collider.Velocity.y, 0)
		 if playerGrounded and (input["Space"] or jumping) then
			 jumping = true
		 else
			 jumping = false
		 end
		 
		 setCharacterRotation()
		 if jumping then
			 jump()
		 elseif playerGrounded then
			 run(hitPosition)
		 else
			 air()		
		 end
		 
	 end
	 
	 function updateMoveInputSum()
		 moveInputSum["forward"] = input["W"] == true and 1 or 0
		 moveInputSum["forward"] = input["S"] == true and moveInputSum["forward"] - 1 or moveInputSum["forward"]
		 moveInputSum["side"] = input["A"] == true and 1 or 0
		 moveInputSum["side"] = input["D"] == true and moveInputSum["side"] - 1 or moveInputSum["side"]
	 end
	 
	 function findCollisionRay()
		 local torsoCFrame = character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
		 local ignoreList = {character, camera}
		 local rays = {
			 Ray.new(character.HumanoidRootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -rayYLength, 0)),
			 Ray.new((torsoCFrame * CFrame.new(-0.8,0,0)).p, Vector3.new(0, -rayYLength, 0)),
			 Ray.new((torsoCFrame * CFrame.new(0.8,0,0)).p, Vector3.new(0, -rayYLength, 0)),
			 Ray.new((torsoCFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,0.8)).p, Vector3.new(0, -rayYLength, 0)),
			 Ray.new((torsoCFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-0.8)).p, Vector3.new(0, -rayYLength, 0))
		 }
		 local rayReturns  = {}
		 
		 local i
		 for i = 1, #rays do
			 local part, position, normal = game.Workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(rays[i],ignoreList)
			 if part == nil then
				 position = Vector3.new(0,-3000000,0)
			 end
			 if i == 1 then
				 table.insert(rayReturns, {part, position, normal})
			 else
				 local yPos = position.y
				 if yPos <= rayReturns[#rayReturns][2].y then
					 table.insert(rayReturns, {part, position, normal})
				 else 
					 local j
					 for j = 1, #rayReturns do
						 if yPos >= rayReturns[j][2].y then
							 table.insert(rayReturns, j, {part, position, normal})
						 end
					 end
				 end
			 end
		 end
		 
		 i = 1
		 local yRatio, zRatio = getPartYRatio(rayReturns[i][3])
		 while magnitude2D(yRatio, zRatio) > maxMovementPitch and i<#rayReturns do
			 i = i + 1
			 if rayReturns[i][1] then
				 yRatio, zRatio = getPartYRatio(rayReturns[i][3])
			 end
		 end
		 
		 return rayReturns[i][1], rayReturns[i][2], rayReturns[i][3], yRatio, zRatio
	 end
	 
	 function setCharacterRotation()
		 local rotationLook = collider.Position + camera.CoordinateFrame.lookVector
		 collider.CFrame = CFrame.new(collider.Position, Vector3.new(rotationLook.x, collider.Position.y, rotationLook.z))
		 collider.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
	 end
	 
	 function jump()
		 collider.Velocity = Vector3.new(collider.Velocity.x, jumpVelocity, collider.Velocity.z)
		 air()
	 end
	 
	 function air()
		 movementPosition.maxForce = Vector3.new()
		 movementVelocity.velocity = getMovementVelocity(collider.Velocity, airAccelerate, airMaxSpeed)
		 movementVelocity.maxForce = getMovementVelocityAirForce()
	 end
	 
	 function run(hitPosition)
		 local playerSpeed = collider.Velocity.magnitude
		 local mVelocity = collider.Velocity
		 
		 if playerSpeed ~= 0 then
			 local drop = playerSpeed * friction * dt;
			 mVelocity = mVelocity * math.max(playerSpeed - drop, 0) / playerSpeed;
		 end
		 
		 movementPosition.position = hitPosition + Vector3.new(0,playerTorsoToGround,0)
		 movementPosition.maxForce = Vector3.new(0,movementPositionForce,0)
		 movementVelocity.velocity = getMovementVelocity(mVelocity, groundAccelerate, groundMaxVelocity)
		 local VelocityForce = getMovementVelocityForce()
		 movementVelocity.maxForce = VelocityForce
		 movementVelocity.P = movementVelocityP
	 end
	 
	 function getMovementVelocity(prevVelocity, accelerate, maxVelocity)
		 local accelForward = cameraLook * moveInputSum["forward"]
		 local accelSide = (cameraYaw * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0)).lookVector * moveInputSum["side"];
		 local accelDir = (accelForward+accelSide).unit;
		 if moveInputSum["forward"] == 0 and moveInputSum["side"] == 0 then --avoids divide 0 errors
			 accelDir = Vector3.new(0,0,0);
		 end
		 
		 local projVel =  prevVelocity:Dot(accelDir);
		 local accelVel = accelerate * dt;
		 
		 if (projVel + accelVel > maxVelocity) then
			 accelVel = math.max(maxVelocity - projVel, 0);
		 end
		 
		 return prevVelocity + accelDir * accelVel;
	 end
	 
	 function getMovementVelocityForce()
	 
		 return Vector3.new(movementVelocityForce,0,movementVelocityForce)
	 end
	 
	 function getMovementVelocityAirForce()
		 local accelForward = cameraLook * moveInputSum["forward"];
		 local accelSide = (cameraYaw * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0)).lookVector * moveInputSum["side"]
		 local accelDir = (accelForward+accelSide).unit
		 if moveInputSum["forward"] == 0 and moveInputSum["side"] == 0 then
			 accelDir = Vector3.new(0,0,0);
		 end
		 
		 local xp = math.abs(accelDir.x)
		 local zp = math.abs(accelDir.z)
		 
		 return Vector3.new(movementVelocityForce*xp,0,movementVelocityForce*zp)
	 end
	 
	 function getPartYRatio(normal)
		 local partYawVector = Vector3.new(-normal.x, 0, -normal.z)
		 if partYawVector.magnitude == 0 then
			 return 0,0
		 else
			 local partPitch = math.atan2(partYawVector.magnitude,normal.y)/(math.pi/2)
			 local vector = Vector3.new(cameraLook.x, 0, cameraLook.z)*partPitch
			 return vector:Dot(partYawVector), -partYawVector:Cross(vector).y
		 end	
	 end
	 
	 function getYaw() --returns CFrame
		 return camera.CoordinateFrame*CFrame.Angles(-getPitch(),0,0)
	 end
	 
	 function getPitch() --returns number
		 return math.pi/2 - math.acos(camera.CoordinateFrame.lookVector:Dot(Vector3.new(0,1,0)))
	 end
	 
	 function getCharacterMass()
		 return character.HumanoidRootPart:GetMass() + character.Head:GetMass()
	 end
	 
	 function magnitude2D(x,z)
		 return math.sqrt(x*x+z*z)
	 end
	 
	 local inputKeys = {
		 ["W"] = false,
		 ["S"] = false,
		 ["A"] = false,
		 ["D"] = false,
		 ["Space"] = false,
		 ["LMB"] = false,
		 ["RMB"] = false
	 }
	
	 local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	 local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	 local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	 function onInput(input, gameProcessedEvent)
		 local inputState
		 --print(input.KeyCode)
		 if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			 inputState = true
		 elseif input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
			 inputState = false
		 else
			 return
		 end 
		 
		 if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			 local key = input.KeyCode.Name
			 if inputKeys[key] ~= nil then
				 inputKeys[key] = inputState
			 end
		 elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then --LMB down
			 inputKeys.LMB = inputState
		 elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then --RMB down
			 inputKeys.RMB = inputState
		 end
	 end
	 function main()
		 local a = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or plr.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid");
		 a.PlatformStand = true
		 --init movement
		 init(plr, camera, inputKeys);
		 initBodyMovers();
			 
		 --connect input
		 UserInputService.InputBegan:connect(onInput);
		 UserInputService.InputEnded:connect(onInput);
		 --connect updateloop
		 game:GetService("RunService"):BindToRenderStep("updateLoop", 1, updateLoop);
		 
		 --rip
	 end
	 
	 local prevUpdateTime = nil
	 local updateDT = 1/60
	 
	 function setDeltaTime() --seconds
		 local UpdateTime = tick() 
		 if prevUpdateTime ~= nil then
			 updateDT = (UpdateTime - prevUpdateTime)
		 else
			 updateDT = 1/60
		 end
		 prevUpdateTime = UpdateTime
	 end
	 function updateLoop()
		 setDeltaTime();
		 update(updateDT);
	 end
 main()
 end)

  cmd.add({"toolinvisible"}, {"toolinvisible", "Be invisible while still be able to use tools"}, function()
	local offset = 1100
	local invisible = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local grips = {}

	local gripChanged
	local handle
	local weld

		for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") then
				player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid").NameDisplayDistance = distance
				player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid").HealthDisplayDistance = distance
			end
		end
	end

					if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= tool then
						grips[child] = child.Grip
					end
				end
			elseif invisible then
				invisible = false
				tool.Name = "Visible Disabled"
				if handle then
					handle:Destroy()
				end
				if weld then
					weld:Destroy()
				end
				for _, child in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") then
						child.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
					end
				end
				for tool, grip in pairs(grips) do
					if tool then
						tool.Grip = grip
					end
				end
				heldTool = nil
				setDisplayDistance(100)
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
				game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -offset, 0)

			end
			tool.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
		end
	)

					grips[heldTool] = lastGrip
				end

				if gripChanged then
					gripChanged:Disconnect()
				end
				gripChanged =
					heldTool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Grip"):Connect(
					function()
						wait()
						if not invisible then
							gripChanged:Disconnect()
						end
						if heldTool.Grip ~= lastGrip then
							lastGrip =
								heldTool.Grip * (CFrame.new(0, offset - 1.5, 1.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))

							heldTool.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
							heldTool.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
						end
					end
				)
			end
		end
	)

 cmd.add({"unchatspy"}, {"unchat", "Unspies on chat, enables chat, spies whispers etc."}, function()
	 
 
 
 wait();
 
 Notify({
 Description = "Chat spy enabled";
 Title = "Nameless Admin";
 Duration = 5;
 
 });
 --This script reveals ALL hidden messages in the default chat
 --chat "/spy" to toggle!
 enabled = false
 --if true will check your messages too
 spyOnMyself = true
 --if true will chat the logs publicly (fun, risky)
 public = false
 --if true will use /me to stand out
 publicItalics = true
 --customize private logs
 privateProperties = {
	 Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255); 
	 Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold;
	 TextSize = 18;
 }
 --////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
 local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
 local Players = game:GetService("Players")
 local player = Players.LocalPlayer
 local saymsg = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"):WaitForChild("SayMessageRequest")
 local getmsg = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"):WaitForChild("OnMessageDoneFiltering")
 local instance = (_G.chatSpyInstance or 0) + 1
 _G.chatSpyInstance = instance
 
 local function onChatted(p,msg)
	 if _G.chatSpyInstance == instance then
		 if p==player and msg:lower():sub(1,4)=="/spy" then
			 enabled = not enabled
			 wait(0.3)
			 print("XD")
			 StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage",privateProperties)
		 elseif enabled and (spyOnMyself==true or p~=player) then
			 msg = msg:gsub("[\n\r]",''):gsub("\t",' '):gsub("[ ]+",' ')
			 local hidden = true
			 local conn = getmsg.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet,channel)
				 if packet.SpeakerUserId==p.UserId and packet.Message==msg:sub(#msg-#packet.Message+1) and (channel=="All" or (channel=="Team" and public==false and Players[packet.FromSpeaker].Team==player.Team)) then
					 hidden = false
				 end
			 end)
			 wait(1)
			 conn:Disconnect()
			 if hidden and enabled then
				 if public then
					 saymsg:FireServer((publicItalics and "/me " or '').."{SPY} [".. p.Name .."]: "..msg,"All")
				 else
					 privateProperties.Text = "{SPY} [".. p.Name .."]: "..msg
					 StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage",privateProperties)
				 end
			 end
		 end
	 end
 end
 
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	 p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) onChatted(p,msg) end)

 -- [[ Admin Player]]
 local _adminChatConnections = _adminChatConnections or {}
local function AdminChatted(_, Player)
	if not Player or _adminChatConnections[Player] then return end
	_adminChatConnections[Player]=Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		if Admin[Player.UserId] then lib.parseCommand(Message, true) end
	end)
end
function CheckPermissions(Player)
	if Player and Admin[Player.UserId] then AdminChatted(nil,Player) end
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	local connection=_adminChatConnections[Player]
	if connection then connection:Disconnect(); _adminChatConnections[Player]=nil end
end)

 gui.txtSize = function(ui, x, y)
	 local textService = game:GetService("TextService")
	 return textService:GetTextSize(ui.Text, ui.TextSize, ui.Font, Vector2.new(x, y))
 end
 -- [uh admin ext] command list: sorted, tap = put it in the bar, long-press / mouse hold = description popup
 gui._showDesc = function(row, text)
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 U.DescPinned = true
	 U.DescToken = (U.DescToken or 0) + 1
	 description.Text = (text and text ~= "") and text or "No description."
	 description.Visible = true
	 local size = gui.txtSize(description, 230, 240)
	 local sx, sy = size.X + 18, size.Y + 12
	 description.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy)
	 local vp = Util.GetScreenSize()
	 local ap, as = row.AbsolutePosition, row.AbsoluteSize
	 local x = math.clamp(ap.X + 10, 6, math.max(6, vp.X - sx - 6))
	 local y = ap.Y + as.Y + 4
	 if y + sy > vp.Y - 6 then y = ap.Y - sy - 4 end
	 description.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, math.max(6, y))
	 gui._hideDesc(4) -- safety net so a missed release can never leave the popup stuck
 end
 gui._hideDesc = function(delay)
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 local token = U.DescToken
	 task.delay(delay or 0, function()
		 if U.DescToken ~= token then return end
		 U.DescPinned = false
		 description.Visible = false
		 description.Text = ""
	 end)
 end
 gui._useCmd = function(cmdName)
	 gui.barSelect()
	 cmdInput.Text = cmdName .. " "
	 cmdInput:CaptureFocus()
 end
 gui._bindRow = function(row, cmdName, tbl)
	 local held, startPos, startT, shown = nil, Vector2.zero, 0, false
	 local function pos(input)
		 if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			 return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		 end
		 return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	 end
	 row.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		 local ty = input.UserInputType
		 if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		 held, shown, startPos, startT = input, false, pos(input), os.clock()
		 task.delay(0.45, function()
			 if held ~= input or shown then return end
			 if (pos(input) - startPos).Magnitude > 12 then return end -- finger moved: it's a scroll, not a hold
			 shown = true
			 gui._showDesc(row, tbl[2][2])
			 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "tick", 1.1)
		 end)
	 end)
	 row.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		 if held ~= input then return end
		 held = nil
		 if shown then
			 gui._hideDesc(1.8)
		 elseif (pos(input) - startPos).Magnitude <= 12 and os.clock() - startT < 0.45 then
			 gui._useCmd(cmdName)
		 end
	 end)
 end
 gui.commands = function()
	 if not commandsFrame or not commandsList or not commandExample then
		 error("UhAdmin UI is not initialized (Commands window missing)")
	 end
	 if not commandsFrame.Visible then
		 commandsFrame.Visible = true
		 commandsList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	 end
	 for _, v in pairs(commandsList:GetChildren()) do
		 if v:IsA("TextLabel") and v ~= commandExample then
			 v:Destroy()
		 end
	 end
	 local names = {}
	 for cmdName in pairs(Commands) do
		 names[#names + 1] = cmdName
	 end
	 table.sort(names)
	 for idx, cmdName in ipairs(names) do
		 local tbl = Commands[cmdName]
		 local Cmd = commandExample:Clone()
		 Cmd.Name = cmdName
		 Cmd.LayoutOrder = idx
		 Cmd.Text = " " .. tbl[2][1]
			Cmd.Visible = true
		 Cmd.Parent = commandsList
		 gui._bindRow(Cmd, cmdName, tbl)
	 end
	 commandsList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #names * 20 + 10)
	 -- [fixed] Only centre on first open; preserve user-dragged position.
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 if not U.CommandsOpened then
		 commandsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -283/2, 0.5, -260/2)
		 U.CommandsOpened = true
	 end
	 commandsFilter.Text = ""
 end
 Util.UhAdmin.OpenList = function()
	 gui.commands()
 end
 gui.chatlogs = function()
	 if not chatLogsFrame.Visible then
		 chatLogsFrame.Visible = true
	 end
	 -- [fixed] Only centre on first open.
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 if not U.ChatLogsOpened then
		 chatLogsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -283/2+5, 0.5, -260/2+5)
		 U.ChatLogsOpened = true
	 end
 end
 
 gui.tween = function(obj, style, direction, duration, goal)
	 local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle[style], Enum.EasingDirection[direction])
	 local tween = TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, goal)
	 tween:Play()
	 return tween
 end
 gui.mouseIn = function(guiObject, range)
	 local pos1, pos2 = guiObject.AbsolutePosition, guiObject.AbsolutePosition + guiObject.AbsoluteSize
	 local mX, mY = mouse.X, mouse.Y
	 if mX > pos1.X-range and mX < pos2.X+range and mY > pos1.Y-range and mY < pos2.Y+range then
		 return true
	 end
	 return false
 end
 gui.resizeable = function(ui, min, max)
	 local rgui = resizeFrame:Clone()
	 rgui.Parent = ui
	 
	 local mode
	 local UIPos
	 local lastSize
	 local lastPos = Vector2.new()
	 
	 local function update(delta)
		 local xy = resizeXY[(mode and mode.Name) or '']
		 if not mode or not xy then return end
		 local delta = (delta * xy[1]) or Vector2.new()
		 local newSize = Vector2.new(lastSize.X + delta.X, lastSize.Y + delta.Y)
		 newSize = Vector2.new(
			 math.clamp(newSize.X, min.X, max.X),
			 math.clamp(newSize.Y, min.Y, max.Y)
		 )
		 ui.Size = UDim2.new(0, newSize.X, 0, newSize.Y)
		 ui.Position = UDim2.new(
			 UIPos.X.Scale, 
			 UIPos.X.Offset + (-(newSize.X - lastSize.X) * xy[2]).X, 
			 UIPos.Y.Scale, 
			 UIPos.Y.Offset + (delta * xy[2]).Y
		 )
	 end
	 
	 mouse.Move:Connect(function()
		 update(Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y) - lastPos)
	 end)
	 
	 for _, button in pairs(rgui:GetChildren()) do
		 local isIn = false
		 button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			 if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				 mode = button
				 lastPos = Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
				 lastSize = ui.AbsoluteSize
				 UIPos = ui.Position
			 end
		 end)
		 button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			 if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				 mode = nil
			 end
		 end)
		 button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			 mouse.Icon = resizeXY[button.Name][3]
		 end)
		 button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			 if mouse.Icon == resizeXY[button.Name][3] then
				 mouse.Icon = ""
			 end
		 end)
	 end
 end
 gui.draggable = function(ui, dragui)
	 if not dragui then dragui = ui end
	 local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	 
	 local dragging
	 local dragInput
	 local dragStart
	 local startPos
	 
	 local function update(input)
		 local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		 ui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	 end
	 
	 dragui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		 if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			 dragging = true
			 dragStart = input.Position
			 startPos = ui.Position
			 
			 input.Changed:Connect(function()
				 if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					 dragging = false
				 end
			 end)
		 end
	 end)
	 
	 dragui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		 if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			 dragInput = input
		 end
	 end)
	 
	 UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		 if input == dragInput and dragging then
			 update(input)
		 end
	 end)
 end
 gui.menuify = function(menu)
	 local exit = menu:FindFirstChild("Exit", true)
	 local mini = menu:FindFirstChild("Minimize", true)
	 local minimized = false
	 local sizeX, sizeY = {Value=0}, {Value=0} -- [fixed] was IntValue instances polluting the frame
	 mini.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		 minimized = not minimized
		 if minimized then
			 sizeX.Value = menu.Size.X.Offset
			 sizeY.Value = menu.Size.Y.Offset
			 gui.tween(menu, "Quart", "Out", 0.5, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 283, 0, 25)})
		 else
			 gui.tween(menu, "Quart", "Out", 0.5, {Size = UDim2.new(0, sizeX.Value, 0, sizeY.Value)})
		 end
	 end)
	 exit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		 menu.Visible = false
	 end)
	 gui.draggable(menu, menu.Topbar)
	 menu.Visible = false
 end


 gui.loadCommands = function()
	if not cmdAutofill or not cmdExample then
		error("UhAdmin UI is not initialized (CmdAutofill/CmdExample missing)")
	end
	for _, v in pairs(cmdAutofill:GetChildren()) do
		if v ~= cmdExample and v.Name ~= "UIListLayout" then v:Destroy() end
	end
	for name, tbl in pairs(Commands) do
		local info = tbl[2]
		local btn = cmdExample:Clone()
		btn.Parent = cmdAutofill
		btn.Name = name
		btn.Input.Text = info[1]
		btn.Visible = false
	end
	cmdAutofill.Visible = false
end

	gui.loadCommands()
	gui.barSelect = function(speed)
	centerBar.Visible = true
	cmdAutofill.Visible = true
	pcall(Util.UhAdmin.Fire, "open")
	gui.tween(centerBar, "Sine", "Out", speed or 0.25, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 1, 15)})
	gui.tween(leftFill, "Quad", "Out", speed or 0.3, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)})
	gui.tween(rightFill, "Quad", "Out", speed or 0.3, {Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)})
	if gui.searchCommands then gui.searchCommands() end
end

gui.barDeselect = function(speed)
	pcall(Util.UhAdmin.Fire, "close")
	gui.tween(centerBar, "Sine", "Out", speed or 0.25, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 0)})
	gui.tween(leftFill, "Sine", "In", speed or 0.3, {Position = UDim2.new(-0.5, 100, 0.5, 0)})
	gui.tween(rightFill, "Sine", "In", speed or 0.3, {Position = UDim2.new(1.5, -100, 0.5, 0)})
	cmdAutofill.Visible = false
	for _, v in ipairs(cmdAutofill:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") and v ~= cmdExample then
			v.Visible = false
			v.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25)
		end
	end
end

Util.UhAdmin.OpenBar = function()
	 gui.barSelect()
	 cmdInput.Text = ''
	 cmdInput:CaptureFocus()
 end
 Util.UhAdmin.Stage = "core: bar ready"

 -- [[ AUTOFILL SEARCHER ]] --
 gui.searchCommands = function()
	if not cmdInput or not cmdAutofill then return end
	local str = tostring(cmdInput.Text or "")
	local prefix = tostring(opt.prefix or ";")
	if prefix ~= "" then
		while str:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix do str = str:sub(#prefix + 1) end
	end
	str = str:lower()
	local index = 0
	for _, v in ipairs(cmdAutofill:GetChildren()) do
		if v ~= cmdExample and v:IsA("Frame") then
			local cmd = Commands[v.Name]
			local name = cmd and cmd[2][1] or ""
			local isMatch = str == "" or v.Name:lower():find(str, 1, true) ~= nil
			if isMatch then index += 1 end
			local shouldShow = isMatch and index <= 5
			v.Input.Text = isMatch and v.Name or name
			v.Visible = shouldShow
			if shouldShow then
				local n = math.sqrt(index) * 125
				local yPos = (index - 1) * 28
				gui.tween(v, "Quint", "Out", 0.18, {Size = UDim2.new(0.5, n, 0, 25), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, yPos)})
			else
				v.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25)
			end
		end
	end
end
 --[[ GUI FUNCTIONALITY ]]--

-- [[ OPEN THE COMMAND BAR ]] -- 
 -- [fixed] Replaced deprecated mouse.KeyDown with UserInputService
 UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
	 if gp then return end
	 if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
	 local ok, keyText = pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(input.KeyCode) end)
	 local ch = ok and type(keyText) == "string" and keyText:sub(1,1):lower() or ""
	 if ch == "" then return end
	 if ch == tostring(opt.prefix or ";"):sub(1,1):lower() then
		 gui.barSelect()
		 cmdInput.Text = ''
		 cmdInput:CaptureFocus()
		 task.wait(0.00005)
		 cmdInput.Text = ''
	 end
 end)

 -- [[ CLOSE THE COMMAND BAR ]] -- 
 cmdInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
	 if enterPressed then
		 local pfx = (opt.prefix:gsub("%p", "%%%0"))
		 local word = ((cmdInput.Text:lower()):gsub("^%s*" .. pfx, "")):match("^%s*(%S+)") or ""
		 local known = (Commands[word] or Aliases[word]) and true or false
		 pcall(Util.UhAdmin.Fire, known and "run" or (word ~= "" and "unknown" or "close"))
		 if not known and word:find("fling", 1, true) and not word:find("antifling", 1, true) then
			 Notify({Description = "Standalone fling variants are disabled. Choose Fling 1, Fling 2, Fling 3, or NaN State from the Fling Method dropdown."; Title = "Uh Admin"; Duration = 6;})
		 end
		 wrap(function()
			 local entered=cmdInput.Text or ""
			 local prefix=tostring(opt.prefix or ";")
			 if entered:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix then entered=entered:sub(#prefix+1) end
			 lib.parseCommand(prefix .. entered)
		 end)
	 end
	 gui.barDeselect()
 end)
 
 cmdInput.Changed:Connect(function(p)
	 if p ~= "Text" then return end
	 if cmdInput.Text ~= "" then pcall(Util.UhAdmin.Fire, "type") end
	 gui.searchCommands()
 end)

	if p ~= "Text" then return end
	local filterText = tostring(commandsFilter.Text or ""):lower()
	for _, v in pairs(commandsList:GetChildren()) do

			v.Visible = filterText == "" or v.Name:lower():find(filterText, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
	end
end)
 -- [[ CHAT TO USE COMMANDS ]] --
 local function bindToChat(plr, msg)
	 local chatMsg = chatExample:Clone()
	 for i, v in pairs(chatLogs:GetChildren()) do
		 if v:IsA("TextLabel") then
			 v.LayoutOrder = v.LayoutOrder + 1
		 end
	 end
	 chatMsg.Parent = chatLogs
	 chatMsg.Text = ("[%s]: %s"):format(plr.Name, msg)
	 
	 local txtSize = gui.txtSize(chatMsg, chatMsg.AbsoluteSize.X, 100)
	 chatMsg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, txtSize.Y)
 end
 
 for i, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	 plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		 bindToChat(plr, msg)
	 end)
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	 plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		 bindToChat(plr, msg)
	 end)
 end)

 end)

	local byName = {}

	local function lower(v) return tostring(v or ""):lower() end
	local function host() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G end

	local function ready()
		local env = rawget(host(), "__UhNAEnv")
		if not env then return nil end
		local ok, c = pcall(function() return env.cmd end)
		if ok and type(c) == "table" then
			local okRun, run = pcall(function() return c.run end)
			if okRun and type(run) == "function" then return env, c end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local booting = false
	function NA.Boot()
		if ready() then return true end
		if booting then
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while booting and os.clock() - t0 < 100 do task.wait(0.2) end
			return ready() ~= nil
		end
		booting = true
		NA.Stage = "downloading"
		pcall(Util.Notify, "Loading the Nameless Admin runtime (first NA command)...")
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local loader = loadstring or load
			if type(loader) ~= "function" then error("no loadstring/load available") end
			local okGet, src = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(NA.Url) end)
			if not okGet or type(src) ~= "string" or #src < 1000 then error("could not download Source.lua: " .. tostring(src)) end
			-- one-line export so the bridge can reach NA's private environment (cmd / cmd.run)
			local patched, n = src:gsub("__NA_SPLIT_ENV = environment", "__NA_SPLIT_ENV = environment; rawset((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G, '__UhNAEnv', environment)")
			if n == 0 then error("NA bootstrap changed: export hook not found") end
			local fn, cerr = loader(patched, "@NamelessAdmin_Source")
			if type(fn) ~= "function" then error(cerr or "Source.lua failed to compile") end
			NA.Stage = "booting"
			NA.BootError = nil
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok2, e2 = pcall(fn)
				if not ok2 then NA.BootError = tostring(e2) end
			end)
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - t0 < 90 do
				if ready() then return end
				if NA.BootError then error(NA.BootError) end
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
			error("timed out waiting for NA's command core")
		end)
		booting = false
		if not ok then
			NA.Stage, NA.Error = "failed", tostring(err)
			warn("[UhAdmin] Nameless Admin runtime failed: " .. tostring(err))
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Nameless Admin runtime failed to load (see console). v53 commands are unaffected.")
			return false
		end
		NA.Stage = "ready"
		-- best effort: keep only the v53 bar/triangle visible, not NA's own window
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 40 do
				pcall(function()
					local env = rawget(host(), "__UhNAEnv")
					local g = env and env.NAStuff and env.NAStuff.NASCREENGUI
					if g and g.Enabled ~= nil then g.Enabled = false end
				end)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	function NA.Run(primary, args)
		task.spawn(function()
			if not NA.Boot() then return end
			local _, c = ready()
			if not c then return end
			local argv = { primary }
			for i = 1, #args do argv[#argv + 1] = args[i] end
			local ok, err = pcall(c.run, argv)
			if not ok then
				warn("[UhAdmin] NA command '" .. tostring(primary) .. "' failed: " .. tostring(err))
				pcall(Util.Notify, ("Nameless Admin command '%s' failed: %s"):format(tostring(primary), tostring(err)))
			end
		end)
	end

	function NA.exec(line)
		local parts = {}
		for w in tostring(line or ""):gmatch("%S+") do parts[#parts + 1] = w end
		local name = table.remove(parts, 1)
		if not name then return end
		NA.Run(byName[lower(name)] or lower(name), parts)
	end

	local okJ, list = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(CATALOGUE) end)
	if not okJ or type(list) ~= "table" then
		NA.Error = tostring(list)
		warn("[UhAdmin] NA catalogue failed to decode: " .. tostring(list))
	else
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local primary, aliases = lower(e[1]), e[2] or {}
			if primary ~= "" then
				byName[primary] = primary
				for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do byName[lower(a)] = primary end
				local names = { primary }
				for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do names[#names + 1] = a end
				if UH.IsBlocked(names) then
					NA.Blocked += 1
				elseif Commands[primary] or Aliases[primary] then
					NA.Native += 1
				else
					local kept = {}
					for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do
						local key = lower(a)
						if key ~= primary and not Commands[key] and not Aliases[key] then kept[#kept + 1] = key end
					end
					local usage = (e[3] and e[3] ~= "") and e[3] or primary
					if #kept > 0 then usage = usage .. " (" .. table.concat(kept, ", ") .. ")" end
					local reg = {
						function(...) return NA.Run(primary, { ... }) end,
						{ usage, (e[4] and e[4] ~= "") and e[4] or "Nameless Admin command." },
					}
					Commands[primary] = reg
					for _, key in ipairs(kept) do Aliases[key] = reg end
					commandcount += 1
					NA.Added += 1
				end
			end
		end
		UH.Stage = "nameless: catalogue registered (" .. tostring(NA.Added) .. ")"
		pcall(function() if gui and gui.loadCommands then gui.loadCommands() end end)
		pcall(Util.Notify, ("Nameless Admin: %d commands added (handlers load on first use), %d already native, %d blocked."):format(NA.Added, NA.Native, NA.Blocked))
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- TELEPORT TRANSITION  (adapted from Nameless Admin's TeleportGui: static handoff via SetTeleportGui, transition
-- token, TeleportInitFailed + 30 s watchdog, instance -> plain-place fallback). The logo is v53's own animated
-- 3D triangle (Util.FX.NewTriangle3D). Styles follow the live UI theme: orbit / radar / prism / scan.
-- ============================================================================
do
	local UH = Util.UhAdmin
	local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local TP = { Active = nil, Token = nil, Since = 0, Styles = { "orbit", "radar", "prism", "scan" } }
	UH.Teleport = TP

	local function new(class, props, parent)
		local o = Instance.new(class)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		o.Parent = parent
		return o
	end
	local function styleName()
		local ok, s = pcall(function() return SaveData.TeleportStyle end)
		s = ok and tostring(s or "orbit"):lower() or "orbit"
		if s == "random" then return TP.Styles[math.random(1, #TP.Styles)] end
		for _, n in ipairs(TP.Styles) do if n == s then return s end end
		return "orbit"
	end
	local function theme()
		local ok, a, b, c = pcall(UH.Theme, os.clock())
		if ok and typeof(a) == "Color3" then
			return a, (typeof(b) == "Color3" and b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)), (typeof(c) == "Color3" and c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		return Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	local function spaced(s) return (tostring(s or ""):upper():gsub(".", "%0\u{2009}")) end
	local function parentGui(g)
		if gethiddengui then
			local ok, h = pcall(gethiddengui)
			if ok and h and pcall(function() g.Parent = h end) and g.Parent then return true end
		end
		if pcall(function() g.Parent = CoreGui end) and g.Parent then return true end
		return pcall(function() g.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end)
	end

	function TP.Clear()
		local ui = TP.Active
		TP.Active = nil
		if not ui then return end
		if ui.conn then pcall(function() ui.conn:Disconnect() end) end
		pcall(function() TeleportService:SetTeleportGui(nil) end)
		local function kill()
			if ui.tri then pcall(function() ui.tri:Destroy() end) end
			pcall(function() ui.gui:Destroy() end)
		end
		if ui.shade and ui.shade.Parent then
			pcall(function() TweenService:Create(ui.shade, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play() end)
			task.delay(0.25, kill)
		else
			kill()
		end
	end

	function TP.Update(action, detail, placeId)
		local ui = TP.Active
		if not ui then return end
		if action and ui.title then ui.title.Text = spaced(action) end
		if detail and ui.detail then ui.detail.Text = tostring(detail) end
		if placeId and ui.place then ui.place.Text = "DESTINATION  //  " .. tostring(placeId) end
	end

	-- static copy handed to Roblox's own teleport loading screen (animations do not survive the place change)
	function TP.Handoff()
		local ui = TP.Active
		if not ui or not ui.gui then return false end
		return pcall(function()
			local copy = ui.gui:Clone()
			copy.Name = "UhTeleportHandoff"
			copy.Enabled = true
			for _, n in ipairs({ "Cancel", "Shade" }) do
				local c = copy:FindFirstChild(n, true)
				if c then c:Destroy() end
			end
			TeleportService:SetTeleportGui(copy)
		end)
	end

	function TP.Create(action, detail, placeId, tag)
		TP.Clear()
		local accent, bg, txt = theme()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 450)
		local mobile = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled
		local S = math.clamp(math.floor(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.52), 150, 380)
		local ui = { accents = {}, updaters = {}, started = os.clock(), style = styleName() }
		local function acc(o, prop) ui.accents[#ui.accents + 1] = { o, prop }; return o end

		local gui = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "UhTeleport", IgnoreGuiInset = true, ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 2147483000, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling }, nil)
		local root = new("Frame", { Name = "Root", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = 1 }, gui)
		local function band(y, rot)
			local f = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, y), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.38), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root)
			new("UIGradient", { Rotation = rot, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, f)
		end
		band(0, 90); band(1, -90)
		local border = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2 }, root)
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }, border)
		acc(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.82, Color = accent }, border), "Color")

		local stage = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, S), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, root)
		local function ring(scale, thick, tr, arc)
			local r = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(scale, scale), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, stage)
			new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, r)
			local st = acc(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = thick, Transparency = tr, Color = accent }, r), "Color")
			local gr
			if arc then
				gr = new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, st)
			end
			return r, gr, st
		end
		local function dot(size)
			local d = acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, stage), "BackgroundColor3")
			new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, d)
			return d
		end
		local function addUpdater(f) ui.updaters[#ui.updaters + 1] = f end

		if ui.style == "orbit" then
			local _, g1 = ring(1.0, 2, 0, true)
			local _, g2 = ring(0.8, 1.5, 0.15, true)
			local _, g3 = ring(0.62, 1, 0.35, true)
			ring(0.46, 1, 0.8, false)
			local dots = {}
			for i = 1, 6 do dots[i] = dot(i % 2 == 0 and 5 or 7) end
			addUpdater(function(t)
				g1.Rotation = (t * 110) % 360
				g2.Rotation = (-t * 160) % 360
				g3.Rotation = (t * 70) % 360
				for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
					local a = t * (1.1 + i * 0.12) * (i % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1) + i * 1.05
					local r = (i <= 3 and 0.5 or 0.4) * S
					d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * r, 0.5, math.sin(a) * r)
				end
			end)
		elseif ui.style == "radar" then
			ring(1.0, 2, 0.1, false); ring(0.72, 1, 0.5, false); ring(0.44, 1, 0.6, false)
			local hands = {}
			for i = 0, 6 do
				local h = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, stage)
				local line = acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 + i * 0.13, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, h), "BackgroundColor3")
				new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, line)
				hands[#hands + 1] = { h, i }
			end
			local blips = {}
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local b = dot(5)
				local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, (0.18 + math.random() * 0.28) * S
				b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * r, 0.5, math.sin(a) * r)
				blips[i] = b
			end
			addUpdater(function(t)
				for _, e in ipairs(hands) do e[1].Rotation = (t * 140 - e[2] * 7) % 360 end
				for i, b in ipairs(blips) do b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.85 * ((math.sin(t * 2 + i * 1.7) + 1) / 2) end
			end)
		elseif ui.style == "prism" then
			local cols = {}
			local n = math.clamp(math.floor(vp.X / 38), 10, 40)
			for i = 1, n do
				local h = math.random(60, 180)
				local c = acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new((i - 0.5) / n, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(1, 2), 0, h), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
				new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }) }, c)
				cols[i] = { c, math.random(), 0.15 + math.random() * 0.35, h, (i - 0.5) / n }
			end
			local waves = {}
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local r, _, st = ring(1, 1.5, 0.3, false)
				waves[i] = { r, st }
			end
			addUpdater(function(t)
				for _, e in ipairs(cols) do
					e[1].Position = UDim2.new(e[5], 0, 0, ((t * e[3] + e[2]) % 1) * (vp.Y + e[4]) - e[4])
				end
				for i, w in ipairs(waves) do
					local p = (t * 0.35 + (i - 1) / 3) % 1
					local sz = 0.35 + p * 0.85
					w[1].Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
					w[2].Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * p
				end
			end)
		else -- scan
			for i = 1, 11 do
				acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(i / 12, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.93, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
			end
			for i = 1, 6 do
				acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, i / 7, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.93, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
			end
			local sweep = acc(new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
			local glow = acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 }, sweep), "BackgroundColor3")
			new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.82) }) }, glow)
			for _, c in ipairs({ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }) do
				local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
				acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 2), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, stage), "BackgroundColor3")
				acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 22), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, stage), "BackgroundColor3")
			end
			ring(0.5, 1, 0.7, false)
			addUpdater(function(t) sweep.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (t * 0.28) % 1, 0) end)
		end

		-- logo: v53's animated 3D triangle (flat rotating one if the 3D build fails)
		local holder = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.42), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6 }, stage)
		local okT, tri = pcall(function()
			return Util.FX.NewTriangle3D(holder, { Interactive = false, ZIndex = 8, LayerSize = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
		end)
		if okT and tri then
			tri.baseSpin, tri.scaleBase = 2.2, 1.25
			ui.tri = tri
			pcall(function() tri:PopIn() end)
		else
			local f = acc(new("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{25B2}", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = accent, ZIndex = 8 }, holder), "TextColor3")
			addUpdater(function(t) f.Rotation = (t * 120) % 360 end)
		end

		-- text block + indeterminate progress bar + elapsed timer
		local W = math.min(vp.X - 36, 460)
		local info = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, S / 2 + 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, 104), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 7 }, root)
		local function label(y, h, size, font, text, tr, align)
			return new("TextLabel", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = txt, TextTransparency = tr, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 8 }, info)
		end
		ui.title = label(0, 30, mobile and 20 or 26, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, spaced(action), 0)
		ui.detail = label(31, 16, 13, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, tostring(detail or ""), 0.3)
		ui.place = label(49, 14, 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "DESTINATION  //  " .. tostring(placeId or game.PlaceId), 0.5)
		local track = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 72), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = txt, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 8 }, info)
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, track)
		local fill = acc(new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9 }, track), "BackgroundColor3")
		local fg = new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, fill)
		ui.timer = label(82, 14, 10, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "00:00", 0.45, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		label(82, 14, 10, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, tag and ("JOB  " .. tostring(tag):sub(1, 8)) or "", 0.45, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
		new("TextLabel", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 52), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = spaced("UH ADMIN") .. "  //  TELEPORT", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = txt, TextTransparency = 0.35, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 8 }, root)
		acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 46), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 2), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")

		local cancel = new("TextButton", { Name = "Cancel", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 34), BackgroundColor3 = bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, Text = "CANCEL", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = txt, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 10 }, root)
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, cancel)
		acc(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4, Color = accent }, cancel), "Color")
		cancel.Activated:Connect(function() TP.Cancel() end)

		local lastSec = -1
		ui.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local t = os.clock() - ui.started
				local a = theme()
				for _, e in ipairs(ui.accents) do e[1][e[2]] = a end
				fg.Offset = Vector2.new(-1 + ((t * 0.85) % 1) * 2, 0)
				if ui.tri then ui.tri.baseSpin = 2 + 0.6 * math.sin(t * 1.7) end
				for _, f in ipairs(ui.updaters) do f(t, dt) end
				local sec = math.floor(t)
				if sec ~= lastSec then
					lastSec = sec
					ui.timer.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(sec / 60), sec % 60)
				end
			end)
			if not ok and not ui.warned then ui.warned = true; warn("[UhAdmin] teleport screen: " .. tostring(err)) end
		end)

		if not parentGui(gui) then
			pcall(function() ui.conn:Disconnect() end)
			if ui.tri then pcall(function() ui.tri:Destroy() end) end
			pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
			return nil
		end
		ui.gui, ui.root = gui, root
		ui.shade = new("Frame", { Name = "Shade", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 50 }, root)
		pcall(function() TweenService:Create(ui.shade, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play() end)
		TP.Active = ui

		task.spawn(function() -- destination name (same place: game.Name, other place: marketplace lookup)
			local pid = tonumber(placeId) or game.PlaceId
			local name = (pid == game.PlaceId) and tostring(game.Name or "") or ""
			if name == "" then
				local okI, pi = pcall(function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(pid) end)
				if okI and type(pi) == "table" and pi.Name then name = tostring(pi.Name) end
			end
			if name ~= "" and TP.Active == ui and ui.place then ui.place.Text = name:upper() .. "  //  " .. tostring(pid) end
		end)
		return ui
	end

	function TP.Cancel()
		TP.Token = nil
		pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportCancel() end)
		if TP.FailConn then pcall(function() TP.FailConn:Disconnect() end); TP.FailConn = nil end
		TP.Clear()
	end

	-- spec = { method, args, action, detail, placeId, tag, reuse, fallback = { method, args, detail } }
	function TP.Go(spec)
		local now = os.clock()
		if TP.Token and (now - TP.Since) < 20 then
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport already in progress.")
			return false
		end
		local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
		local token = tostring(now) .. ":" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000))
		TP.Token, TP.Since = token, now
		local function fail(msg)
			if TP.Token == token then
				TP.Token = nil
				if TP.FailConn then pcall(function() TP.FailConn:Disconnect() end); TP.FailConn = nil end
				TP.Clear()
			end
			if msg then pcall(Util.Notify, msg) end
		end
		if spec.reuse and TP.Active then
			TP.Update(spec.action, spec.detail, spec.placeId)
		else
			TP.Create(spec.action, spec.detail, spec.placeId, spec.tag)
		end
		if TP.FailConn then pcall(function() TP.FailConn:Disconnect() end); TP.FailConn = nil end
		local okc, conn = pcall(function()
			return TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, result, errMsg)
				if player == lp and TP.Token == token then
					fail(("Teleport failed [%s]: %s"):format(tostring(result), tostring(errMsg)))
				end
			end)
		end)
		if okc then TP.FailConn = conn end
		task.delay(30, function()
			if TP.Token == token then fail("Teleport timed out - overlay removed.") end
		end)
		task.wait(0.15) -- let the triangle render a frame before the static copy is handed to Roblox
		if TP.Token ~= token then return false end
		TP.Handoff()
		local function call(m)
			return pcall(function() return TeleportService[m.method](TeleportService, table.unpack(m.args)) end)
		end
		local ok, err = call(spec)
		if not ok and spec.fallback then
			TP.Update(nil, spec.fallback.detail)
			ok, err = call(spec.fallback)
		end
		if not ok then
			fail("Teleport error: " .. tostring(err))
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	-- rejoin / serverhop / joinjobid keep their v53 names + aliases; only the handler is swapped
	local function setHandler(name, fn)
		local reg = Commands[name]
		if type(reg) == "table" then reg[1] = fn return true end
		return false
	end
	setHandler("rejoin", function()
		local lp, pid, jid = Players.LocalPlayer, game.PlaceId, game.JobId
		if #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 or jid == "" then
			TP.Go({ method = "Teleport", args = { pid, lp }, action = "REJOINING", detail = "Finding a fresh server", placeId = pid })
		else
			TP.Go({ method = "TeleportToPlaceInstance", args = { pid, jid, lp }, action = "REJOINING SERVER", detail = "Returning to the current server", placeId = pid, tag = jid,
				fallback = { method = "Teleport", args = { pid, lp }, detail = "Current server unavailable, finding another" } })
		end
	end)
	setHandler("joinjobid", function(id)
		id = tostring(id or ""):gsub("%s", "")
		if id == "" then pcall(Util.Notify, "Usage: joinjobid <jobid>") return end
		local lp, pid = Players.LocalPlayer, game.PlaceId
		TP.Go({ method = "TeleportToPlaceInstance", args = { pid, id, lp }, action = "JOINING SERVER", detail = "Connecting to the requested job id", placeId = pid, tag = id })
	end)
	local searching = false
	setHandler("serverhop", function()
		if searching or (TP.Token and os.clock() - TP.Since < 20) then
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport already in progress.")
			return
		end
		searching = true
		local lp, pid = Players.LocalPlayer, game.PlaceId
		TP.Create("SERVER HOP", "Searching public servers", pid)
		local okS, pick = pcall(function()
			local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. pid .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100&excludeFullGames=true"
			local okG, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
			if not okG then body = game:HttpGetAsync(url) end
			local data = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body)
			local pool = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(data.data or {}) do
				if type(v) == "table" and v.id ~= game.JobId and v.playing < v.maxPlayers then pool[#pool + 1] = v end
			end
			table.sort(pool, function(a, b) return a.playing > b.playing end)
			local top = math.min(#pool, 5)
			return top > 0 and pool[math.random(1, top)] or nil
		end)
		searching = false
		if not okS or not pick then
			TP.Clear()
			pcall(Util.Notify, okS and "No other public server found." or ("Server search failed: " .. tostring(pick)))
			return
		end
		TP.Go({ reuse = true, method = "TeleportToPlaceInstance", args = { pid, pick.id, lp }, action = "SERVER HOP", detail = ("Joining a server with %d/%d players"):format(pick.playing, pick.maxPlayers), placeId = pid, tag = pick.id,
			fallback = { method = "Teleport", args = { pid, lp }, detail = "Server unavailable, letting Roblox pick one" } })
	end)

	cmd.add({"tpstyle"}, {"tpstyle <orbit|radar|prism|scan|random>", "Sets the teleport loading screen style"}, function(s)
		s = tostring(s or ""):lower()
		local valid = (s == "random")
		for _, n in ipairs(TP.Styles) do if n == s then valid = true end end
		if not valid then
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport styles: orbit, radar, prism, scan, random")
			return
		end
		SaveData.TeleportStyle = s
		pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport screen style: " .. s)
	end)
	cmd.add({"tptest", "tpscreen"}, {"tptest (tpscreen)", "Previews the teleport loading screen for 5 seconds (no teleport)"}, function()
		if TP.Token and os.clock() - TP.Since < 20 then return end
		TP.Create("TELEPORT PREVIEW", "Preview only - nothing is being teleported", game.PlaceId)
		local active = TP.Active
		task.delay(5, function() if TP.Active == active and not TP.Token then TP.Clear() end end)
	end)
end

SaveData.SkipIntro = not not SaveData.SkipIntro
SaveData.MuteUIMusic = not not SaveData.MuteUIMusic
SaveData.MuteReanimMusic = not not SaveData.MuteReanimMusic
SaveData.MuteUISound = not not SaveData.MuteUISound

-- [v23] cinematic intro (60 s since v48). It plays the theme song (Modjo - Lady (Hear Me Tonight)); when that file is not
-- available it falls back to Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit). It runs on its own thread, so the UI keeps building / module
-- loading keeps going underneath it and the intro has a SKIP button that opens the UI.
Util.IntroTrackFile = "dm_change.ft2.mp3" -- fallback track
Util.RunIntro = function(preview)
	if Util.IntroRunning then return end
	if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then -- [v34] low end mode: no cinematic intro (it is the heaviest effect in the script)
		if preview then
			pcall(Util.UINotify, "Intro preview is disabled in Low End UI Mode")
		end
		return
	end
	Util.IntroRunning = true
	Util.IntroMusicReady = false
	Util.IntroTheme = false
	Util.FX.IntroActive = true -- the window boot animation waits for this, so it unfolds right when the intro ends
	task.spawn(function() -- the song loads in parallel; the cinematic clock starts on its first note
		pcall(function()
			UISound.Music.Volume = 0
			local idx = nil
			Util.IntroTheme = Util.ThemeSong.Ensure(40) -- [v48] first run: wait for the one-time decode / save (cached afterwards; returns at once on a failure)
			if Util.IntroTheme then
				for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
					if entry.Theme then
						idx = i
						break
					end
				end
			end
			for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
				if idx then break end
				if type(entry[1]) == "string" and entry[1]:find(Util.IntroTrackFile, 1, true) then
					idx = i
					break
				end
			end
			if not idx then -- custom Muzik folder replaced the built-in list: put the intro song back at the front
				table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {"UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. Util.IntroTrackFile, "Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit)"})
				idx = 1
			end
			MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(idx)
			local waited = os.clock()
			repeat RunService.RenderStepped:Wait() until UISound.Music.IsLoaded or os.clock() - waited > 3
			UISound.Music:Stop()
			task.wait()
			UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
			UISound.Music:Play()
			UISound.Music.Volume = 1
		end)
		Util.IntroMusicReady = true
	end)
	local okAll, errAll = pcall(Util.FX.Intro, UIMainFrame, UISound.Music, Util.FX.MarqueeText(""), {
		Preview = preview,
		Ready = function() return Util.IntroMusicReady end,
		ReadyWait = 46, -- [v48] first run can include the one-time theme decode / save (the wait ends at once when the song is ready or failed)
		Theme = function() return Util.IntroTheme and Util.ThemeSong or nil end, -- [v48] beat grid of the theme song
		ClickSnd = UISound.Click, -- [v30] lets the intro play its little tick sounds
	})
	if not okAll then
		warn("[Uhhhhhh] intro failed (UI is unaffected): " .. tostring(errAll))
	end
	Util.FX.IntroCamBusy = false -- [v48] always hand the cinematic camera back, even if the intro errored
	Util.FX.IntroActive = false
	if SaveData.MuteUIMusic then

	end
	Util.IntroRunning = false
end

		UISound.Music.Volume = 0
	end

	task.spawn(Util.RunIntro, false)
end

httpTxt = function(u, hdr)
	if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then
		return nil, "bad url"
	end
	local rq = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (http and http.request)
	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local h = {
			["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
			["Accept"] = "*/*",
		}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			local code = tonumber(res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code) or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
	end
	local ok, body = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(u)
	end)
	if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
		return body
	end
	return nil, "HttpGet returned " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(body) or type(body))
end

local function runUrl(u, name, hdr)
	local ld = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
	if type(ld) ~= "function" then
		return false, "loadstring unavailable"
	end
	local src, er = httpTxt(u, hdr)
	if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then
		return false, er or "empty source"
	end
	local fn, er2 = ld(src, name or ("@" .. u))
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		return false, er2 or "compile failed"
	end
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
		pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, fn, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
	end
	return pcall(fn)
end

local uiLib = {}
uiLib.draggerV2 = function(ui, dragui)
	dragui = dragui or ui
	local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	local anchor = ui.AnchorPoint
	local sg = ui:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui") or ui.Parent
	local function sClamp(v, lo, hi)
		if hi < lo then
			hi = lo
		end
		return math.clamp(v, lo, hi)
	end
	local function upd(input)
		pcall(function()
			local p = sg.AbsoluteSize
			local s = ui.AbsoluteSize
			if p.X <= 0 or p.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local sx = startPos.X.Scale * p.X + startPos.X.Offset
			local sy = startPos.Y.Scale * p.Y + startPos.Y.Offset
			local dx = input.Position.X - dragStart.X
			local dy = input.Position.Y - dragStart.Y
			local minX = anchor.X * s.X
			local maxX = p.X - (1 - anchor.X) * s.X
			local minY = anchor.Y * s.Y
			local maxY = p.Y - (1 - anchor.Y) * s.Y
			local nx = sClamp(sx + dx, minX, maxX)
			local ny = sClamp(sy + dy, minY, maxY)
			ui.Position = UDim2.new(nx / p.X, 0, ny / p.Y, 0)
		end)
	end
	local id = "DraggerV2_" .. ui:GetDebugId()
	NAlib.disconnect(id)
	NAlib.connect(
		id,
		dragui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			pcall(function()
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					dragging = true
					dragStart = input.Position
					startPos = ui.Position
					local c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
						pcall(function()
							if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
								dragging = false
							end
						end)
					end)
					NAlib.connect(id, c)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
	NAlib.connect(
		id,
		dragui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			pcall(function()
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					dragInput = input
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
	NAlib.connect(
		id,
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			pcall(function()
				if input == dragInput and dragging then
					upd(input)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
	local function clampToView()
		pcall(function()
			local p = sg.AbsoluteSize
			local s = ui.AbsoluteSize
			if p.X <= 0 or p.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local pos = ui.Position
			local ax = pos.X.Scale * p.X + pos.X.Offset
			local ay = pos.Y.Scale * p.Y + pos.Y.Offset
			local minX = anchor.X * s.X
			local maxX = p.X - (1 - anchor.X) * s.X
			local minY = anchor.Y * s.Y
			local maxY = p.Y - (1 - anchor.Y) * s.Y
			local nx = sClamp(ax, minX, maxX)
			local ny = sClamp(ay, minY, maxY)
			ui.Position = UDim2.new(nx / p.X, 0, ny / p.Y, 0)
		end)
	end
	NAlib.connect(id, (sg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(clampToView))
	if ui and ui.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
		NAlib.connect(id, (ui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(clampToView))
	end
	clampToView()
	if ui and NAlib.isProperty(ui, "Active") then
		NAlib.setProperty(ui, "Active", true)
	end
	if dragui and NAlib.isProperty(dragui, "Active") then
		NAlib.setProperty(dragui, "Active", true)
	end
end

local function isGib(n)
	if typeof(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not n:match("^[%w _%-]+$")
end
local function getMain()
	local best
	local bestScore = 0
	for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			local score = 0
			if g:FindFirstChild("Executor") then
				score += 5
			elseif g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true) then
				score += 2
			end
			if g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar") then
				score += 4
			elseif g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true) then
				score += 2
			end
			for _, name in { "Scripthub", "Settings", "Home", "Console" } do
				if g:FindFirstChild(name) then
					score += 2
				elseif g:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
					score += 1
				end
			end
			if g:FindFirstChild("MainScript") then
				score += 1
			end
			if isGib(g.Name) then
				score += 1
			end
			if score > bestScore then
				best = g
				bestScore = score
			end
		end
	end
	if bestScore >= 11 then
		return best
	end
end

local function fixNet(rootGui)
	if not rootGui then
		return
	end
	local side = rootGui:FindFirstChild("Sidemenu", true) or rootGui
	local net = side and side:FindFirstChild("Network", true)
	if not (net and net:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		return
	end
	local over = net:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
	if not (over and over:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		over = Instance.new("Frame")
		over.Name = "Overlay"
		over.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		over.BorderSizePixel = 0
		over.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		over.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		over.ClipsDescendants = false
		over.ZIndex = net.ZIndex + 1
		over.Parent = net
	end
	for _, name in { "Holder", "Information" } do
		local ch = net:FindFirstChild(name)
		if ch and ch ~= over and ch.Parent == net and not over:FindFirstChild(name) then
			ch.Parent = over
		end
	end
	return over
end
local function getIconGui()
	local bestGui
	local bestButton
	local bestScore = -math.huge
	for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and not g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true) then
			local buttons = {}
			local guiCount = 0
			for _, d in g:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
					guiCount += 1
				end
				if d:IsA("ImageButton") then
					table.insert(buttons, d)
				end
			end
			if #buttons == 1 and guiCount <= 12 then
				local button = buttons[1]
				local score = 0
				if button.Parent == g then
					score += 4
				end
				if type(button.Image) == "string" and button.Image ~= "" then
					score += 3
				end
				local size = button.AbsoluteSize
				if size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0 then
					local ratio = size.X / size.Y
					if ratio >= 0.7 and ratio <= 1.3 then
						score += 3
					end
				end
				if isGib(g.Name) then
					score += 1
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore = score
					bestGui = g
					bestButton = button
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestGui, bestButton
end
