			menu = menu,
			row = fr,
			baseHeight = baseHeight,
		}
		table.insert(customDropdownMenus, dropdownEntry)
		local selectedName
		local optionButtons = {}
		local hover = false
		local dropdownOpen = false
		local function getDropdownScale()
			local sc = uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object
			local factor = sc and tonumber(sc.Scale) or 1
			if not factor or factor <= 0 then
				factor = 1
			end
			return factor
		end
		local function syncExpandedHeight()
			local s = fr.Size
			local menuLogicalHeight = menu.Size.Y.Offset
			local uiScaleFactor = getDropdownScale()
			if menu.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
				menuLogicalHeight = math.max(menuLogicalHeight, math.floor((menu.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScaleFactor) + 0.5))
			end
			local expandedHeight = baseHeight + menuLogicalHeight + 6
			fr.Size = UDim2.new(s.X.Scale, s.X.Offset, 0, dropdownOpen and expandedHeight or baseHeight)
		end
		local function setExpanded(open)
			dropdownOpen = open and true or false
			menu.Visible = dropdownOpen
			upArrow.TextColor3 = open and Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 180) or Color3.fromRGB(104, 110, 124)
			downArrow.TextColor3 = open and Color3.fromRGB(104, 110, 124) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 180)
			syncExpandedHeight()
			openBg.BackgroundColor3 = open and Color3.fromRGB(48, 52, 64)
				or (hover and Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(39, 42, 52))
		end
		dropdownEntry.collapse = function()
			setExpanded(false)
		end
		local function refreshOptions()
			for name, btn in optionButtons do
				if btn and btn.Parent then
					btn.TextColor3 = name == selectedName and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						or Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 252)
					local check = btn:FindFirstChild("Check")
					if check and check:IsA("TextLabel") then
						check.Visible = name == selectedName
					end
				end
			end
			openBtn.Text = selectedName or "Select"
		end
		local function applySelection(name)
			if not table.find(names, name) then
				return
			end
			selectedName = name
			pcall(function()
				setSelectedName(name)
			end)
			if opts.persist and id then
				saveSettingsEntry(id, { name = name })
			end
			refreshOptions()
		end
		for idx, name in names do
			local option = Instance.new("TextButton")
			option.Name = name
			option.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
			option.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			option.BorderSizePixel = 0
			option.AutoButtonColor = false
			option.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			option.TextSize = 12
			option.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			option.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			option.Text = name
			option.LayoutOrder = idx
			option.ZIndex = 27
			option.Parent = menu
			local optionPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			optionPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 24)
			optionPad.Parent = option
			local divider = Instance.new("Frame")
			divider.Name = "Divider"
			divider.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
			divider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
			divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, idx < #names and 1 or 0)
			divider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(66, 96, 128)
			divider.BorderSizePixel = 0
			divider.ZIndex = 27
			divider.Parent = option
			local check = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			check.Name = "Check"
			check.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			check.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			check.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
			check.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
			check.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			check.TextSize = 15
			check.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
			check.Text = "✓"
			check.Visible = false
			check.ZIndex = 28
			check.Parent = option
			optionButtons[name] = option
			option.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				closeCustomDropdowns(menu)
				setExpanded(false)
				applySelection(name)
			end)
		end
		openBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hover = true
			if not menu.Visible then
				openBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 60)
			end
		end)
		openBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hover = false
			if not menu.Visible then
				openBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(39, 42, 52)
			end
		end)
		openBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local willOpen = not menu.Visible
			closeCustomDropdowns(menu)
			setExpanded(willOpen)
		end)
		menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncExpandedHeight)
		end)
		menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncExpandedHeight)
		end)
		if uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object and uiScaleState.object.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			uiScaleState.object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(syncExpandedHeight)
			end)
		end
		local initialName
		if opts.persist and id then
			local saved = settingsConfig[id]
			if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.name) == "string" then
				initialName = saved.name
			end
		end
		if type(getCurrentName) == "function" then
			initialName = initialName or getCurrentName()
		end
		if not table.find(names, initialName) then
			initialName = names[1]
		end
		setExpanded(false)
		applySelection(initialName)
	end
	local function makeIconRgbToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and iconBtn and iconStroke) then
			return
		end
		local key = "IconRGB"
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "RGB icon"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Rainbow outline on the Delta icon."
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local saved = settingsConfig[key]
		local enabled = false
		if type(saved) == "table" and saved.enabled ~= nil then
			enabled = saved.enabled and true or false
		end
		local hue = 0
		local function saveState()
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[key] = { enabled = enabled }
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local function setVisualToggle()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		local function startLoop()
			NAlib.disconnect("IconRGB_Loop")
			NAlib.connect(
				"IconRGB_Loop",
				RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
					local spd = iconRgbSpeedValue and math.clamp(iconRgbSpeedValue.Value, 0.05, 2) or 0.2
					hue = (hue + dt * spd) % 1
					pcall(function()
						iconStroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
					end)
				end)
			)
		end
		local function stopLoop()
			NAlib.disconnect("IconRGB_Loop")
			pcall(function()
				if iconColorUseCustom and iconColorValue then
					iconStroke.Color = iconColorValue.Value
				else
					iconStroke.Color = iconBaseColor or iconStroke.Color
				end
			end)
		end
		local function applyState()
			setVisualToggle()
			if enabled then
				startLoop()
			else
				stopLoop()
			end
			saveState()
		end
		applyState()
		local function toggleClick()
			enabled = not enabled
			applyState()
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local function makeDestroyUIButton()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Destroy Delta UI"
			tLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Deletes Delta's UI and icon until you rejoin."
			dLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "KILL"
		end
		btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local function click()
			if iconGui and iconGui ~= mainGui then
				pcall(function()
					iconGui:Destroy()
				end)
				iconGui = nil
			end
			if mainGui then
				pcall(function()
					mainGui:Destroy()
				end)
				mainGui = nil
			end
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(click)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					click()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local function makeIconEnableToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and iconBtn) then
			return
		end
		local key = "IconEnabled"
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Use custom icon"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = iconFsOk() and "Toggle between default and custom Delta icon"
				or "Requires file system + getcustomasset support"
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local enabled = dIcons.enabled and true or false
		local function setVisual()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		setVisual()
		local function toggleClick()
			local target = not enabled
			local ok, err = setIconEnabled(target)
			if not ok then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = err or "Failed to toggle custom icon.",
					Duration = 5,
				})
				return
			end
			enabled = target
			setVisual()
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local function makeIconInputRow()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and iconBtn) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Icon source"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Asset id or image URL (GitHub/External supported)"
		end
		local oldBtn = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		local pos
		if oldBtn then
			pos = oldBtn.Position
			oldBtn:Destroy()
		end
		local basePos = pos or UDim2.new(1, -160, 0.5, 0)
		local bx, bo = basePos.X.Scale, basePos.X.Offset
		local by, byo = basePos.Y.Scale, basePos.Y.Offset
		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = "IconInput"
		box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 18)
		box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		box.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo, by, byo)
		box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = true
		box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		box.TextSize = 12
		box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		box.Text = ""
		box.PlaceholderText = "ID or image URL"
		box.Parent = frame
		local setBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		setBtn.Name = "Apply"
		setBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
		setBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		setBtn.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo - 170, by, byo)
		setBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
		setBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		setBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		setBtn.TextSize = 11
		setBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		setBtn.Text = "SET"
		setBtn.Parent = frame
		local setCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		setCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		setCorner.Parent = setBtn
		local defBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		defBtn.Name = "Default"
		defBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
		defBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		defBtn.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo - 230, by, byo)
		defBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		defBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		defBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		defBtn.TextSize = 11
		defBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		defBtn.Text = "DEF"
		defBtn.Parent = frame
		local defCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		defCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		defCorner.Parent = defBtn
		local function applyInput()
			if not iconFsOk() then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = "Custom icons require file system + getcustomasset.",
					Duration = 5,
				})
				return
			end
			local txt = trim(box.Text or "")
			if txt == "" then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = "Enter an asset id or image URL.",
					Duration = 4,
				})
				return
			end
			local ok, msg = setIconAsset(txt, { autoEnable = true })
			if not ok then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = msg or "Failed to set custom icon.",
					Duration = 5,
				})
				return
			end
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
			box.Text = ""
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Icon",
				Description = "Custom icon updated.",
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		local function resetDefault()
			dIcons.enabled = false
			dIcons.assetId = ""
			dIcons.localPath = ""
			applyIcon()
			saveIconCfg()
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Icon",
				Description = "Reverted to default icon.",
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		setBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(applyInput)
		defBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(resetDefault)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
			if enter then
				applyInput()
			end
		end)
	end
	local function makeIconManagerRow()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Icon manager"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = iconFsOk() and formatIconStatus() or "File system/getcustomasset not supported."
		end
		local oldBtn = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		local pos
		if oldBtn then
			pos = oldBtn.Position
			oldBtn:Destroy()
		end
		local basePos = pos or UDim2.new(1, -160, 0.5, 0)
		local bx, bo = basePos.X.Scale, basePos.X.Offset
		local by, byo = basePos.Y.Scale, basePos.Y.Offset
		local function mkMgrBtn(nm, w, xOff, bgColor, txt)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.Name = nm
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 18)
			b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo + xOff, by, byo)
			b.BackgroundColor3 = bgColor
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			b.TextSize = 11
			b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			b.Text = txt
			b.Parent = frame
			local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
			c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
			c.Parent = b
			return b
		end
		local gray = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		local prevBtn = mkMgrBtn("Prev", 24, -210, gray, "<")
		local nextBtn = mkMgrBtn("Next", 24, -180, gray, ">")
		local delBtn = mkMgrBtn("Del", 32, -140, Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 40), "DEL")
		local clrBtn = mkMgrBtn("Clr", 36, -95, Color3.fromRGB(60, 30, 30), "CLR")
		local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		statusLabel.Name = "Status"
		statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 18)
		statusLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo, by, byo)
		statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		statusLabel.TextSize = 11
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
		statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		statusLabel.Text = "-/-"
		statusLabel.Parent = frame
		function updateIconStatusUI()
			if not statusLabel then
				return
			end
			local n = #dIcons.entries
			local idx = dIcons.index
			if dLabel then
				dLabel.Text = iconFsOk() and formatIconStatus() or "File system/getcustomasset not supported."
			end
			if n <= 0 then
				statusLabel.Text = "-/-"
			else
				if idx < 1 or idx > n then
					idx = 1
				end
				statusLabel.Text = tostring(idx) .. "/" .. tostring(n)
			end
		end
		updateIconStatusUI()
		local function chkFs()
			if iconFsOk() then
				return true
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Icon",
				Description = "Custom icon manager requires file system + getcustomasset.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			if #dIcons.entries == 0 then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No custom icons to cycle.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			cycleIcon(-1)
		end)
		nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			if #dIcons.entries == 0 then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No custom icons to cycle.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			cycleIcon(1)
		end)
		delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			local list = dIcons.entries
			local idx = dIcons.index
			if #list == 0 or idx < 1 or idx > #list then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No icon selected to delete.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			local e = list[idx]
			if not e or not e.file then
				return
			end
			removeIconEntry(e)
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
		end)
		clrBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			if #dIcons.entries == 0 then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No custom icons to clear.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			removeAllIcons()
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
			notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "Cleared all custom icons.", Duration = 4 })
		end)
	end
	local sidebarGestureEnabled = false
	local sidebarGestureVisible = true
	local sidebarGestureWidth = 18
	local sidebarGestureHeight = 120
	local sidebarGestureFrame
	local sidebarDragActive = false
	local sidebarDragStartX = 0
	local sidebarDragStartAlpha = 0
	local sidebarDragAlpha = 0
	local getCurrentSectionName
	local sidebarCurrentSection = nil
	local autoCloseOnLoad = true
	local sectionsList = { "Executor", "Home", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" }
	local gestureWidthValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	gestureWidthValue.Name = "GestureWidthValue"
	gestureWidthValue.Value = sidebarGestureWidth
	local gestureHeightValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	gestureHeightValue.Name = "GestureHeightValue"
	gestureHeightValue.Value = sidebarGestureHeight
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.GestureWidth
		if type(cfg) == "table" and type(cfg.value) == "number" then
			gestureWidthValue.Value = math.clamp(cfg.value, 6, 80)
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.GestureHeight
		if type(cfg) == "table" and type(cfg.value) == "number" then
			gestureHeightValue.Value = math.clamp(cfg.value, 60, 400)
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.SidebarGesture
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.SidebarGestureVisible
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			sidebarGestureVisible = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.AutoCloseOnLoad
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			autoCloseOnLoad = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	local gestCol = Instance.new("Color3Value")
	gestCol.Name = "GestureColorValue"
	gestCol.Value = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	gestCol.Changed:Connect(function()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureFrame.BackgroundColor3 = gestCol.Value
		end
	end)
	local function closeDeltaSidebar()
		if sidebar then
			setSidebarPosition(sidebarClosedPos)
			normalizeSidebarGeometry()
		end
		if mainGui then
			for _, n in sectionsList do
				local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
				if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
					fr.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
		setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
	end
	local function openDeltaFromIcon()
		if not sidebar then
			return
		end
		local curSec = getCurrentSectionName()
		if curSec then
			sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
		end
		if not sidebarCurrentSection then
			sidebarCurrentSection = sectionsList[1]
		end
		if TS and sidebar then
			local tw = __lt.cm(
				"TweenService",
				"Create",
				sidebar,
				TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{
					Position = UDim2.new(sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale, sidebarOpenPos.X.Offset, 0.5, 0),
				}
			)
			tw:Play()
		else
			setSidebarPosition(sidebarOpenPos)
		end
		normalizeSidebarGeometry()
		setIconForcedHidden(true)
		if mainGui and sidebarCurrentSection then
			for _, n in sectionsList do
				local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
				if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
					fr.Visible = n == sidebarCurrentSection
				end
			end
		end
	end
	bindManagedIconToggle = function()
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedIcon_Toggle")
		if not (iconBtn and iconBtn:IsA("GuiButton")) then
			return
		end
		NAlib.connect("ManagedIcon_Toggle", MouseButtonFix(iconBtn, function()
			local override = rawget(__dcm_env, "__NewDeltaUIToggle")
			if type(override) == "function" then
				local ok, handled = pcall(override)
				if ok and handled ~= false then
					return
				end
			end
			if not sidebar then
				return
			end
			local isOpen = math.abs(sidebar.Position.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale) <= 0.001
			if isOpen then
				closeDeltaSidebar()
			else
				openDeltaFromIcon()
			end
		end))
	end
	bindManagedIconToggle()
	local function saveSidebarGesture()
		if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		settingsConfig.SidebarGesture = { enabled = sidebarGestureEnabled }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
	end
	local function saveSidebarGestureVisible()
		if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		settingsConfig.SidebarGestureVisible = { enabled = sidebarGestureVisible }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
	end
	local function applyGestureVisual()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureFrame.BackgroundTransparency = sidebarGestureVisible and 0.4 or 1
		end
	end
	local function applyGestureSize()
		if not sidebarGestureFrame then
			return
		end
		local h = math.clamp(gestureHeightValue and gestureHeightValue.Value or sidebarGestureHeight, 60, 400)
		local w = math.clamp(gestureWidthValue and gestureWidthValue.Value or sidebarGestureWidth, 6, 80)
		if UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled then
			w = math.floor(w * 1.6)
		end
		sidebarGestureFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
	end
	gestureWidthValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			applyGestureSize()
		end
	end)
	gestureHeightValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			applyGestureSize()
		end
	end)
	local function ensureSidebarGestureFrame()
		if sidebarGestureFrame or not (sidebar and mainGui) then
			return
		end
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		sidebarGestureFrame = f
		f.Name = "SidebarGestureZone"
		f.BackgroundColor3 = gestCol.Value
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		f.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		f.Size = UDim2.new(0, sidebarGestureWidth, 0, sidebarGestureHeight)
		f.Active = false
		f.Visible = false
		f.Parent = mainGui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		corner.Parent = f
		applyGestureSize()
		applyGestureVisual()
	end

	function getCurrentSectionName()
		if not mainGui then
			return nil
		end
		local cur
		for _, name in sectionsList do
			local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(name)
			if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") and fr.Visible then
				cur = name
			end
		end
		return cur
	end
	do
		local iconApi = rawget(__dcm_env, "DeltaIcon")
		if type(iconApi) == "table" then
			iconApi.getCurrentSectionName = getCurrentSectionName
			iconApi.setForcedHidden = setIconForcedHidden
			iconApi.openClassic = openDeltaFromIcon
			iconApi.closeClassic = closeDeltaSidebar
			iconApi.setCurrentSection = function(name)
				if table.find(sectionsList, name) then
					sidebarCurrentSection = name
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function bindSidebarSectionMemory()
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarSectionMemory")
		if not mainGui then
			return
		end
		local current = getCurrentSectionName()
		if current then
			sidebarCurrentSection = current
		end

			local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(name)
			if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
				NAlib.connect(
					"SidebarSectionMemory",
					fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
						if fr.Visible then
							sidebarCurrentSection = name
						end
					end)
				)
			end
		end
	end
	bindSidebarSectionMemory()
	function applySidebarGestureState()
		if not sidebar then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = false
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		ensureSidebarGestureFrame()
		if not sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = false
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		if toggleUIBtn and toggleUIBtn:IsA("ImageButton") then
			pcall(function()
				toggleUIBtn.Visible = not sidebarGestureEnabled
			end)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarGesture")
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = false
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = false
		if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
			setIconForcedHidden(false)
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		setIconForcedHidden(true)
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = true
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = true
		applyGestureVisual()
		applyGestureSize()
		local id = "SidebarGesture"
		local function recalcGesturePosition()
			if not (mainGui and sidebar and sidebarGestureFrame) then
				return
			end
			local sgSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			if sgSize.X <= 0 or sgSize.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local sbPos = sidebar.AbsolutePosition
			local sbSize = sidebar.AbsoluteSize
			local px = sbPos.X - 8
			sidebarGestureFrame.Position = UDim2.new(px / sgSize.X, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
		local function getSidebarAlpha()
			if not sidebar then
				return 0
			end
			local sx = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
			local denom = sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale
			if denom == 0 then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp((sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sx) / denom, 0, 1)
		end
		recalcGesturePosition()
		NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		if sidebar.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		if mainGui and mainGui.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (mainGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		local function updateSidebarFromInput(input)
			if not sidebar or not mainGui then
				return
			end
			local dx = input.Position.X - sidebarDragStartX
			local guiSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			local dist = guiSize.X * math.abs(sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale)
			if dist <= 0 then
				dist = 100
			end
			local alpha = math.clamp(sidebarDragStartAlpha - dx / dist, 0, 1)
			sidebarDragAlpha = alpha
			setSidebarPosition(
				UDim2.new(
					sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale + (sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale - sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale) * alpha,
					0,
					0.5,
					0
				)
			)
		end
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sidebarGestureFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragAlpha = getSidebarAlpha()
				sidebarDragStartAlpha = sidebarDragAlpha
				sidebarDragStartX = input.Position.X
				sidebarDragActive = true
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarDragActive or not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					updateSidebarFromInput(input)
				end
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarDragActive or not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragActive = false
				local curSec = getCurrentSectionName()
				if curSec then
					sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
				end
				local targetPos = sidebarDragAlpha > 0.5 and sidebarOpenPos or sidebarClosedPos
				if TS and sidebar then
					local tw = __lt.cm(
						"TweenService",
						"Create",
						sidebar,
						TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{
							Position = UDim2.new(targetPos.X.Scale, targetPos.X.Offset, 0.5, 0),
						}
					)
					tw:Play()
				elseif sidebar then
					setSidebarPosition(targetPos)
				end
				if targetPos == sidebarOpenPos then
					if not sidebarCurrentSection then
						sidebarCurrentSection = getCurrentSectionName()
					end
					setIconForcedHidden(true)
					if mainGui and sidebarCurrentSection then
						for _, n in sectionsList do
							local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
							if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
								fr.Visible = n == sidebarCurrentSection
							end
						end
					end
				else
					if mainGui then
						if curSec then
							sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
						end
						for _, n in sectionsList do
							local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
							if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
								fr.Visible = false
							end
						end
					end
					setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
				end
			end)
		)
		saveSidebarGesture()
	end
	if toggleUIBtn and toggleUIBtn:IsA("GuiButton") then
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedToggleUI_ForcedHidden")
		NAlib.connect(
			"ManagedToggleUI_ForcedHidden",
			toggleUIBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
			end)
		)
	end

	do

			"SoundReverb",
			"Sound Reverb",
			"Set SoundService.AmbientReverb from Delta settings",

				return soundService and soundService.AmbientReverb and soundService.AmbientReverb.Name

				end
			end,
			{ persist = false }

	if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
		local fpsCapValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		fpsCapValue.Name = "FpsCapValue"
		local fpsSaved = settingsConfig.FpsCap
		local fpsHasSaved = type(fpsSaved) == "table" and type(fpsSaved.value) == "number"
		fpsCapValue.Value = fpsHasSaved and math.clamp(math.floor(fpsSaved.value + 0.5), 30, 999) or 60
		local fpsCapTarget = fpsCapValue.Value
		local function applyFpsCap(v)
			local n = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 60) + 0.5), 30, 999)
			if fpsCapValue.Value ~= n then
				fpsCapValue.Value = n
			end
			fpsCapTarget = n
			pcall(setfpscap, n)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("FpsCap_Enforce")
		local function reapplyFpsCap()
			if fpsCapTarget then
				pcall(setfpscap, fpsCapTarget)
			end
		end
		if UIS and UIS.WindowFocused then
			NAlib.connect("FpsCap_Reapply", UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(reapplyFpsCap))
		end
		makeSizeSlider("FpsCap", "FPS cap", "set your FPS cap to anything you like", fpsCapValue, 1, 999, {
			integer = true,
			apply = applyFpsCap,
		})
		if fpsHasSaved then
			task.defer(function()
				applyFpsCap(fpsCapValue.Value)
			end)
		end
	end

	local sidemenu = execFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidemenu", true)
	if sidemenu then
		local oldCard = sidemenu:FindFirstChild("Script", true)
		if oldCard and oldCard:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			local parent = oldCard.Parent
			local newCard = oldCard:Clone()
			__dcm_setTracked(oldCard, "Parent", nil)
			newCard.Name = "LT_FeaturedScriptCard"
			newCard.Parent = parent
			local labs = {}
			for _, d in newCard:QueryDescendants("TextLabel") do
				table.insert(labs, d)
			end
			if #labs >= 3 then
				table.sort(labs, function(a, b)
					return a.AbsolutePosition.Y < b.AbsolutePosition.Y
				end)
				local bigHeader = labs[1]
				local subTitle = labs[2]
				local desc = labs[3]
				if bigHeader then
					bigHeader.Text = "Featured"
				end
				if subTitle then
					subTitle.Text = "Nameless Admin"
				end
				if desc then
					desc.Text =
						"continuation of Nameless Admin with advanced features, fixed commands and lots of customization."
				end
			end
			local clickable = nil
			for _, d in newCard:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
				if d:IsA("LocalScript") then
					d:Destroy()
				elseif d:IsA("TextButton") then
					clickable = d
				end
			end
			if not clickable then
				clickable = newCard:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
					or newCard:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton", true)
					or newCard

			local function runNA()

				local ok, er = runUrl(
					"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ltseverydayyou/Nameless-Admin/main/Source.lua",
					"@NamelessAdminSource.lua"
				)
				if not ok then
					toast("ScriptHub", tostring(er))
				end

				clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runNA)
			else
				clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						runNA()
					end

		if item then
			pingLabel.RichText = true
			local pingId = "DeltaCustom_Ping"
			NAlib.disconnect(pingId)
			local function updatePing()
				local v = 0
				pcall(function()
					if item.GetValue then
						v = item:GetValue()
					elseif item.Value ~= nil then
						v = item.Value
					end
				end)
				pingLabel.Text = string.format('<font color="#4FA4F2">%d</font> MS Ping', math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0))
			end
			updatePing()
			local pingAccum = 0
			NAlib.connect(
				pingId,
				RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
					pingAccum += dt
					if pingAccum < 0.5 then
						return
					end
					pingAccum = 0
					updatePing()
				end)
			)
		end

		and type(makefolder) == "function"
		and type(isfile) == "function"
		and type(writefile) == "function"
		and type(readfile) == "function"

	local function parseIndex(nm)
		return tonumber(nm:match("^script(%d+)%.lua$"))
	end
	local function isScriptName(nm)
		return parseIndex(nm) ~= nil
	end
	local function getCodeBoxes()
		local t = {}
		for _, c in codeSf:QueryDescendants("TextBox") do
			if isScriptName(c.Name) then				table.insert(t, c)
			end
		end
		table.sort(t, function(a, b)
			return (parseIndex(a.Name) or 0) < (parseIndex(b.Name) or 0)
		end)
		return t
	end
	local function getSavedNames()
		local list = {}
		for _, p in listfiles(tabsDir) do
			local nm = p:match("([^/\\]+)$")
			if nm and isScriptName(nm) then
				table.insert(list, nm)
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return (parseIndex(a) or 0) < (parseIndex(b) or 0)
		end)
		return list
	end
	local saved = getSavedNames()
	local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
	if tabNotifEnabled then
		if #saved > 0 then
			local desc
			if #saved > #boxes then
				desc = "Saved tabs: "
					.. tostring(#saved)
					.. "\nCreate your tabs in Delta and the saved code will load automatically."
			else
				desc = "Saved tabs: "
					.. tostring(#saved)
					.. "\nYour saved code will load into matching tabs automatically."
			end
			notify({ Title = "Delta Customization", Description = desc, Duration = 8 })
		else
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "No saved tabs yet. Anything you type will be saved automatically.",
				Duration = 6,
			})
		end
	end
	local hooked = {}
	local function hookBox(box)
		if not box or hooked[box] then
			return
		end
		hooked[box] = true
		local ready = false
		local function setupForName(nm)
			if ready then
				return
			end
			if not isScriptName(nm) then
				return
			end
			ready = true
			local path = tabsDir .. "/" .. nm
			if isfile(path) then
				local ok, data = pcall(readfile, path)
				if ok and type(data) == "string" then
					box.Text = data
				end
			else
				pcall(writefile, path, box.Text or "")
			end
			local last = 0
			(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text")):Connect(function()
				last = tick()
				local id = last
				task.delay(0.4, function()
					if id ~= last then
						return
					end
					local txt = box.Text
					pcall(writefile, path, txt)
				end)
			end)
		end
		setupForName(box.Name);
		(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name")):Connect(function()
			setupForName(box.Name)
		end)
	end
	for _, b in boxes do
		hookBox(b)
	end
	codeSf.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
			task.wait(0.05)
			hookBox(obj)
		end
	end)
	codeSf.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(obj)
		if not (obj:IsA("TextBox") and isScriptName(obj.Name) and type(delfile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		local txt = ""
		pcall(function()
			txt = obj.Text
		end)
		if type(txt) ~= "string" or txt:match("^%s*$") then
			local path = tabsDir .. "/" .. obj.Name
			if isfile(path) then
				pcall(delfile, path)
			end
		end
	end)
end)


__lt.deltaPatchState = __lt.deltaPatchState or {}
__lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv = __dcm_env
if type(__lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv) == "table" and not __lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv.__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded then
	__lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv.__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded = true
	task.defer(function()
		if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower() ~= "delta" then
			return
		end
		local function S(n)
			local ok, s = pcall(function()
				return __lt.cs(n, cloneref and cloneref or function(v)
					return v
				end)
			end)
			if ok then
				return s
			end
		end
		local HS = S("HttpService")
		local TS = S("TweenService")
		local CG = S("CoreGui")
		local root = gethui and gethui() or CG
		local function isGib(n)
			if typeof(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then
				return false
			end
			return not n:match("^[%w _%-]+$")
		end
		local function getMain()
			for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
				if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and isGib(g.Name) then
					if
						g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true)
						and g:FindFirstChild("Scripthub", true)
						and g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
					then
						return g
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local mainGui = getMain()
		if not mainGui then
			return
		end
		do
			local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			if UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled and (vp.X <= 1100 or vp.Y <= 820) then
				local darkOverlay = mainGui:FindFirstChild("DarkOverlay")
				if darkOverlay then
					pcall(function()
						darkOverlay.Visible = false
						darkOverlay.Active = false
					end)
				end
				return
			end
		end
		local sectionsList = { "Executor", "Home", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" }
		local settingsPath = "DeltaCustom/Settings.json"
		local settingsConfig = {}
		if HS and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(settingsPath) then
			local ok, data = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
			if ok and data then
				local ok2, dec = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", data)
				end)
				if ok2 and type(dec) == "table" then
					settingsConfig = dec
				end
			end
		end
		local function saveCfg(k, t)
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[k] = t
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local darkOverlay = mainGui:FindFirstChild("DarkOverlay")
		NAlib.disconnect("DarkOverlay_Hide")
		local dimFr = darkOverlay
		if not dimFr then
			dimFr = Instance.new("Frame")
			dimFr.Name = "DarkOverlay"
			dimFr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			dimFr.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dimFr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			dimFr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			dimFr.ZIndex = 1
			dimFr.Visible = false
			dimFr.Active = false
			dimFr.Parent = mainGui
		end
		pcall(function()
			dimFr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			dimFr.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dimFr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			dimFr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			dimFr.ZIndex = 1
			dimFr.Active = false
		end)
		local base = { cor = {}, pan = {}, str = {}, got = false }
		local okNm = {
			Sidebar = true,
			Overlay = true,
			Popup = true,
			Searchbar = true,
			Script = true,
			Network = true,
			Information = true,
			RobloxConsole = true,
			RConsole = true,
			Source = true,
			Title = true,
			Executor = true,
			Console = true,
			Home = true,
			Scripthub = true,
			Settings = true,
			Dropdown = true,
			SettingDropdown = true,
			SettingTextbox = true,
			SettingSwitch = true,
			SettingSwitchOn = true,
			Button = true,
			InputText = true,
			LT_ScriptHub = true,
			LT_Music = true,
			Top = true,
			Bottom = true,
			List = true,
			Card = true,
			Card1 = true,
		}
		local skip = {
			Knob = true,
			Hue = true,
			Sat = true,
			Val = true,
			Fill = true,
			DarkOverlay = true,
			SidebarGestureZone = true,
		}
		local function capUi()
			if not mainGui then
				return
			end
			for _, o in mainGui:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
				if o:IsA("UICorner") then
					local p = o.Parent
					if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and not skip[p.Name] then
						local s = p.AbsoluteSize
						if okNm[p.Name] or (s.X >= 44 and s.Y >= 18) then
							if base.cor[o] == nil then
								base.cor[o] = o.CornerRadius
							end
						end
					end
				elseif o:IsA("UIStroke") then
					if base.str[o] == nil then
						base.str[o] = o.Thickness
					end
				elseif
					o:IsA("Frame")
					or o:IsA("ImageLabel")
					or o:IsA("TextBox")
					or o:IsA("TextButton")
					or o:IsA("ImageButton")
					or o:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
				then
					if not skip[o.Name] then
						local s = o.AbsoluteSize
						if okNm[o.Name] or s.X >= 120 or s.Y >= 28 then
							local pr = (o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton")) and "ImageTransparency"
								or "BackgroundTransparency"
							if base.pan[o] == nil then
								base.pan[o] = { pr, o[pr] }
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			base.got = true
		end
		local radVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		radVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiRound) == "table" and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiRound.value or 0, 0, 18)
			or 0
		local panVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		panVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiAlpha) == "table"
				and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiAlpha.value or 0, 0, 0.35)
			or 0
		local stkVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		stkVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiStroke) == "table"
				and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiStroke.value or 1, 0, 2.5)
			or 1
		local dimVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		dimVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiDim) == "table" and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiDim.value or 0.28, 0, 0.65)
			or 0.28
		local dimDesiredVisible = false
		local dimDesiredTransparency = 1
		local dimGuardBusy = false
		local function applyDimState(force)
			if dimGuardBusy then
				return
			end
			dimGuardBusy = true
			pcall(function()
				if force or dimFr.Visible ~= dimDesiredVisible then
					dimFr.Visible = dimDesiredVisible
				end
				if force or math.abs(dimFr.BackgroundTransparency - dimDesiredTransparency) > 0.001 then
					dimFr.BackgroundTransparency = dimDesiredTransparency
				end
				dimFr.Active = false
				if force or dimFr.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.new(0, 0, 0) then
					dimFr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
			end)
			dimGuardBusy = false
		end
		local function syncDimLoop()
			NAlib.disconnect("DeltaCustom_DimGuard")
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaCustom_DimGuard",
				dimFr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					if not dimGuardBusy and dimFr.Visible ~= dimDesiredVisible then
						task.defer(applyDimState, false)
					end
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaCustom_DimGuard",
				dimFr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency"):Connect(function()
					if
						not dimGuardBusy
						and math.abs(dimFr.BackgroundTransparency - dimDesiredTransparency) > 0.001
					then
						task.defer(applyDimState, false)
					end
				end)
			)
		end
		local function apRad()
			capUi()
			local v = math.floor(math.clamp(radVal.Value, 0, 18) + 0.5)
			for o, b in base.cor do
				if o and o.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						o.CornerRadius = UDim.new(b.Scale, math.max(b.Offset, v))
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function apPan()
			capUi()
			local a = math.clamp(panVal.Value, 0, 0.35)
			for o, b in base.pan do
				if o and o.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						o[b[1]] = math.clamp(b[2] + a, 0, 1)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function apStk()
			capUi()
			local m = math.clamp(stkVal.Value, 0, 2.5)
			for o, b in base.str do
				if o and o.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						o.Thickness = b * m
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function uiOpen()
			for _, n in sectionsList do
				local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
				if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") and fr.Visible then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		local function fxSync()
			local on = uiOpen()
			dimDesiredVisible = on and dimVal.Value > 0.01
			dimDesiredTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(dimVal.Value, 0, 0.85)
			applyDimState(true)
			syncDimLoop()
		end
		capUi()
		apRad()
		apPan()
		apStk()
		fxSync()
		radVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			apRad()
			saveCfg("UiRound", { value = math.clamp(radVal.Value, 0, 18) })
		end)
		panVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			apPan()
			saveCfg("UiAlpha", { value = math.clamp(panVal.Value, 0, 0.35) })
		end)
		stkVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			apStk()
			saveCfg("UiStroke", { value = math.clamp(stkVal.Value, 0, 2.5) })
		end)
		dimVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			fxSync()
			saveCfg("UiDim", { value = math.clamp(dimVal.Value, 0, 0.65) })
		end)
		for _, n in sectionsList do
			local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
			if fr and fr.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
				fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(fxSync)
				end)
			end
		end
		local settings = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
		local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		local template
		if holder then
			for _, c in holder:GetChildren() do
				if c:IsA("Frame") and c.Name == "Button" then
					template = c
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if holder and template then
			local function mkDock(fr)
				local d = Instance.new("Frame")
				d.Name = "Dock"
				d.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				d.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0)
				d.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 18)
				d.Parent = fr
				local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
				l.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
				l.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
				l.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
				l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
				l.Parent = d
				return d
			end
			local function mkBox(par)
				local b = Instance.new("TextBox")
				b.Name = "ValueBox"
				b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 18)
				b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0
				b.ClearTextOnFocus = false
				b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
				b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
				b.TextSize = 12
				b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				b.Parent = par
				return b
			end
			local function mkSl(par, w)
				local s = Instance.new("Frame")
				s.Name = "Slider"
				s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				s.Size = UDim2.new(0, w or 150, 0, 18)
				s.Parent = par
				local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
				bar.Name = "Bar"
				bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
				bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
				bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
				bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6)
				bar.Parent = s
				local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
				bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
				bc.Parent = bar
				local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
				fill.Name = "Fill"
				fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
				fill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				fill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
				fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
				fill.Parent = bar
				local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
				fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
				fc.Parent = fill
				local kb = Instance.new("Frame")
				kb.Name = "Knob"
				kb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
				kb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				kb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				kb.BorderSizePixel = 0
				kb.Parent = bar
				local kc = Instance.new("UICorner")
				kc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				kc.Parent = kb
				return s, bar, fill, kb
			end
			local function makeSizeSlider(id, titleText, descText, numValue, minV, maxV)
				local fr = __dcm_registerCustom(template:Clone())
				fr.Parent = holder
				fr.Visible = true
				fr.LayoutOrder = -2
				local tl = fr:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
				local dl = fr:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
				if tl then
					tl.Text = titleText
				end
				if dl then
					dl.Text = descText
				end
				local ob = fr:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
				if ob then
					ob:Destroy()
				end
				local dock = mkDock(fr)
				local vb = mkBox(dock)
				local sl, bar, fill, kb = mkSl(dock, 150)
				local function setVis(v)
					v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
					local a = (v - minV) / (maxV - minV)
					fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
					kb.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
					vb.Text = string.format("%.2f", v)
				end
				local function apply(v)
					v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
					numValue.Value = v
					setVis(v)
					saveCfg(id, { value = v })
				end
				setVis(numValue.Value)
				local drag = false
				local function fromIn(input)
					local rel = 0
					pcall(function()
						rel = (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X
					end)
					rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
					apply(minV + (maxV - minV) * rel)
				end
				bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						drag = true
						fromIn(input)
					end
				end)
				local ui = S("UserInputService")
				if ui then
					ui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
						if
							drag
							and (
								input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
								or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
							)
						then
							fromIn(input)
						end
					end)
					ui.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
						if
							input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
							or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
						then
							drag = false
						end
					end)
				end
				vb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
					local v = tonumber(vb.Text or "")
					if v then
						apply(v)
					else
						setVis(numValue.Value)
					end
				end)
				local function updDock()
					local w = math.clamp(math.floor(fr.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.46), 240, 380)
					dock.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 18)
					local sw = math.clamp(w - 78, 140, 280)
					sl.Size = UDim2.new(0, sw, 0, 18)
				end
				updDock()
				fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(updDock)
				end)
			end
			makeSizeSlider("UiRound", "UI roundness", "Adds extra roundness to panels and cards", radVal, 0, 18)
			makeSizeSlider(
				"UiAlpha",
				"Panel transparency",
				"Makes the heavy panels cleaner and less chunky",
				panVal,
				0,
				0.35
			)
			makeSizeSlider("UiStroke", "Stroke scale", "Scales borders and outlines across Delta", stkVal, 0, 2.5)
			makeSizeSlider("UiDim", "Open dim", "Darkens the game behind Delta while it is open", dimVal, 0, 0.65)
		end
	end)
end


end

do
local __lt = __lt

if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower() ~= "delta" then
	return
end

local env = __dcm_env
if type(env) ~= "table" then
	return
end

if env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch and type(env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch.stop) == "function" then
	pcall(env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch.stop)
end

local ref = cloneref and type(cloneref) == "function" and cloneref or function(v)
	return v
end

local srv = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(t, k)
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			return __lt.cs(k, ref)
		end)
		if ok and v then
			rawset(t, k, v)
			return v
		end
	end,
})

local function S(n)
	return srv[n]
end

local UIS = S("UserInputService")
local TS = S("TweenService")
local RS = S("RunService")
local SS = S("SoundService")
local HS = S("HttpService")
local CG = S("CoreGui")

local root = gethui and gethui() or CG
local rq = request or http_request or syn and syn.request

local st = {
	con = {},
	pg = {},
	snd = nil,
	muted = {},
	gui = nil,
	fn = {},
}

local function con(c)
	if c then
		st.con[#st.con + 1] = c
	end
	return c
end

local function disc()
	for _, c in st.con do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	st.con = {}
end

local function stop()
	disc()
	if st.snd then
		pcall(function()
			st.snd:Destroy()
		end)
		st.snd = nil
	end
	if st.pg.music then
		pcall(function()
			st.pg.music:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	if st.pg.musicButton then
		pcall(function()
			st.pg.musicButton:Destroy()
		end)
		st.pg.musicButton = nil
	end
	if st.pg.sh and st.pg.sh:FindFirstChild("LT_ScriptHub") then
		pcall(function()
			st.pg.sh.LT_ScriptHub:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	for o, v in st.muted do
		if o and o.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				o.Visible = v
			end)
		end
	end
	st.muted = {}
	env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch = nil
end

env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch = {
	stop = stop,
}

local function trim(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then
		return ""
	end
	return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

local function isg(s)
	if typeof(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not s:match("^[%w _%-]+$")
end

local function getMain()
	for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and isg(g.Name) then
			if
				g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true)
				and g:FindFirstChild("Scripthub", true)
				and g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
			then
				return g
			end
		end
	end
end

local gui = getMain()
if not gui then
	return
end
st.gui = gui

local sb = gui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
local sh = gui:FindFirstChild("Scripthub")
local ex = gui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
local hm = gui:FindFirstChild("Home")
local se = gui:FindFirstChild("Settings")
local co = gui:FindFirstChild("Console")

if not (sb and sh) then
	return
end

st.pg.sh = sh

local sec = {
	"Executor",
	"Home",
	"Scripthub",
	"Settings",
	"Console",
	"Music",
}

local musicState = {
	openPos = UDim2.new(0.476246715, 0, 0.508232415, 0),
	closedPos = UDim2.new(0.400000006, 0, 0.508232415, 0),
	frame = nil,
	button = nil,
	tween = nil,
	activeTab = nil,
	icon = {
		sheetUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ltseverydayyou/Nameless-Admin/main/NAimages/sheet.png",
		sheetAsset = nil,
		rectOffset = Vector2.new(371, 806),
		rectSize = Vector2.new(23, 33),
	},
}
local syncTabColors
local function tweenMusic(toPos, show, hideAfter)
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	if musicState.tween then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.tween:Cancel()
		end)
		musicState.tween = nil
	end
	if show then
		musicState.frame.Visible = true
	end
	if TS then
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.frame.Position
		musicState.tween =
			TS:Create(musicState.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = toPos,
			})
		if hideAfter then
			con(musicState.tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if musicState.frame then
					musicState.frame.Visible = false
				end
			end))
		end
		musicState.tween:Play()
	else
		musicState.frame.Position = toPos
		if hideAfter then
			musicState.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function openMusic()
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	musicState.activeTab = "Music"
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p ~= musicState.frame then
			p.Visible = false
		end
	end
	musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
	tweenMusic(musicState.openPos, true, false)
	task.defer(function()
		syncTabColors("Music")
	end)
end

local function closeMusic(anim)
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	if not musicState.frame.Visible then
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
		return
	end
	if anim then
		tweenMusic(musicState.closedPos, false, true)
	else
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
		musicState.frame.Visible = false
	end
end

local function hideAll(exn)
	if exn == "Music" then
		musicState.activeTab = "Music"
		openMusic()
		return
	end
	musicState.activeTab = exn
	closeMusic(true)
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and n ~= "Music" then
			p.Visible = n == exn
		end
	end
	task.defer(function()
		syncTabColors(exn)
	end)
end

local function txtOf(o)
	for _, d in o:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			return d
		end
	end
end

local function gbtn(nm)
	for _, d in sb:QueryDescendants("GuiButton") do
		if d.Name == nm then			return d
		end
	end
end

local sidebarRefs = {
	home = gbtn("Home"),
	scripthub = gbtn("Scripthub"),
	settings = gbtn("Settings"),
	executor = gbtn("Executor"),
	console = gbtn("Console"),
	toggle = gbtn("ToggleUI"),
	activeColor = sb:FindFirstChild("ActiveColor"),
	inactiveColor = sb:FindFirstChild("InactiveColor"),
}

local function imgOf(btn)
	if not btn then
		return nil
	end
	return btn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel")
end

local function improveSidebarTouch(btn)
	if not (btn and btn:IsA("GuiButton") and UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled) then
		return btn
	end
	if btn:GetAttribute("LT_TouchSized") then
		return btn
	end
	btn:SetAttribute("LT_TouchSized", true)
	pcall(function()
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(btn.Size.X.Scale, btn.Size.X.Offset + 8, btn.Size.Y.Scale, btn.Size.Y.Offset + 14)
	end)
	return btn
end

local offBg = sidebarRefs.scripthub and sidebarRefs.scripthub.BackgroundColor3 or Color3.fromRGB(41, 45, 58)
local offImg = imgOf(sidebarRefs.scripthub) and imgOf(sidebarRefs.scripthub).ImageColor3
	or Color3.fromRGB(138, 145, 164)
local onImg = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.home)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.scripthub)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.settings)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.executor)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.console)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.toggle)

local function bgOn()
	return sidebarRefs.activeColor and sidebarRefs.activeColor.Value or col.ac
end

local function bgOff()
	return sidebarRefs.inactiveColor and sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Value or offBg
end

local function applyBtnState(btn, on)
	if not btn then
		return
	end
	local targetBg = on and bgOn() or bgOff()
	local targetImg = on and onImg or offImg
	local img = imgOf(btn)
	if TS then
		pcall(function()
			TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundColor3 = targetBg,
			}):Play()
		end)
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				TS:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					ImageColor3 = targetImg,
				}):Play()
			end)
		end
	else
		pcall(function()
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = targetBg
		end)
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				img.ImageColor3 = targetImg
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function visibleTab()
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.Visible then
			return n
		end
	end
end

function syncTabColors(forceTab)
	local curTab = forceTab or visibleTab()
	local map = {
		Home = sidebarRefs.home,
		Executor = sidebarRefs.executor,
		Scripthub = sidebarRefs.scripthub,
		Settings = sidebarRefs.settings,
		Console = sidebarRefs.console,
		Music = musicState.button,
	}
	for n, b in map do
		applyBtnState(b, curTab == n)
	end
end

local function muteObj(d)
	if not (d and d:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		return
	end
	local keep = false
	if d == sh then
		keep = true
	elseif d:FindFirstAncestor("LT_ScriptHub") then
		keep = true
	end
	if keep then
		return
	end
	if st.muted[d] == nil then
		st.muted[d] = d.Visible
	end
	local master = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime")
	if type(master) == "table" and type(master.setTracked) == "function" then
		master.setTracked(d, "Visible", false)
	else
		pcall(function()
			d.Visible = false
		end)
	end
	if d.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
		con(d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if d.Parent and not d:FindFirstAncestor("LT_ScriptHub") then
				pcall(function()
					d.Visible = false
				end)
			end
		end))
	end
end

local function muteSh()
	for _, d in sh:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
		muteObj(d)
	end
end

local col = {
	bg = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26),
	bg2 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 33, 40),
	cd = Color3.fromRGB(26, 29, 36),
	st = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85),

	su = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153),
	wa = Color3.fromRGB(255, 179, 71),
	er = Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94),

local function mk(class, props, kids)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in props or {} do
		o[k] = v
	end
	for _, c in kids or {} do
		c.Parent = o
	end
	return o
end

local function req(u)
	local body
	local status = 0
	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local ok, r = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = {
				["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
				["Accept"] = "application/json",
			},
		})
		if ok and r then
			body = r.Body or r.body
			status = r.StatusCode or r.Status or r.status_code or 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		local ok2, r2 = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(u)
		end)
		if ok2 and type(r2) == "string" and r2 ~= "" then
			body = r2
			status = 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return nil, status
	end
	local ok3, dec = pcall(function()
		return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", body)
	end)
	if ok3 then
		return dec, status
	end
	return nil, status
end

local SCRIPTBLOX_BASE = "https://scriptblox.com"
local RSCRIPTS_BASE = "https://rscripts.net"
local HAXHELL_BASE = "https://haxhell.com"
local IMAGE_CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustom/ScriptHubImages"
local MUSIC_CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic"
local MUSIC_CFG_PATH = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/_config.json"
local MUSIC_EXTS = {
	mp3 = true,
	ogg = true,
	flac = true,
	wav = true,
}
local musicCfg = {}

local function sanitizeFileName(str)
	return tostring(str or ""):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
end

local function hashString(str)
	local h = 0
	for i = 1, #str do
		h = (h * 31 + string.byte(str, i)) % 4294967296
	end
	return string.format("%08x", h)
end

local function clearImageCache()
	if
		type(isfolder) ~= "function"
		or type(listfiles) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or type(delfile) ~= "function"
	then
		return false
	end
	local okExists, exists = pcall(isfolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okExists or not exists then
		return false
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" and path ~= "" then
			pcall(delfile, path)
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ensureImageFolder()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if ok and ex then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(makefolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR) == true
end

local function ensureMusicFolder()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if ok and ex then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(makefolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR) == true
end

local function getAudioExt(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local clean = path:match("([^?#]+)") or path
	local ext = clean:match("%.([%w]+)$")
	if not ext then
		return nil
	end
	ext = ext:lower()
	return MUSIC_EXTS[ext] and ext or nil
end

local function normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	t = t:gsub(
		"^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$",
		"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%1/%2/%3/%4"
	)
	return t
end

local function deriveAudioFileName(url, ext)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "track"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", ""))
	base = base ~= "" and base or "track"
	return string.format("%s_%s.%s", base, hashString(url), ext)
end

local function resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if type(full) ~= "string" or full == "" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		return nil
	end
	local okAsset, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okAsset and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadMusicCfg()
	if HS and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH) then
		local ok, data = pcall(readfile, MUSIC_CFG_PATH)
		if ok and type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
			local okDec, dec = pcall(function()
				return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", data)
			end)
			if okDec and type(dec) == "table" then
				musicCfg = dec
				return
			end
		end
	end
	musicCfg = {}
end

local function saveMusicCfg()
	if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function" and ensureMusicFolder()) then
		return false
	end
	return writeJsonFile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH, musicCfg)
end

local function scanMusicFiles()
	local list = {}
	if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not ensureMusicFolder() then
		return list
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return list
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" then
			local ext = getAudioExt(path)
			if ext then
				local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)$") or path
				list[#list + 1] = {
					path = path,
					name = name,
					asset = resolveMusicAsset(path),
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return (a.name or ""):lower() < (b.name or ""):lower()
	end)
	return list
end

local function findLocalMusicEntry(query)
	query = trim(query)
	if query == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local lower = query:lower()
	for _, item in scanMusicFiles() do
		local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
		local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
		if lower == nm or lower == base then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local httpGetBinary
local function downloadMusicAsset(url)
	if
		type(getcustomasset) ~= "function"
		or type(writefile) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or not ensureMusicFolder()
	then
		return nil, "Custom music requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local norm = normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	local ext = getAudioExt(norm)
	if not norm or not ext then
		return nil, "Unsupported audio format. Use mp3, ogg, flac, or wav."
	end
	local full = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveAudioFileName(norm, ext)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local data = httpGetBinary(norm)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil, "Failed to download audio."
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil, "Failed to save audio."
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return nil, "Failed to load audio asset."
	end
	return {
		asset = asset,
		name = full:match("([^/\\]+)$") or full,
		path = full,
	}, nil
end

loadMusicCfg()

local function deriveImageFileName(url)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "image"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:match("(.+)%.") or name)
	return string.format("%s_%s.bin", base ~= "" and base or "image", hashString(url))
end

clearImageCache()

local function normalizeImageUrl(url, base)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^rbxassetid://") or t:match("^rbxthumb://") then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^https?://") then
		return t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 2) == "//" then
		return "https:" .. t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return (base or "") .. t
	end
	return base and (base .. "/" .. t) or t
end

local function isMeaningfulImageUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not url:lower():find("no%-script")
end

function httpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end

local function downloadImageAsset(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	if not ensureImageFolder() then
		return nil
	end
	local full = IMAGE_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveImageFileName(url)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local host = url:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
		local hdr
		if host:find("rscripts%.net") then
			hdr = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
		elseif host:find("robloxscripts%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
		elseif host:find("haxhell%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
		elseif host:find("rbxcdn%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://www.roblox.com/" }
		end
		local data = httpGetBinary(url, hdr)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil
		end
	end
	local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, SCRIPTBLOX_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.coverImage,
		d.icon,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.coverImage,
		d.game and d.game.icon,
	})
end

local function resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, RSCRIPTS_BASE)
			if n then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.cover,
		d.banner,
		d.img,
		d.game and d.game.imgurl,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.cover,
		d.game and d.game.banner,
		d.game and d.game.gameLogo,
	})
end

local function resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local media = type(d.media) == "table" and d.media or {}
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or {}
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, HAXHELL_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		media.thumbnailUrl,
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		gameData.thumbnailUrl,
		gameData.iconUrl,
		gameData.imageUrl,
		gameData.image,
	})
end

local function buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	local id = tostring(placeId or "")
	if id == "" or id == "0" then
		return nil
	end
	return "https://www.roblox.com/Thumbs/PlaceThumbnail.ashx?width=420&height=270&format=png&placeId=" .. id
end

local function toast(a, b)
	if type(env.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(env.Notify, {
			Title = a,
			Description = b,
			Duration = 4,
		})
		return
	end
	if type(env.nt) == "function" then
		pcall(env.nt, {
			Title = a,
			Description = b,
			Duration = 4,
		})
	end
end

local eng = "RScripts"
local flt = "all"
local cur = 1
local maxp = 1
local q = ""
local tr = false
local busy = false
local data = {}

local function pass(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	if flt == "all" then
		return true
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		return not k
	else
		return k
	end
end

local function shClr()
	for _, c in list:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function shMsg(t, c3)
	local lb = mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		Text = t,
		TextColor3 = c3 or col.td,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 14,
		Parent = list,
	})
	return lb
end

	return mk("TextButton", {
		BackgroundColor3 = c3,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 28),
		Text = tx,
		TextColor3 = col.tx,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 12,
		Parent = par,
	}, {
		mk("UICorner", {
			CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7),
		}),
	})
end

local function getRw(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", true
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		local source = d.script or ""
		if source ~= "" then
			return source, false
		end
		local url = d.rawScriptUrl or d.scriptLink or d.raw or ""
		return url, url ~= ""
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local links = type(d.links) == "table" and d.links or {}
		local sourceData = type(d.source) == "table" and d.source or {}
		local source = links.raw or sourceData.rawUrl or sourceData.code or d.rawScriptUrl or d.script or ""
		return source, type(source) == "string" and source:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	end
	return d.script or d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", false
end

local function getTi(d)
	return d.title or d.name or "Untitled Script"
end

local function getGa(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.game and d.game.title or "Unknown Game"
	end
	return d.game and d.game.name or "Unknown Game"
end

local function keyReq(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	return k
end

local function getInfo(d)
	local stats = type(d.stats) == "table" and d.stats or {}
	local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
	local v = tostring(d.views or d.viewCount or stats.views or 0)
	local l = tostring(d.likes or d.likeCount or stats.likes or 0)
	local k = keyReq(d) and "Key" or "Keyless"
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		local access = d.accessType:lower()
		if access == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		elseif access == "free" then
			k = "Free"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and flags.isPaid == true then
		k = "Paid"
	end
	local s = eng == "RobloxScripts" and "Published" or (d.isPatched == true or flags.patched == true) and "Patched" or "Working"
	local info = string.format("%s | Views %s | Likes %s | %s", k, v, l, s)
	if eng == "RScripts" and d.discord and d.discord ~= "" then
		info = info .. " | Discord"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and d.author and d.author.verified == true then
		info = info .. " | Verified"
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local verified = flags.verified == true or type(d.author) == "table" and d.author.isScripterVerified == true
		if verified then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if flags.mobileSupported == true then
			info = info .. " | Mobile"
		end
	end
	return info
end
