end

local function mkCard(par, i, d)
	local rw, rwIsUrl = getRw(d)
	local placeId
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.gameId
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		placeId = d.game and (d.game.placeId or d.game.gameLink and d.game.gameLink:match("/games/(%d+)"))
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.placeId or d.placeId
	end
	placeId = tonumber(placeId)

	local bgUrl
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		bgUrl = resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		bgUrl = resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		bgUrl = resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	else
		local candidates = {
			d.image,
			d.imageUrl,
			d.thumbnail,
			d.game and d.game.iconUrl,
			d.game and d.game.image,
		}
		for _, value in candidates do
			local normalized = normalizeImageUrl(value, "https://robloxscripts.com")
			if normalized and isMeaningfulImageUrl(normalized) then
				bgUrl = normalized
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not bgUrl and placeId then
		bgUrl = buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	end
	local bgAsset = bgUrl and downloadImageAsset(bgUrl) or nil
	local bgImg = bgAsset or bgUrl

	local cd = mk("Frame", {
		Name = "Card" .. tostring(i),
		BackgroundColor3 = col.cd,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.333333343, -7, 1, 0),
		LayoutOrder = i,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Parent = par,
	}, {
		mk("UICorner", {
			CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}),
		mk("UIStroke", {
			Color = col.st,
			Transparency = 0.35,
		}),
	})

	if bgImg then
		mk("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "Cover",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Image = bgImg,
			ImageTransparency = 0.1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 0,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
		})
		mk("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 1,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
			mk("UIGradient", {
				Rotation = 90,
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.45),
				}),
			}),
		})
	end

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = col.tx,
		Text = getTi(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 30),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = col.ac,
		Text = getGa(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 50),
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = col.td,
		Text = getInfo(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	local row = mk("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -36),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	}, {
		mk("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		}),
	})

	local run = mkb(row, "Run", col.su)
	run.ZIndex = 3
	local cp = setclipboard and mkb(row, "Copy", Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75)) or nil
	if cp then
		cp.ZIndex = 3
	end
	local dc = eng == "RScripts"
			and d.discord
			and d.discord ~= ""
			and setclipboard
			and mkb(row, "Discord", Color3.fromRGB(28, 116, 224))
		or nil
	if dc then
		dc.ZIndex = 3
	end

	con(run.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local ok, er = pcall(function()
			local ld = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
			if type(ld) ~= "function" then
				error("loadstring unavailable")
			end
			local src = rw
			if rwIsUrl then
				local headers
				if eng == "RScripts" then
					headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
				elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
					headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
				elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
					headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
				end
				local got, gotEr = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				if type(got) ~= "string" or got == "" then
					error(gotEr or "empty script source")
				end
				src = got
			end
			if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then
				error("script source must be a string, got " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(src) or type(src)))
			end
			local fn, cer = ld(src, "@ScriptHubEntry")
			if type(fn) ~= "function" then
				error(cer or "compile failed")
			end
			if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
				pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, fn, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
			end
			fn()
		end)
		if ok then
			toast("ScriptHub", "Executed script.")
		else
			toast("ScriptHub", tostring(er))
		end
	end))

	if cp then
		con(cp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				local src = rw
				if rwIsUrl then
					local headers
					if eng == "RScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
					elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
					elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
						headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
					end
					src = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				end
				if type(src) == "string" and src ~= "" then
					setclipboard(src)
				end
			end)
			cp.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if cp and cp.Parent then
					cp.Text = "Copy"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end

	if dc then
		con(dc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				setclipboard(d.discord)
			end)
			dc.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if dc and dc.Parent then
					dc.Text = "Discord"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end
end

local function ren()
	shClr()
	pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
	if not data or #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	local row
	local coln = 0
	for _, d in data do
		if pass(d) then
			if not row or coln >= 3 then
				row = mkRow()
				coln = 0
			end
			n += 1
			coln += 1
			mkCard(row, n, d)
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then
		if flt == "keyless" then
			shMsg("No keyless scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		elseif flt == "key" then
			shMsg("No key-required scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		else
			shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		end
	end
end

local function setBusy(v)
	busy = v and true or false
	gob.Active = not busy
	prev.Active = not busy
	nextb.Active = not busy
	gob.Text = busy and "Loading" or "Search"
end

local function fetch(q2, tr2, p2)
	if busy then
		return
	end
	clearImageCache()
	q2 = trim(q2 or "")
	tr2 = eng == "ScriptBlox" and tr2 == true or false
	p2 = math.max(tonumber(p2) or 1, 1)
	q = q2
	tr = tr2
	cur = p2
	maxp = 1
	data = {}
	setBusy(true)
	shClr()
	shMsg("Loading...", col.td)
	local requestQuery = q2
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and #requestQuery > 100 then
		requestQuery = requestQuery:sub(1, 100)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and requestQuery ~= "" and #requestQuery < 2 then
		shClr()
		shMsg("HaxHell search requires at least 2 characters", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local enc = __lt.cm("HttpService", "UrlEncode", requestQuery)
	local u
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		u = string.format("https://rscripts.net/api/v2/scripts?page=%d&orderBy=date&sort=desc", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		p2 = math.min(p2, 200)
		cur = p2
		u = string.format("https://robloxscripts.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=newest", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/search/scripts?q=%s&page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif tr2 then
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/fetch?page=%d", p2)
	else
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/search?q=%s&page=%d", enc, p2)
	end
	local dec, status = req(u)
	shClr()
	if status == 429 then
		shMsg("Rate limit reached. Try again shortly", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status == 503 then
		shMsg("API temporarily unavailable", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status ~= 0 and (status < 200 or status >= 300) then
		shMsg("Request failed (" .. tostring(status) .. ")", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif not dec then
		shMsg("Request failed", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local arr
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		arr = dec.scripts
		maxp = math.max(dec.info and dec.info.maxPages or 1, 1)
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		maxp = math.min(math.max(pages or 1, 1), 200)
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
		if not pages then
			pages = pg.hasMore == true and (cur + 1) or cur
		end
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
	else
		local r = dec.result or {}
		arr = r.scripts
		maxp = math.max(r.totalPages or 1, 1)
	end
	data = arr or {}
	if #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	ren()
	setBusy(false)
end

con(engb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		eng = "RScripts"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 58)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (rscripts.net)"
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		eng = "RobloxScripts"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 52, 68)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (robloxscripts.com)"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		eng = "HaxHell"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 42, 74)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (haxhell.com)"
	else
		eng = "ScriptBlox"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = col.bg
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (scriptblox.com)"
	end
	engb.Text = "Engine: " .. eng
	toast("ScriptHub", "Switched to " .. eng)
	data = {}
	cur = 1
	maxp = 1
	pgt.Text = "Page 1 / 1"
	shClr()
	shMsg("Press Search to load scripts", col.td)
end))

con(fltb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if flt == "all" then
		flt = "keyless"
		fltb.Text = "Keyless"
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		flt = "key"
		fltb.Text = "Key"
	else
		flt = "all"
		fltb.Text = "All"
	end
	ren()
end))

con(gob.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local t = trim(sbox.Text)
	if t ~= "" then
		fetch(t, false, 1)
	else
		if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
			fetch("", true, 1)
		else
			fetch("", false, 1)
		end
	end
end))

con(sbox.FocusLost:Connect(function(ent)
	if ent then
		local t = trim(sbox.Text)
		if t ~= "" then
			fetch(t, false, 1)
		else
			if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
				fetch("", true, 1)
			else
				fetch("", false, 1)
			end
		end
	end
end))

con(prev.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if busy then
		return
	end
	if cur > 1 then
		fetch(q, tr, cur - 1)
	end
end))

con(nextb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if busy then
		return
	end
	if cur < maxp then
		fetch(q, tr, cur + 1)
	end
end))

shClr()
shMsg("Press Search to load scripts", col.td)
con(sh.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	muteObj(d)
end))

local function buildMusicTab()
	musicState.frame = gui:FindFirstChild("Music")
	if musicState.frame then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.frame:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	local tpl = sh or hm or se or ex or co
	if tpl and tpl:IsA("GuiObject") then
		musicState.frame = tpl:Clone()
		musicState.frame.Name = "Music"
		musicState.frame.Visible = false
		musicState.frame.Parent = gui
		pcall(function()
			musicState.frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
			musicState.frame.Size = sh.Size
			musicState.frame.ZIndex = sh.ZIndex
		end)
		for _, d in musicState.frame:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
			if d:IsA("LocalScript") then
				d:Destroy()
			elseif d:IsA("GuiObject") and d ~= musicState.frame then
				pcall(function()
					d.Visible = false
				end)
			end
		end
	else
		musicState.frame = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Music",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = musicState.closedPos,
			Size = sh and sh.Size or UDim2.new(0.848344803, 0, 0.892481446, 0),
			Visible = false,
			Parent = gui,
			ZIndex = sh and sh.ZIndex or 100,
		})
	end

	st.pg.music = musicState.frame

	local mr = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "LT_Music",
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,

		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 590),
		ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
		HorizontalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar,

		mk("UIStroke", {
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),

		}),

	local localPicker
	local function relayoutMusic(extra)
		extra = math.max(0, tonumber(extra) or 0)
		inputCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, inputBaseHeight + extra)
		controlCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, controlBaseY + extra)
		mixCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, mixBaseY + extra)
		mr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, canvasBaseHeight + extra)
	end

	local function syncLocalPicker(raw)
		if not localPicker then
			return
		end
		local entry = raw and findLocalMusicEntry(raw) or nil
		if entry and entry.name then
			localPicker.setText(entry.name)
		else
			localPicker.setText("")
		end
	end

	local savedVol = tonumber(musicCfg.volume)
	if savedVol and savedVol >= 0 and savedVol <= 1 then
		savedVol *= 10
	end
	local vl = math.clamp(savedVol or 1, 0, 10)
	local spd = math.clamp(tonumber(musicCfg.playbackSpeed) or 1, 0.5, 2)
	local mixSaveStamp = 0
	local mixReady = false
	local function queueMixSave()
		if not mixReady then
			return
		end
		mixSaveStamp += 1
		local cur = mixSaveStamp
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if cur ~= mixSaveStamp then
				return
			end
			musicCfg.volume = vl
			musicCfg.playbackSpeed = spd
			saveMusicCfg()
		end)
	end
	local function formatTime(sec)
		sec = tonumber(sec) or 0
		if sec < 0 or sec ~= sec or sec == math.huge then
			sec = 0
		end
		local total = math.floor(sec + 0.5)
		local m = math.floor(total / 60)
		local s = total % 60
		return string.format("%02d:%02d", m, s)
	end

	local function setStatusText(text, accent)
		stat.Text = text
		heroStatus.Text = string.upper(text)
		if accent then
			heroStatus.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			heroStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 250)
		else
			heroStatus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 42)
			heroStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(199, 208, 221)
		end
	end

	local function setProgress(alpha, pos, len)
		alpha = math.clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
		pfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		pkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		progressInfo.Text = string.format("%s / %s", formatTime(pos or 0), formatTime(len or 0))
	end

	local function syncLoopButton()
		local on = st.snd and st.snd.Looped
		loopb.Text = on and "Loop On" or "Loop Off"
		loopb.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(45, 93, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 61)
	end
	local function syncPauseButtons()
		local paused = st.musicPaused and st.snd ~= nil
		pauseb.Visible = not paused
		resumeb.Visible = paused
	end
	local function syncCycleButton()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode == "order" then
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Order"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 93, 73)
		elseif mode == "random" then
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Random"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 74, 112)
		else
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Off"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 61)
		end
	end
	local function getNextCycleTrack()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode ~= "order" and mode ~= "random" then
			return nil
		end
		local items = scanMusicFiles()
		if #items == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local currentRaw = trim(st.musicRaw or "")
		if currentRaw == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local currentLower = currentRaw:lower()
		local currentIndex
		for i, item in items do
			local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
			local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
			if currentLower == nm or currentLower == base then
				currentIndex = i
				break
			end
		end
		if not currentIndex then
			return nil
		end
		if mode == "random" then
			if #items == 1 then
				return items[1]
			end
			local idx = currentIndex
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				idx = math.random(1, #items)
				if idx ~= currentIndex then
					break
				end
			end
			if idx == currentIndex then
				idx = (currentIndex % #items) + 1
			end
			return items[idx]
		end
		return items[(currentIndex % #items) + 1]
	end

	local function apVol(v)
		vl = math.clamp(v, 0, 10)
		local alpha = vl / 10
		vfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		vkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		vt.Text = string.format("Volume  %.2f", vl)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.Volume = vl
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	local function apSpeed(v)
		spd = math.clamp(v, 0.5, 2)
		local alpha = (spd - 0.5) / 1.5
		sfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		skn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		spLabel.Text = string.format("Playback speed  %.2fx", spd)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	apVol(vl)
	apSpeed(spd)
	st.musicPaused = false
	st.musicCycleMode = st.musicCycleMode or "off"
	mixReady = true
	setStatusText("Stopped")
	setProgress(0, 0, 0)
	relayoutMusic(0)
	syncPauseButtons()
	syncCycleButton()

	local dragging = false
	local speedDragging = false
	local progressDragging = false

	local function setBar(inp)
		local x = (inp.Position.X - vbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(vbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		apVol(math.clamp(x, 0, 1) * 10)
	end

	local function setSpeedBar(inp)
		local x = (inp.Position.X - sbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(sbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		apSpeed(0.5 + math.clamp(x, 0, 1) * 1.5)
	end

	local function setProgressBar(inp)
		if not (st.snd and st.snd.TimeLength and st.snd.TimeLength > 0) then
			return
		end
		local x = (inp.Position.X - pbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(pbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
		local len = st.snd.TimeLength
		local pos = len * x
		pcall(function()
			st.snd.TimePosition = pos
		end)
		setProgress(x, pos, len)
	end

	con(vbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			setBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(sbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			speedDragging = true
			setSpeedBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(pbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			progressDragging = true
			setProgressBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if
			dragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setBar(inp)
		end
		if
			speedDragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setSpeedBar(inp)
		end
		if
			progressDragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setProgressBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
			speedDragging = false
			progressDragging = false
		end
	end))

	if RS then
		con(RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local snd = st.snd
			if not snd then
				return
			end
			local len = snd.TimeLength or 0
			local pos = snd.TimePosition or 0
			local alpha = 0
			if len > 0 then
				alpha = math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1)
			end
			if not progressDragging then
				setProgress(alpha, pos, len)
			end
		end))
	end

	local function getId(t)
		t = trim(t)
		if t == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local n = t:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or t:match("id=(%d+)") or t:match("^(%d+)$")
		if n then
			return "rbxassetid://" .. n, n
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function mkSnd(id, raw)
		if st.snd then
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.Name = "LT_MusicSound"
		s.SoundId = id
		s.Volume = vl
		s.Looped = false
		s.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		s.Parent = gui
		local function clearSoundGroup()
			if not (s and s.Parent) then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if s.SoundGroup ~= nil then
					s.SoundGroup = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		clearSoundGroup()
		st.snd = s
		st.musicPaused = false
		st.musicRaw = tostring(raw)
		now.Text = tostring(raw)
		assetChip.Text = tostring(raw)
		setStatusText("Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(53, 83, 125))
		setProgress(0, 0, 0)
		syncLoopButton()
		syncPauseButtons()
		con(s.Loaded:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(53, 83, 125))
			setProgress(0, s.TimePosition or 0, s.TimeLength or 0)
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Ended:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Ended", Color3.fromRGB(88, 64, 48))
			syncPauseButtons()
			local nextTrack = getNextCycleTrack()
			if nextTrack and nextTrack.asset then
				task.defer(function()
					if st.snd ~= s then
						return
					end
					mb.Text = nextTrack.name or ""
					mkSnd(nextTrack.asset, nextTrack.name)
					syncLocalPicker(nextTrack.name)
					if st.snd then
						pcall(function()
							st.snd:Play()
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
		end))
		con(s.Played:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Playing", Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153))
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Paused:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = true
			setStatusText("Paused", Color3.fromRGB(92, 105, 123))
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Stopped:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Stopped")
			setProgress(0, 0, s.TimeLength or 0)
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundGroup"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(clearSoundGroup)
		end))
	end

	local function resolveTrackInput(text)
		local q = trim(text)
		if q == "" then
			return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
		end
		local localEntry = findLocalMusicEntry(q)
		if localEntry and localEntry.asset then
			return localEntry.asset, localEntry.name
		end
		local sid, raw = getId(q)
		if sid then
			return sid, raw
		end
		if q:match("^https?://") or q:match("^www%.") then
			local entry, err = downloadMusicAsset(q:match("^www%.") and ("https://" .. q) or q)
			if not entry then
				return nil, nil, err or "Failed to download audio."
			end
			return entry.asset, entry.name
		end
		if getAudioExt(q) then
			return nil, nil, "Local track not found in DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic."
		end
		return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
	end

	local loadCurrentTrack
	localPicker = makeMusicFolderDropdown(inputCard, 74, 53, function(item)
		mb.Text = item.name or ""
		task.defer(function()
			if loadCurrentTrack then
				loadCurrentTrack()
			end
		end)
	end, function(open, menuHeight)
		relayoutMusic(open and (menuHeight + 10) or 0)
	end)

	function loadCurrentTrack()
		if localPicker then
			localPicker.close()
		end
		local sid, raw, err = resolveTrackInput(mb.Text)
		if not sid then
			toast("Music", err or "Enter a valid track.")
			return false
		end
		mkSnd(sid, raw)
		syncLocalPicker(raw)
		toast("Music", "Loaded audio.")
		return true
	end

	con(loadb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(loadCurrentTrack))

	con(mb.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		if enter then
			loadCurrentTrack()
		end
	end))

	con(playb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Play()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(pauseb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = true
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Pause()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(resumeb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				st.snd:Resume()
			end)
			if not ok then
				pcall(function()
					st.snd:Play()
				end)
			end
		end
	end))

	con(stopb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Stop()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(loopb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not st.snd then
			return
		end
		st.snd.Looped = not st.snd.Looped
		syncLoopButton()
	end))
	con(cycleb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode == "off" then
			st.musicCycleMode = "order"
		elseif mode == "order" then
			st.musicCycleMode = "random"
		else
			st.musicCycleMode = "off"
		end
		syncCycleButton()
	end))
end

musicState.setupSidebar = function()
	musicState.icon.sheetAsset = downloadImageAsset(musicState.icon.sheetUrl)

	musicState.button = gbtn("Music")
	if musicState.button then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.button:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	musicState.sourceButton = sidebarRefs.console
		or sidebarRefs.scripthub
		or sidebarRefs.home
		or sidebarRefs.settings
		or sidebarRefs.executor
	if musicState.sourceButton then
		musicState.button = musicState.sourceButton:Clone()
		musicState.button.Name = "Music"
		musicState.button.Parent = musicState.sourceButton.Parent
		st.pg.musicButton = musicState.button
		musicState.textLabel = txtOf(musicState.button)
		if musicState.textLabel then
			musicState.textLabel.Text = "Music"
		end
		pcall(function()
			if sidebarRefs.toggle and sidebarRefs.toggle:IsA("GuiButton") then
				local to = sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 999
				for _, d in sb:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= musicState.button and d.LayoutOrder and d.LayoutOrder >= to then
						d.LayoutOrder += 1
					end
				end
				musicState.button.LayoutOrder = to
			else
				local lo = 0
				for _, d in sb:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= musicState.button then
						lo = math.max(lo, d.LayoutOrder or 0)
					end
				end
				musicState.button.LayoutOrder = lo + 1
			end
		end)
		musicState.imageLabel = imgOf(musicState.button)
		if musicState.imageLabel then
			pcall(function()
				if musicState.icon.sheetAsset then
					musicState.imageLabel.Image = musicState.icon.sheetAsset
					musicState.imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = musicState.icon.rectOffset
					musicState.imageLabel.ImageRectSize = musicState.icon.rectSize
					musicState.imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
				end
				musicState.imageLabel.ImageColor3 = offImg
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			musicState.button.BackgroundColor3 = bgOff()
		end)
	end

	musicState.placeButton = function()
		if not (musicState.button and sidebarRefs.toggle and musicState.button.Parent == sidebarRefs.toggle.Parent) then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			if sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS") == nil then
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Scale)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYS", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Scale)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Offset)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigLay", sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end
			local op = UDim2.new(
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Scale,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYS") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Scale,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYO") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Offset
			)
			sidebarRefs.toggle.Position = op
			local togLo = sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigLay") or sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 0
			sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder = togLo
			local above
			local ay = -math.huge
			local ty = op.Y.Scale + op.Y.Offset / 100000
			for _, d in sidebarRefs.toggle.Parent:GetChildren() do
				if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= sidebarRefs.toggle and d ~= musicState.button then
					local py = d.Position.Y.Scale + d.Position.Y.Offset / 100000
					if py < ty and py > ay then
						ay = py
						above = d
					end
				end
			end
			local gapS = 0.11
			local gapO = 0
			if above then
				gapS = op.Y.Scale - above.Position.Y.Scale
				gapO = op.Y.Offset - above.Position.Y.Offset
			end
			musicState.button.Position = op
			musicState.button.LayoutOrder = togLo - 1
			sidebarRefs.toggle.Position = UDim2.new(op.X.Scale, op.X.Offset, op.Y.Scale + gapS, op.Y.Offset + gapO)
			sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder = togLo + 1
		end)
	end

	musicState.placeButton()

	musicState.bindHide = function(b, nm)
		improveSidebarTouch(b)
		if b and b:IsA("GuiButton") then
			con(b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				closeMusic(true)
				task.defer(function()
					syncTabColors(nm or b.Name)
				end)
			end))
		end
	end

	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.home, "Home")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.scripthub, "Scripthub")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.settings, "Settings")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.executor, "Executor")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.console, "Console")

	improveSidebarTouch(musicState.button)
	if musicState.button and musicState.button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		con(musicState.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			openMusic()
			task.defer(function()
				syncTabColors("Music")
			end)
		end))
	end

	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			con(p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(syncTabColors)
			end))
		end
	end

	if sidebarRefs.activeColor and sidebarRefs.activeColor.Changed then
		con(sidebarRefs.activeColor.Changed:Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncTabColors)
		end))
	end

	if sidebarRefs.inactiveColor and sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Changed then
		con(sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Changed:Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncTabColors)
		end))
	end

	task.defer(syncTabColors)
end

musicState.setupSidebar()
end

do
	local previousThemeRuntime = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime")
	if type(previousThemeRuntime) == "table" and type(previousThemeRuntime.stop) == "function" then
		pcall(previousThemeRuntime.stop)
	end
	if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower() == "delta" then
		task.defer(function()
			local themeRuntime = {
				alive = true,
				connections = {},
				baseBackground = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseText = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseStroke = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseImage = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			}
			__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeRuntime = themeRuntime
			local function connectTheme(signal, callback)
				if not signal then
					return
				end
				local ok, connection = pcall(function()
					return signal:Connect(callback)
				end)
				if ok and connection then
					table.insert(themeRuntime.connections, connection)
				end
			end
			local function getThemeRoot()
				local service = cloneref and cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui")) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
				return gethui and gethui() or service
			end
			local function findMainGui()
				local rootGui = getThemeRoot()
				for _, gui in rootGui:GetChildren() do
					if
						gui:IsA("ScreenGui")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Settings")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
					then
						return gui
					end
				end
			end
			local mainGui = findMainGui()
			local attempts = 0
			while themeRuntime.alive and not mainGui and attempts < 100 do
				attempts += 1
				task.wait(0.1)
				mainGui = findMainGui()
			end
			if not (themeRuntime.alive and mainGui) then
				return
			end
			local settingsPath = "DeltaCustom/Settings.json"
			local function readThemeConfig()
				if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(settingsPath) then
					return {}
				end
				local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
				if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then
					return {}
				end
				local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
				end)
				return decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded or {}
			end
			local function saveTheme(name)
				local config = readThemeConfig()
				config.DeltaTheme = { name = name }
				writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
			end
			local function capture(object)
				if not object then
					return
				end
				if
					object:IsA("Frame")
					or object:IsA("ImageLabel")
					or object:IsA("ImageButton")
					or object:IsA("TextButton")
					or object:IsA("TextBox")
					or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
				then
					if themeRuntime.baseBackground[object] == nil then
						themeRuntime.baseBackground[object] = object.BackgroundColor3
					end
				end
				if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
					if themeRuntime.baseText[object] == nil then
						themeRuntime.baseText[object] = object.TextColor3
					end
				end
				if object:IsA("UIStroke") and themeRuntime.baseStroke[object] == nil then
					themeRuntime.baseStroke[object] = object.Color
				end
				if (object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton")) and themeRuntime.baseImage[object] == nil then
					themeRuntime.baseImage[object] = object.ImageColor3
				end
			end
			capture(mainGui)
			for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
				capture(object)
			end
			local palettes = {
				Light = {
					root = Color3.fromRGB(242, 244, 248),
					panel = Color3.fromRGB(229, 232, 239),
					card = Color3.fromRGB(216, 221, 230),
					card2 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 211, 221),
					text = Color3.fromRGB(27, 33, 44),
					muted = Color3.fromRGB(91, 101, 118),
					stroke = Color3.fromRGB(178, 188, 204),
					icon = Color3.fromRGB(69, 79, 96),
					accent = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				},
				Amoled = {
					root = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
					panel = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 7),
					card = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 13),
					card2 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19),
					text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 247, 250),
					muted = Color3.fromRGB(143, 150, 162),
					stroke = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 36),
					icon = Color3.fromRGB(224, 229, 236),
					accent = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				},
			}
			local function isAccent(color)
				local hue, saturation, value = Color3.toHSV(color)
				return saturation >= 0.34 and value >= 0.28 and hue >= 0.48 and hue <= 0.72
			end
			local function isControlColorPart(object)
				local current = object
				while current and current ~= mainGui do
					local name = current.Name
					if
						name == "Hue"
						or name == "Sat"
						or name == "Val"
						or name == "Knob"
						or name == "ColorSlider"
						or name == "ColorValue"
					then
						return true
					end
					current = current.Parent
				end
				return false
			end
			local function backgroundRole(object, palette)
				local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
				if name == "darkoverlay" then
					return Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				if
					name:find("overlay")
					or name == "settings"
					or name == "executor"
					or name == "home"
					or name == "scripthub"
					or name == "console"
					or name == "music"
				then
					return palette.root
				end
				if
					name:find("button")
					or name:find("tab")
					or name:find("card")
					or name:find("script")
					or name:find("network")
					or name:find("search")
					or name:find("dropdown")
					or name:find("setting")
				then
					return palette.card
				end
				if object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
					return palette.card2
				end
				return palette.panel
			end
			local function restoreObject(object)
				local background = themeRuntime.baseBackground[object]
				if background ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.BackgroundColor3 = background
					end)
				end
				local textColor = themeRuntime.baseText[object]
				if textColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.TextColor3 = textColor
					end)
				end
				local strokeColor = themeRuntime.baseStroke[object]
				if strokeColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = strokeColor
					end)
				end
				local imageColor = themeRuntime.baseImage[object]
				if imageColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.ImageColor3 = imageColor
					end)
				end
			end
			local function applyObject(object, themeName)
				if object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay") then
					return
				end
				capture(object)
				if themeName == "Default" then
					restoreObject(object)
					return
				end
				local palette = palettes[themeName]
				if not palette or isControlColorPart(object) then
					return
				end
				local background = themeRuntime.baseBackground[object]
				if background ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						object.BackgroundColor3 = isAccent(background) and background or backgroundRole(object, palette)
					end)
				end
				local textColor = themeRuntime.baseText[object]
				if textColor ~= nil then
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					pcall(function()
						object.TextColor3 = isAccent(textColor) and textColor
							or ((name == "desc" or name:find("description") or name:find("placeholder")) and palette.muted or palette.text)
					end)
				end
				local strokeColor = themeRuntime.baseStroke[object]
				if strokeColor ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = isAccent(strokeColor) and strokeColor or palette.stroke
					end)
				end
				local imageColor = themeRuntime.baseImage[object]
				if imageColor ~= nil then
					local _, saturation = Color3.toHSV(imageColor)
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					if saturation <= 0.28 or name == "checked" or name:find("icon") or name == "imagebutton" then
						pcall(function()
							object.ImageColor3 = isAccent(imageColor) and imageColor or (name == "checked" and palette.accent or palette.icon)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			local function getThemeDropdown()
				local executor = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
				local image = executor and executor:FindFirstChild("Executor")
				local overlay = image and image:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
				local menu = overlay and overlay:FindFirstChild("Menu", true)
				return menu and menu:FindFirstChild("Dropdown")
			end
			local themeMap = { Option1 = "Default", Option2 = "Light", Option3 = "Amoled" }
			local function syncChecks(themeName)
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				for optionName, name in themeMap do
					local option = dropdown and dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName)
					local checked = option and option:FindFirstChild("Checked", true)
					if checked and checked:IsA("GuiObject") then
						checked.Visible = name == themeName
					end
				end
			end
			local currentTheme = "Default"
			local applying = false
			local function applyTheme(themeName, persist)
				if applying or not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				themeName = themeName == "Light" and "Light" or themeName == "Amoled" and "Amoled" or "Default"
				applying = true
				currentTheme = themeName
				applyObject(mainGui, themeName)
				for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
					applyObject(object, themeName)
				end
				syncChecks(themeName)
				if persist then
					saveTheme(themeName)
				end
				applying = false
			end
			themeRuntime.applyTheme = applyTheme
			themeRuntime.stop = function()
				if not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				if currentTheme ~= "Default" then
					applyTheme("Default", false)
				end
				themeRuntime.alive = false
				for i = #themeRuntime.connections, 1, -1 do
					pcall(function()
						themeRuntime.connections[i]:Disconnect()
					end)
				end
				table.clear(themeRuntime.connections)
				if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime") == themeRuntime then
					__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeRuntime = nil
				end
			end
			local boundOptions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local function bindOption(option, themeName)
				if not (option and option:IsA("GuiButton")) or boundOptions[option] then
					return
				end
				boundOptions[option] = true
				local locked = false
				local function choose()
					if locked then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					task.defer(applyTheme, themeName, true)
					task.delay(0.12, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connectTheme(option.MouseButton1Click, choose)
				connectTheme(option.Activated, choose)
				connectTheme(option.TouchTap, choose)
			end
			local function bindThemeOptions()
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				if not dropdown then
					return
				end
				for optionName, themeName in themeMap do
					bindOption(dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName), themeName)
				end
			end
			bindThemeOptions()
			connectTheme(mainGui.DescendantAdded, function(object)
				task.defer(function()
					if not (themeRuntime.alive and object and object.Parent) then
						return
					end
					capture(object)
					if object:IsA("GuiObject") or object:IsA("UIStroke") then
						applyObject(object, currentTheme)
					end
					if object:IsA("GuiButton") and themeMap[object.Name] and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "Dropdown" then
						bindOption(object, themeMap[object.Name])
					end
				end)
			end)
			local config = readThemeConfig()
			local savedTheme = type(config.DeltaTheme) == "table" and config.DeltaTheme.name or nil
			applyTheme(savedTheme, false)
		end)
	end
end

do
	local previous = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime")
	if type(previous) == "table" and type(previous.stop) == "function" then
		pcall(previous.stop)
	end

	local runtime = {
		alive = true,
		version = "2.5.5",
		connections = {},
		instances = {},
		originalButtons = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		restorers = {},
	}
	__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = runtime
	__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = runtime

	local function addConnection(connection)
		if connection then
			table.insert(runtime.connections, connection)
		end
		return connection
	end

	local function connect(signal, callback)
		if not signal then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, connection = pcall(function()
			return signal:Connect(callback)
		end)
		if ok then
			return addConnection(connection)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function addRestorer(callback)
		if type(callback) == "function" then
			table.insert(runtime.restorers, callback)
		end
	end

	local function track(instance)
		if instance then
			table.insert(runtime.instances, instance)
		end
		return instance
	end

	local function restoreOriginalButtons()
		for button, wasVisible in runtime.originalButtons do
			if button and button.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					local nativeVisible = button:GetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible")
					button.Visible = typeof(nativeVisible) == "boolean" and nativeVisible or wasVisible
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(runtime.originalButtons)
	end

	runtime.stop = function()
		if not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		runtime.alive = false
		restoreOriginalButtons()
		for i = #runtime.restorers, 1, -1 do
			pcall(runtime.restorers[i])
		end
		table.clear(runtime.restorers)
		for name in _naConns do
			NAlib.disconnect(name)
		end
		for i = #runtime.connections, 1, -1 do
			local connection = runtime.connections[i]
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(runtime.connections)
		for i = #runtime.instances, 1, -1 do
			local instance = runtime.instances[i]
			if instance and instance.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					instance:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(runtime.instances)
		if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime") == runtime then
			__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = nil
		end
		if rawget(__dcm_shared, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime") == runtime then
			__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = nil
		end
	end

	NAlib.disconnect("FpsCap_Enforce")

	local function findMainGui()
		local best
		local bestScore = 0
		for _, gui in root:GetChildren() do
			if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local score = 0
				for _, name in { "Executor", "Sidebar", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Home", "Console" } do
					if gui:FindFirstChild(name) then
						score += (name == "Executor" or name == "Sidebar") and 4 or 2
					elseif gui:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
						score += 1
					end
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					best = gui
					bestScore = score
				end
			end
		end
		if bestScore >= 10 then
			return best
		end
	end

	local v2Main = findMainGui()
	local attempts = 0
	while runtime.alive and not v2Main and attempts < 80 do
		attempts += 1
		task.wait(0.1)
		v2Main = findMainGui()
	end
	if not (runtime.alive and v2Main) then
		return
	end

	local executorRoot = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Executor") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Executor", true)
	local executorImage = executorRoot and executorRoot:FindFirstChild("Executor")
	local executorOverlay = executorImage and executorImage:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
	local tabsFrame = executorOverlay and executorOverlay:FindFirstChild("Tabs", true)
	local codeFrame = executorOverlay and executorOverlay:FindFirstChild("Code", true)
	local buttonsFrame = executorOverlay and executorOverlay:FindFirstChild("Buttons", true)
	if not (executorOverlay and tabsFrame and codeFrame and buttonsFrame) then
		return
	end

	for _, object in codeFrame:GetChildren() do
		if object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay") or object.Name:match("^LT_Syntax_") then
			object:Destroy()
		elseif object:IsA("TextBox") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
			local originalTransparency = object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency")
			local originalZ = object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex")
			object.TextTransparency = typeof(originalTransparency) == "number" and originalTransparency or 0
			object.ZIndex = typeof(originalZ) == "number" and originalZ or 1
			object:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency", nil)
			object:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex", nil)
		end
	end
	local staleToolbar = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("LT_EditorToolbar")
	if staleToolbar then
		staleToolbar:Destroy()
	end
	for _, name in { "Execute", "Clear", "ExecuteClipboard" } do
		local button = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			button:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
			button.Visible = true
		end
	end
	buttonsFrame.Visible = true

	local function readCurrentConfig()
		local config = {}
		if
			type(isfile) == "function"
			and type(readfile) == "function"
			and isfile(settingsPath)
		then
			local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
			if ok and type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
				local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
				end)
				if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" then
					config = decoded
				end
			end
		end
		return config
	end

	local function readBool(key, defaultValue)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		local value = config[key]
		if type(value) == "table" and value.enabled ~= nil then
			return value.enabled and true or false
		end
		return defaultValue
	end

	local function saveBool(key, enabled)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		config[key] = { enabled = enabled and true or false }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
	end

	local function readNumber(key, defaultValue, minimum, maximum)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		local value = config[key]
		local number = type(value) == "table" and tonumber(value.value) or nil
		return math.clamp(number or defaultValue, minimum, maximum)
	end

	local function saveNumber(key, value)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		config[key] = { value = value }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
	end

	do
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		if config.UiBlur ~= nil or config.UiBlurSize ~= nil then
			config.UiBlur = nil
			config.UiBlurSize = nil
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
		end
	end

	local autoRestoreEnabled = readBool("AutoRestoreTabs", true)
	local editorToolbarEnabled = readBool("EditorToolbar", true)
	local editorStatusEnabled = readBool("EditorStatus", true)
	local wideEditorEnabled = readBool("WideEditor", false)
	local compactTabsEnabled = readBool("CompactTabs", false)
	local editorWordWrapEnabled = readBool("EditorWordWrap", false)
	local syntaxHighlightEnabled = readBool("EditorSyntaxHighlight", true)
	local exploitSyntaxEnabled = readBool("ExploitSyntaxHighlight", true)
	local editorFontSize = math.floor(readNumber("EditorFontSize", 14, 10, 24) + 0.5)
	local toolbarButtons = {}
	local toolbarLayout = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	local originalToolbarPadding = toolbarLayout and toolbarLayout.Padding or nil
	local nativeButtonOriginals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local statusFrame
	local statusLabel
	local editorCanvas
	local originalCodePosition = codeFrame.Position
	local originalCodeSize = codeFrame.Size
	local originalButtonsVisible = buttonsFrame.Visible
	local statusUpdateQueued = false
	local hookedBoxes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local sidebar = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
	local sidebarLayout = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	local originalSidebarSortOrder = sidebarLayout and sidebarLayout.SortOrder or nil
	local sidebarNames = { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Music", "Console", "Settings", "ToggleUI" }
	local sidebarNameSet = {}
	local sidebarOriginalOrders = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	for _, name in sidebarNames do
		sidebarNameSet[name] = true
		local button = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild(name)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			sidebarOriginalOrders[button] = button.LayoutOrder
		end
	end

	local function normalizeSidebarOrder(value)
		local result = {}
		local used = {}
		if type(value) == "table" then
			for _, name in value do
				if sidebarNameSet[name] and not used[name] then
					used[name] = true
					table.insert(result, name)
				end
			end
		end
		local musicWasMissing = not used.Music
		for _, name in sidebarNames do
			if not used[name] then
				used[name] = true
				table.insert(result, name)
			end
		end
		if musicWasMissing then
			local musicIndex = table.find(result, "Music")
			if musicIndex then
				table.remove(result, musicIndex)
				local hubIndex = table.find(result, "Scripthub") or math.min(3, #result)
				table.insert(result, hubIndex + 1, "Music")
			end
		end
		return result
	end

	local function readSidebarOrder()
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		local saved = config.SidebarButtonOrder
		if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.order) == "table" then
			saved = saved.order
		end
		return normalizeSidebarOrder(saved)
	end

	local sidebarOrder = readSidebarOrder()
	local sidebarApplyingOrder = false

	local function saveSidebarOrder()
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		config.SidebarButtonOrder = { order = table.clone(sidebarOrder) }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
	end

	local function applySidebarOrder()
		if sidebarApplyingOrder or not sidebar then
			return
		end
		sidebarApplyingOrder = true
		if sidebarLayout then
			sidebarLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		end
		for index, name in sidebarOrder do
			local button = sidebar:FindFirstChild(name)
			if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
				if sidebarOriginalOrders[button] == nil then
					sidebarOriginalOrders[button] = button.LayoutOrder
				end
				button.LayoutOrder = index
			end
		end
		sidebarApplyingOrder = false
	end

	local function moveSidebarButton(name, direction)
		local index = table.find(sidebarOrder, name)
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local target = math.clamp(index + direction, 1, #sidebarOrder)
		if target == index then
			return
		end
		sidebarOrder[index], sidebarOrder[target] = sidebarOrder[target], sidebarOrder[index]
		applySidebarOrder()
		saveSidebarOrder()
	end

	local function getCodeBoxes()
		local boxes = {}
		for _, object in codeFrame:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("TextBox") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(boxes, object)
			end
		end
		table.sort(boxes, function(a, b)
			local ai = tonumber(a.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			local bi = tonumber(b.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			return ai < bi
		end)
		return boxes
	end

	local function getActiveCodeBox()
		local focused = UIS and UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
		if focused and focused:IsDescendantOf(codeFrame) then
			return focused
		end
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			if box.Visible then
				return box
			end
		end
		return getCodeBoxes()[1]
	end


	runtime.clipboardCache = tostring(runtime.clipboardCache or "")

	local function writeClipboard(value)
		value = tostring(value or "")
		runtime.clipboardCache = value
		local writer = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard
			or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard
			or type(setrbxclipboard) == "function" and setrbxclipboard
		if writer then
			pcall(writer, value)
		end
		return writer ~= nil
	end

	local function readClipboard()
		local reader = type(getclipboard) == "function" and getclipboard
			or type(readclipboard) == "function" and readclipboard
		if reader then
			local ok, value = pcall(reader)
			if ok and type(value) == "string" then
				runtime.clipboardCache = value
				return value, true
			end
		end
		if runtime.clipboardCache ~= "" then
			return runtime.clipboardCache, false
		end
		return nil, false
	end


	local function insertIntoActive(text)
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		text = tostring(text or "")
		local current = box.Text or ""
		local cursor = tonumber(box.CursorPosition) or -1
		if cursor < 1 or cursor > #current + 1 then
			cursor = #current + 1
		end
		box.Text = current:sub(1, cursor - 1) .. text .. current:sub(cursor)
		local nextCursor = cursor + #text
		task.defer(function()
			if box and box.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					box:CaptureFocus()
					box.CursorPosition = nextCursor
					box.SelectionStart = nextCursor
				end)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end


	local function copyActiveCode()
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return
		end
		writeClipboard(box.Text or "")
		notify({
			Title = "Delta Customization",
			Description = "Copied the active editor tab.",
			Duration = 3,
		})
	end

	local function pasteIntoActive()
		local value = readClipboard()
		if type(value) == "string" then
			insertIntoActive(value)
			return
		end
		notify({
			Title = "Delta Customization",
			Description = "Clipboard access is unavailable in this Delta build.",
			Duration = 5,
		})
	end

	local function executeSource(source, chunkName)
		source = tostring(source or "")
		if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "Script execution is unavailable in this Delta build.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		local compiled, compileError = loadstring(source, chunkName or "=Delta V2")
		if not compiled then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta V2 compile error",
				Description = tostring(compileError or "Unknown compile error"),
				Duration = 7,
			})
			return false
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, runtimeError = xpcall(compiled, function(message)
				return tostring(message)
			end)
			if not ok then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta V2 runtime error",
					Description = tostring(runtimeError or "Unknown runtime error"),
					Duration = 7,
				})
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	local function executeActiveCode()
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		return executeSource(box.Text or "", "=" .. tostring(box.Name))
	end

	local function clearActiveCode()
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		box.Text = ""
		task.defer(function()
			if box and box.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					box.CursorPosition = 1
					box.SelectionStart = -1
				end)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	local function executeClipboardCode()
		local value = readClipboard()
		if type(value) ~= "string" then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "Clipboard access is unavailable in this Delta build.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		return executeSource(value, "=Delta V2 Clipboard")
	end

	local function activateOriginal(button)
		if not button then
			return false
		end
		if type(firesignal) == "function" then
			if type(getconnections) == "function" then
				for _, signalName in { "MouseButton1Click", "Activated" } do
					local signal = button[signalName]
					local ok, connections = pcall(getconnections, signal)
					if ok and type(connections) == "table" and #connections > 0 then
						local fired = pcall(firesignal, signal)
						if fired then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local ok = pcall(firesignal, button.MouseButton1Click)
			if ok then
				return true
			end
		end
		return pcall(function()
			button:Activate()
		end)
	end

	local function removeScripts(instance)
		for _, object in instance:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				object:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local function setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = text
		end
	end

	local function captureNativeButton(button)
		if not (button and button:IsA("GuiObject")) or nativeButtonOriginals[button] then
			return
		end
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		nativeButtonOriginals[button] = {
			Size = button.Size,
			LayoutOrder = button.LayoutOrder,
			Title = title,
			Text = title and title.Text or nil,
			TextScaled = title and title.TextScaled or nil,
			TextSize = title and title.TextSize or nil,
			TextTruncate = title and title.TextTruncate or nil,
		}
	end

	local function restoreNativeButton(button)
		local original = nativeButtonOriginals[button]
		if not (original and button and button.Parent) then
			return
		end
		button.Size = original.Size
		button.LayoutOrder = original.LayoutOrder
		button.Visible = true
		local title = original.Title
		if title and title.Parent then
			title.Text = original.Text
			title.TextScaled = original.TextScaled
			title.TextSize = original.TextSize
			title.TextTruncate = original.TextTruncate
		end
	end

	local function styleNativeButton(button, text, width, order)
		if not (button and button:IsA("GuiObject")) then
			return
		end
		captureNativeButton(button)
		button.Visible = true
		button.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, 0.7, 0)
		button.LayoutOrder = order
		setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextScaled = false
			title.TextSize = buttonsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X < 650 and 10 or 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
	end

	local function createToolbarButton(parent, template, name, text, order, callback)
		local button = template:Clone()
		button.Name = name
		removeScripts(button)
		button.Visible = true
		button.Active = true
		button.Interactable = true
		button.Selectable = true
		button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 6, -4, 1, -6)
		button.LayoutOrder = order
		button.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
		button.Parent = parent
		for _, object in button:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				object.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
			end
		end
		setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextScaled = false
			title.TextSize = buttonsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X < 650 and 10 or 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
		track(button)
		local locked = false
		local function activate()
			if locked or not runtime.alive then
				return
			end
			locked = true
			callback()
			task.delay(0.1, function()
				locked = false
			end)
		end
		if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			connect(button.MouseButton1Click, activate)
			connect(button.Activated, activate)
			connect(button.TouchTap, activate)
		else
			connect(button.InputEnded, function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					activate()
				end
			end)
		end
		return button
	end

	local function clearToolbar()
		for i = #toolbarButtons, 1, -1 do
			local button = toolbarButtons[i]
			if button and button.Parent then
				button:Destroy()
			end
			toolbarButtons[i] = nil
		end
		for _, name in { "LT_Copy", "LT_Paste", "LT_NewLine" } do
			local stale = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
			if stale then
				stale:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for _, name in { "Execute", "Clear", "ExecuteClipboard" } do
			restoreNativeButton(buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name))
		end
		if toolbarLayout and originalToolbarPadding then
			toolbarLayout.Padding = originalToolbarPadding
		end
	end

	local function addToolbarButton(template, name, text, order, width, callback)
		local button = createToolbarButton(buttonsFrame, template, name, text, order, callback)
		button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		button.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, 0.7, 0)
		table.insert(toolbarButtons, button)
		return button
	end

	local function buildToolbar()
		clearToolbar()
		for _, name in {
			"CopyCode",
			"LT_EditorToolbar",
			"LT_Execute",
			"LT_Clear",
			"LT_ExecuteClipboard",
			"LT_Copy",
			"LT_Paste",
			"LT_NewLine",
		} do
			local stale = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
			if stale then
				stale:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local executeButton = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("Execute")
		local clearButton = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("Clear")
		local clipboardButton = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("ExecuteClipboard")
		for _, button in { executeButton, clearButton, clipboardButton } do
			if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
				button:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
				button.Visible = true
			end
		end
		if not editorToolbarEnabled then
			return
		end
		local template = clipboardButton or executeButton or clearButton
		if not (executeButton and clearButton and clipboardButton and template and template:IsA("GuiObject")) then
			return
		end
		if toolbarLayout then
			toolbarLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
		end
		styleNativeButton(executeButton, "RUN", 0.14, 0)
		styleNativeButton(clearButton, "CLEAR", 0.13, 1)
		styleNativeButton(clipboardButton, "RUN CLIP", 0.20, 2)
		addToolbarButton(template, "LT_Copy", "COPY", 3, 0.13, copyActiveCode)
		addToolbarButton(template, "LT_Paste", "PASTE", 4, 0.13, pasteIntoActive)
		addToolbarButton(template, "LT_NewLine", "ADD LINE", 5, 0.16, function()
			insertIntoActive("\n")
		end)
	end

	local function updateStatusPosition()
		if not (statusFrame and statusFrame.Parent and codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent == executorOverlay) then
			return
		end
		statusFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			codeFrame.Position.X.Scale + codeFrame.Size.X.Scale * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.X),
			codeFrame.Position.X.Offset + codeFrame.Size.X.Offset * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.X) - 6,
			codeFrame.Position.Y.Scale + codeFrame.Size.Y.Scale * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.Y),
			codeFrame.Position.Y.Offset + codeFrame.Size.Y.Offset * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.Y) - 5
		)
		statusFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.58), 210, 360), 0, 22)
	end

	local function updateStatus()
		statusUpdateQueued = false
		if not (statusFrame and statusLabel) then
			return
		end
		statusFrame.Visible = editorStatusEnabled
		if not editorStatusEnabled then
			return
		end
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			statusLabel.Text = "No active editor tab"
			return
		end
		local text = box.Text or ""
		local _, lineBreaks = text:gsub("\n", "\n")
		local lines = lineBreaks + 1
		statusLabel.Text = string.format("%s   •   %d lines   •   %d chars   •   autosave", box.Name, lines, #text)
	end

	local function queueStatusUpdate()
		if statusUpdateQueued then
			return
		end
		statusUpdateQueued = true
		task.defer(updateStatus)
	end

	local saveTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local tabDirectory = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs"
	editorCanvas = (function()
		local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
		local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local resizeTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local originalCanvasSize = codeFrame.CanvasSize
		local originalAutomaticCanvasSize = codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize
		local originalCanvasPosition = codeFrame.CanvasPosition

		local function effectiveScale(object)
			local scale = 1
			local current = object
			while current do
				for _, child in current:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("UIScale") then
						scale *= child.Scale
					end
				end
				current = current.Parent
			end
			return math.max(scale, 0.05)
		end

		local function remember(box)
			if originals[box] == nil then
				originals[box] = {
					AutomaticSize = box.AutomaticSize,
					Position = box.Position,
					Size = box.Size,
				}
			end
		end

		local function resize(box)
			if not (runtime.alive and box and box.Parent and box:IsA("TextBox")) then
				return
			end
			remember(box)
			local token = (resizeTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			resizeTokens[box] = token
			task.defer(function()
				if not (runtime.alive and box.Parent and resizeTokens[box] == token) then
					return
				end
				local scale = effectiveScale(codeFrame)
				local windowWidth = math.max(140, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / scale))
				local windowHeight = math.max(100, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / scale))
				local availableTextWidth = math.max(120, windowWidth - 20)
				local text = box.Text ~= "" and box.Text or " "
				local params = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				params.Text = text
				params.Width = box.TextWrapped and availableTextWidth or 1000000
				params.Font = box.FontFace
				params.Size = box.TextSize
				local ok, bounds = pcall(function()
					return TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(params)
				end)
				params:Destroy()
				local _, lineBreaks = (box.Text or ""):gsub("\n", "\n")
				local lineHeight = math.max(1, box.LineHeight) * box.TextSize
				local minimumTextHeight = math.ceil((lineBreaks + 1) * lineHeight)
				if not ok then
					bounds = Vector2.new(availableTextWidth, minimumTextHeight)
				end
				if not (runtime.alive and box.Parent and resizeTokens[box] == token) then
					return
				end
				local measuredWidth = math.ceil(bounds.X)
				local measuredHeight = math.max(math.ceil(bounds.Y), minimumTextHeight)
				local contentWidth = box.TextWrapped
					and availableTextWidth
					or math.max(availableTextWidth, measuredWidth + 28)
				local contentHeight = math.max(windowHeight - 12, measuredHeight + math.ceil(lineHeight) + 28)
				local canvasWidth = box.TextWrapped
					and windowWidth
					or math.max(windowWidth, 8 + contentWidth + 32)
				local canvasHeight = math.max(windowHeight, 6 + contentHeight + 36)
				box.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
				box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
				box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(contentWidth, contentHeight)
				if box.Visible then
					codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
					codeFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(canvasWidth, canvasHeight)
					local maximumX = math.max(0, canvasWidth - windowWidth)
					local maximumY = math.max(0, canvasHeight - windowHeight)
					codeFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
						math.clamp(codeFrame.CanvasPosition.X, 0, maximumX),
						math.clamp(codeFrame.CanvasPosition.Y, 0, maximumY)
					)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function hook(box)
			if hooked[box] or not box:IsA("TextBox") or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				return
			end
			hooked[box] = true
			remember(box)
			for _, property in { "Text", "Visible", "TextWrapped", "TextSize", "FontFace", "LineHeight" } do
				connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
					resize(box)
				end)
			end
			resize(box)
		end

		local function resizeAll()
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				hook(box)
				resize(box)
			end
		end

		local function restore()
			if codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent then
				codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = originalAutomaticCanvasSize
				codeFrame.CanvasSize = originalCanvasSize
				codeFrame.CanvasPosition = originalCanvasPosition
			end
			for box, values in originals do
				if box and box.Parent then
					box.AutomaticSize = values.AutomaticSize
					box.Position = values.Position
					box.Size = values.Size
				end
			end
		end

		connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resizeAll)
		pcall(function()
			connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"), resizeAll)
		end)
		return { hook = hook, resize = resize, resizeAll = resizeAll, restore = restore }
	end)()

	local function applyToolbarLayout()
		buttonsFrame.Visible = true
		codeFrame.Position = originalCodePosition
		codeFrame.Size = originalCodeSize
		task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		task.delay(0.05, function()
			if runtime.alive then
				editorCanvas.resizeAll()
			end
		end)
	end

	addRestorer(function()
		for button, layoutOrder in sidebarOriginalOrders do
			if button and button.Parent then
				button.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
			end
		end
		if sidebarLayout and originalSidebarSortOrder then
			sidebarLayout.SortOrder = originalSidebarSortOrder
		end
	end)

	if sidebar then
		applySidebarOrder()
		connect(sidebar.ChildAdded, function(object)
			if sidebarNameSet[object.Name] and object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				task.defer(applySidebarOrder)
			end
		end)
	end

	addRestorer(function()
		if codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent then
			codeFrame.Position = originalCodePosition
			codeFrame.Size = originalCodeSize
		end
		if buttonsFrame and buttonsFrame.Parent then
			for _, name in { "LT_Copy", "LT_Paste", "LT_NewLine" } do
				local button = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
				if button then
					button:Destroy()
				end
			end
			for _, name in { "Execute", "Clear", "ExecuteClipboard" } do
				restoreNativeButton(buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name))
			end
			if toolbarLayout and originalToolbarPadding then
				toolbarLayout.Padding = originalToolbarPadding
			end
			buttonsFrame.Visible = originalButtonsVisible
		end
	end)
