		local function escape(value)
			return tostring(value or ""):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")
		end

		local function palette()
			local background = codeFrame.BackgroundColor3
			local light = background.R * 0.299 + background.G * 0.587 + background.B * 0.114 > 0.58
			if light then
				return {
					text = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 42), keyword = "#AF00DB", builtin = "#267F99",
					global = "#001080", func = "#795E26", string = "#A31515",
					number = "#098658", comment = "#008000", executor = "#B44700",
				}
			end
			return {
				text = Color3.fromRGB(218, 222, 232), keyword = "#C586C0", builtin = "#4EC9B0",
				global = "#9CDCFE", func = "#DCDCAA", string = "#CE9178",
				number = "#B5CEA8", comment = "#6A9955", executor = "#FF9E64",
			}
		end

		local function paint(value, color)
			return '<font color="' .. color .. '">' .. escape(value) .. "</font>"
		end

		local function longBracketAt(source, index)
			local equals = source:sub(index):match("^%[(=*)%[")
			if equals == nil then
				return nil
			end
			local closing = "]" .. equals .. "]"
			local finish = source:find(closing, index + #equals + 2, true)
			return finish and finish + #closing - 1 or #source
		end

		local function tokenize(source)
			local colors = palette()
			local output = table.create(math.max(32, math.floor(#source / 6)))
			local index = 1
			local expectFunctionName = false
			while index <= #source do
				local char = source:sub(index, index)
				local pair = source:sub(index, index + 1)
				if pair == "--" then
					local longFinish = longBracketAt(source, index + 2)
					local finish = longFinish or ((source:find("\n", index + 2, true) or (#source + 1)) - 1)
					output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.comment)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char == "\"" or char == "'" then
					local quote = char
					local finish = index + 1
					while finish <= #source do
						local current = source:sub(finish, finish)
						if current == "\\" then
							finish += 2
						elseif current == quote then
							break
						else
							finish += 1
						end
					end
					finish = math.min(finish, #source)
					output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.string)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char == "[" then
					local finish = longBracketAt(source, index)
					if finish then
						output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.string)
						index = finish + 1
					else
						output[#output + 1] = escape(char)
						index += 1
					end
				elseif char:match("[%a_]") then
					local finish = index
					while finish < #source and source:sub(finish + 1, finish + 1):match("[%w_]") do
						finish += 1
					end
					local word = source:sub(index, finish)
					local color
					if keywords[word] then
						color = colors.keyword
						expectFunctionName = word == "function"
					elseif exploitSyntaxEnabled and executorApis[word] then
						color = colors.executor
					elseif builtins[word] then
						color = colors.builtin
					elseif globals[word] then
						color = colors.global
					else
						local nextIndex = finish + 1
						while nextIndex <= #source and source:sub(nextIndex, nextIndex):match("%s") do
							nextIndex += 1
						end
						if expectFunctionName or source:sub(nextIndex, nextIndex) == "(" then
							color = colors.func
						end
						expectFunctionName = false
					end
					output[#output + 1] = color and paint(word, color) or escape(word)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char:match("%d") or (char == "." and source:sub(index + 1, index + 1):match("%d")) then
					local rest = source:sub(index)
					local number = rest:match("^0[xX][%da-fA-F_]+")
						or rest:match("^0[bB][01_]+")
						or rest:match("^%d[%d_]*%.?[%d_]*[eE][+-]?[%d_]+")
						or rest:match("^%.%d[%d_]*[eE][+-]?[%d_]+")
						or rest:match("^%d[%d_]*%.?[%d_]*")
						or rest:match("^%.%d[%d_]*")
					number = number ~= "" and number or char
					output[#output + 1] = paint(number, colors.number)
					index += #number
				else
					output[#output + 1] = escape(char)
					index += 1
				end
			end
			return table.concat(output), colors.text
		end

		local function sync(box)
			local state = overlays[box]
			if not state then
				return
			end
			local label = state.label
			if not (box.Parent and label.Parent) then
				return
			end
			label.AnchorPoint = box.AnchorPoint
			label.Position = box.Position
			label.Size = box.Size
			label.Rotation = box.Rotation
			label.TextXAlignment = box.TextXAlignment
			label.TextYAlignment = box.TextYAlignment
			label.TextWrapped = box.TextWrapped
			label.FontFace = box.FontFace
			label.TextSize = box.TextSize
			label.LineHeight = box.LineHeight
			local showOverlay = syntaxHighlightEnabled and box.Visible and box.Text ~= ""
			label.Visible = showOverlay
			if showOverlay then
				box.TextTransparency = 1
				box.ZIndex = state.originalZ + 1
				label.ZIndex = state.originalZ
			else
				box.TextTransparency = state.originalTransparency
				box.ZIndex = state.originalZ
			end
		end

		local function update(box)
			local state = overlays[box]
			if not state then
				return
			end
			sync(box)
			if not syntaxHighlightEnabled then
				return
			end
			local richText, textColor = tokenize(box.Text or "")
			state.label.TextColor3 = textColor
			state.label.Text = richText
		end

		local function queue(box)
			local token = (updateTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			updateTokens[box] = token
			task.delay(#(box.Text or "") > 60000 and 0.08 or 0.025, function()
				if runtime.alive and box.Parent and updateTokens[box] == token then
					update(box)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function hook(box)
			if overlays[box] or not box:IsA("TextBox") or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				return
			end
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = "LT_Syntax_" .. box.Name
			label:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay", true)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.RichText = true
			label.TextScaled = false
			label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
			label.Active = false
			label.Interactable = false
			label.Selectable = false
			label.Parent = box.Parent
			track(label)
			local originalTransparency = box:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency")
			if typeof(originalTransparency) ~= "number" then
				originalTransparency = box.TextTransparency < 1 and box.TextTransparency or 0
			end
			local originalZ = box:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex")
			if typeof(originalZ) ~= "number" then
				originalZ = math.max(1, box.ZIndex)
			end
			box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency", originalTransparency)
			box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex", originalZ)
			overlays[box] = {
				label = label,
				originalTransparency = originalTransparency,
				originalZ = originalZ,
			}
			for _, property in {
				"Text", "Visible", "Position", "Size", "AnchorPoint", "Rotation", "TextWrapped",
				"TextSize", "FontFace", "LineHeight", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment",
			} do
				connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
					queue(box)
				end)
			end
			connect(box.Destroying, function()
				local state = overlays[box]
				if state and state.label and state.label.Parent then
					state.label:Destroy()
				end
				overlays[box] = nil
			end)
			queue(box)
		end

		local function applyAll()
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				hook(box)
				update(box)
			end
		end

		local function restore()
			for box, state in overlays do
				if box and box.Parent then
					box.TextTransparency = state.originalTransparency
					box.ZIndex = state.originalZ
					box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency", nil)
					box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex", nil)
				end
				if state.label and state.label.Parent then
					state.label:Destroy()
				end
			end
			table.clear(overlays)
		end

		connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"), applyAll)
		return { hook = hook, sync = queue, applyAll = applyAll, restore = restore }
	end)()

	local function hookCodeBox(box)
		if
			not (box and box:IsA("TextBox") and not hookedBoxes[box])
			or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$")
		then
			return
		end
		hookedBoxes[box] = true
		editorCanvas.hook(box)
		syntaxHighlighter.hook(box)
		local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. box.Name
		if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(path) then
			local ok, data = pcall(readfile, path)
			if ok and type(data) == "string" then
				box.Text = data
			end
		elseif type(writefile) == "function" then
			pcall(writefile, path, box.Text or "")
		end
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
			queueStatusUpdate()
			local token = (saveTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			saveTokens[box] = token
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				if
					runtime.alive
					and box.Parent
					and saveTokens[box] == token
					and type(writefile) == "function"
				then
					pcall(writefile, tabDirectory .. "/" .. box.Name, box.Text or "")
				end
			end)
		end)
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), queueStatusUpdate)
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"), queueStatusUpdate)
		connect(box.Focused, queueStatusUpdate)
	end

	local function buildStatus()
		if statusFrame and statusFrame.Parent then
			statusFrame:Destroy()
		end
		statusFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		statusFrame.Name = "LT_EditorStatus"
		statusFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		statusFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22)
		statusFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
		statusFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		statusFrame.ZIndex = math.max(codeFrame.ZIndex + 50, 800)
		statusFrame.Visible = editorStatusEnabled
		statusFrame.Parent = executorOverlay
		track(statusFrame)
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
		corner.Parent = statusFrame
		track(corner)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness = 1
		stroke.Transparency = 0.45
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
		stroke.Parent = statusFrame
		track(stroke)
		statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		statusLabel.Name = "Text"
		statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0)
		statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0)
		statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		statusLabel.TextSize = 11
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 228, 238)
		statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		statusLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		statusLabel.ZIndex = statusFrame.ZIndex + 1
		statusLabel.Parent = statusFrame
		track(statusLabel)
		updateStatusPosition()
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			hookCodeBox(box)
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
	end

	local normalizingTabs = false
	local managedCloseBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local managedCloseBusy = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local normalizeTabSequence

	local function getOrderedTabButtons()
		local entries = {}
		for ordinal, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(entries, { tab = tab, ordinal = ordinal })
			end
		end
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
			local ao = a.tab.LayoutOrder
			local bo = b.tab.LayoutOrder
			if ao ~= bo then
				return ao < bo
			end
			local ai = tonumber(a.tab.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			local bi = tonumber(b.tab.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			if ai ~= bi then
				return ai < bi
			end
			return a.ordinal < b.ordinal
		end)
		local result = {}
		for _, entry in entries do
			table.insert(result, entry.tab)
		end
		return result
	end

	local function closeManagedTab(tab)
		if not (runtime.alive and tab and tab.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local tabs = getOrderedTabButtons()
		if #tabs <= 1 then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(tabs, tab)
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local box = boxes[index]
		local wasVisible = box and box.Visible or false
		if tab.Parent then
			tab:Destroy()
		end
		if box and box.Parent then
			box:Destroy()
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if not runtime.alive then
				return
			end
			normalizeTabSequence()
			if wasVisible then
				local remaining = getCodeBoxes()
				local nextBox = remaining[math.min(index, #remaining)] or remaining[#remaining]
				if nextBox then
					for _, current in remaining do
						current.Visible = current == nextBox
					end
					for _, currentTab in getOrderedTabButtons() do
						currentTab.BackgroundTransparency = currentTab.Name == nextBox.Name and 0 or 1
					end
				end
			end
			queueStatusUpdate()
		end)
	end

	local function bindManagedClose(tab)
		if not (tab and tab:IsA("GuiButton")) or managedCloseBound[tab] then
			return
		end
		local closeButton = tab:FindFirstChild("ImageButton")
		if not (closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton")) then
			return
		end
		managedCloseBound[tab] = true
		local function activateClose()
			if managedCloseBusy[tab] then
				return
			end
			managedCloseBusy[tab] = true
			closeManagedTab(tab)
			task.delay(0.1, function()
				managedCloseBusy[tab] = nil
			end)
		end
		connect(closeButton.MouseButton1Click, activateClose)
		connect(closeButton.Activated, activateClose)
	end

	local function normalizeSavedTabFiles()
		local directory = tabDirectory
		if
			type(isfolder) ~= "function"
			or type(listfiles) ~= "function"
			or type(readfile) ~= "function"
			or type(writefile) ~= "function"
			or not isfolder(directory)
		then
			return
		end
		local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, directory)
		if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local saved = {}
		for _, path in files do
			local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)$")
			local index = name and tonumber(name:match("^script(%d+)%.lua$"))
			if index then
				local readOk, text = pcall(readfile, path)
				if readOk and type(text) == "string" then
					table.insert(saved, { index = index, name = name, text = text })
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(saved, function(a, b)
			return a.index < b.index
		end)
		local keep = {}
		for index, item in saved do
			local name = "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
			keep[name] = true
			pcall(writefile, directory .. "/" .. name, item.text)
		end
		if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
			for _, item in saved do
				if not keep[item.name] then
					local path = directory .. "/" .. item.name
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	normalizeTabSequence = function()
		if normalizingTabs or not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		normalizingTabs = true
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local tabs = getOrderedTabButtons()
		local usedTabs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local entries = {}
		local keep = {}
		for index, box in boxes do
			local oldName = box.Name
			local newName = "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
			keep[newName] = true
			local tab
			for _, candidate in tabs do
				if not usedTabs[candidate] and candidate.Name == oldName then
					tab = candidate
					break
				end
			end
			if not tab then
				for _, candidate in tabs do
					if not usedTabs[candidate] then
						tab = candidate
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if tab then
				usedTabs[tab] = true
			end
			table.insert(entries, {
				box = box,
				tab = tab,
				oldName = oldName,
				newName = newName,
				text = box.Text or "",
			})
		end
		for _, tab in tabs do
			if not usedTabs[tab] and tab.Parent then
				tab:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for index, entry in entries do
			if entry.box.Parent then
				entry.box.Name = entry.newName
			end
			local tab = entry.tab
			if tab and tab.Parent then
				tab.Name = entry.newName
				tab.LayoutOrder = index
				local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
				if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
					title.Text = entry.newName
				end
				bindManagedClose(tab)
			end
		end
		if type(writefile) == "function" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				pcall(writefile, tabDirectory .. "/" .. entry.newName, entry.text)
			end
		end
		if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				if entry.oldName ~= entry.newName and not keep[entry.oldName] then
					local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. entry.oldName
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
		normalizingTabs = false
	end

	local function savedTabNames()
		normalizeSavedTabFiles()
		local names = {}
		local directory = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs"
		if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not isfolder(directory) then
			return names
		end
		local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, directory)
		if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
			return names
		end
		for _, path in files do
			local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)$")
			if name and name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
		end
		table.sort(names, function(a, b)
			return (tonumber(a:match("%d+")) or math.huge) < (tonumber(b:match("%d+")) or math.huge)
		end)
		return names
	end

	local function fireAddTab(addButton)
		local before = #getCodeBoxes()
		local fired = activateOriginal(addButton)
		if not fired then
			return false
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + 0.5
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until #getCodeBoxes() > before or os.clock() >= deadline
		return #getCodeBoxes() > before
	end

	local function selectTabByName(name)
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			box.Visible = box.Name == name
		end
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				tab.BackgroundTransparency = tab.Name == name and 0 or 1
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
	end

	local function nextAvailableTabName()
		local used = {}
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			used[tonumber(box.Name:match("%d+"))] = true
		end
		local index = 1
		while used[index] do
			index += 1
		end
		return "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
	end

	local function createFallbackTab(name)
		if tabsFrame:FindFirstChild(name) and codeFrame:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
			return true
		end
		local sourceTab
		for _, object in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if object:IsA("GuiButton") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				sourceTab = object
				break
			end
		end
		local sourceBox = getCodeBoxes()[1]
		if not (sourceTab and sourceBox) then
			return false
		end
		local index = tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or (#getCodeBoxes() + 1)
		local tab = sourceTab:Clone()
		tab.Name = name
		tab.LayoutOrder = index
		tab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		removeScripts(tab)
		local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = name
		end
		tab.Parent = tabsFrame
		track(tab)
		local box = sourceBox:Clone()
		box.Name = name
		box.Text = ""
		box.Visible = false
		box.Parent = sourceBox.Parent
		track(box)
		connect(tab.MouseButton1Click, function()
			selectTabByName(name)
		end)
		local closeButton = tab:FindFirstChild("ImageButton")
		if closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
			connect(closeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
				if #getCodeBoxes() <= 1 then
					return
				end
				local wasVisible = box.Visible
				if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
					local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. name
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
				if tab.Parent then
					tab:Destroy()
				end
				if box.Parent then
					box:Destroy()
				end
				if wasVisible then
					local remaining = getCodeBoxes()[1]
					if remaining then
						selectTabByName(remaining.Name)
					end
				end
				queueStatusUpdate()
			end)
		end
		return true
	end

	local restoringTabs = false
	local function restoreSavedTabs(showResult)
		if restoringTabs or not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		restoringTabs = true
		normalizeTabSequence()
		local saved = savedTabNames()
		local addButton = tabsFrame:FindFirstChild("AddTab")
		local before = #getCodeBoxes()
		local target = 0
		for _, name in saved do
			target = math.max(target, tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or 0)
		end
		local attemptsMade = 0
		while runtime.alive and #getCodeBoxes() < target and attemptsMade < math.max(target * 3, 8) do
			attemptsMade += 1
			local nextIndex = #getCodeBoxes() + 1
			local created = addButton and fireAddTab(addButton) or false
			if not created then
				created = createFallbackTab("script" .. tostring(nextIndex) .. ".lua")
			end
			if not created then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.08)
		end
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
			for _, box in boxes do
				local path = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs/" .. box.Name
				if isfile(path) then
					local ok, text = pcall(readfile, path)
					if ok and type(text) == "string" then
						box.Text = text
					end
				end
				hookCodeBox(box)
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
		if showResult then
			local after = #boxes
			local description
			if #saved == 0 then
				description = "No saved tabs were found."
			elseif after >= target then
				description = string.format("Restored %d saved tab%s.", #saved, #saved == 1 and "" or "s")
			else
				description = string.format("Restored %d of %d saved tabs.", math.max(after - before, 0), #saved)
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = description,
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		restoringTabs = false
	end

	local function findSettingsTemplate()
		local settings = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
		local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		if not holder then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local template
		for _, child in holder:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "Button" then
				template = child
				break
			end
		end
		return holder, template
	end

	local function createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, buttonText, callback)
		local holder, template = findSettingsTemplate()
		if not (holder and template) then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local existing = holder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
		local row = template:Clone()
		row.Name = name
		row.Visible = true
		row.LayoutOrder = -2
		removeScripts(row)
		local title = row:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local desc = row:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = titleText
		end
		if desc and desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
			desc.Text = descText
		end
		local button = row:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			setButtonTitle(button, buttonText)
			if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
				button.Active = true
				button.Interactable = true
				local locked = false
				local function activate()
					if locked or not runtime.alive then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					callback()
					task.delay(0.1, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connect(button.MouseButton1Click, activate)
				connect(button.Activated, activate)
				connect(button.TouchTap, activate)
			else
				connect(button.InputEnded, function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						callback()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		row.Parent = holder
		track(row)
		return row, button
	end

		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")

		button.Parent = parent
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		corner.Parent = button
		connect(button.Activated, callback)
		return button
	end

				moveSidebarButton(name, -1)
				refreshSidebarSortMenu()

			makeSortButton(row, "DOWN", UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, -14), UDim2.fromOffset(52, 28), function()
				moveSidebarButton(name, 1)
				refreshSidebarSortMenu()
			end)
		end
	end

	local function createToggleSetting(name, titleText, descText, initial, onChanged)
		local enabled = initial
		local row
		local button
		local function refresh()
			if button and button.Parent then
				local activeColor = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
				local sidebar = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
				local activeValue = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild("ActiveColor")
				if activeValue and activeValue:IsA("Color3Value") then
					activeColor = activeValue.Value
				end
				button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and activeColor or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
				setButtonTitle(button, enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
			end
		end
		row, button = createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, "", function()
			enabled = not enabled
			refresh()
			onChanged(enabled)
		end)
		refresh()
		return row
	end

	local editorSideMenu = executorRoot:FindFirstChild("Sidemenu")
	local originalEditorSize = executorImage.Size
	local originalEditorPosition = executorImage.Position
	local originalEditorAnchor = executorImage.AnchorPoint
	local originalSideVisible = editorSideMenu and editorSideMenu.Visible
	local originalTabSizes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local originalEditorText = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function applyWideEditor()
		if not (executorImage and executorImage.Parent) then
			return
		end
		if wideEditorEnabled then
			if editorSideMenu then
				editorSideMenu.Visible = false
			end
			executorImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, originalEditorAnchor.Y)
			executorImage.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, originalEditorPosition.Y.Scale, originalEditorPosition.Y.Offset)
			executorImage.Size = UDim2.new(0.995, 0, originalEditorSize.Y.Scale, originalEditorSize.Y.Offset)
		else
			if editorSideMenu then
				editorSideMenu.Visible = originalSideVisible
			end
			executorImage.AnchorPoint = originalEditorAnchor
			executorImage.Position = originalEditorPosition
			executorImage.Size = originalEditorSize
		end
		task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
	end
	local function applyTabStyle(tab)
		if not (tab and tab:IsA("ImageButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$")) then
			return
		end
		if originalTabSizes[tab] == nil then
			originalTabSizes[tab] = tab.Size
		end
		if compactTabsEnabled then
			tab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 126, originalTabSizes[tab].Y.Scale, originalTabSizes[tab].Y.Offset)
		else
			tab.Size = originalTabSizes[tab]
		end
		local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextSize = compactTabsEnabled and 11 or 14
		end
	end
	local function applyCompactTabs()
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			applyTabStyle(tab)
		end
	end
	local function applyEditorStyle(box)
		if not (box and box:IsA("TextBox") and box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$")) then
			return
		end
		if originalEditorText[box] == nil then
			originalEditorText[box] = { TextSize = box.TextSize, TextWrapped = box.TextWrapped }
		end
		box.TextSize = editorFontSize
		box.TextWrapped = editorWordWrapEnabled
		editorCanvas.resize(box)
		syntaxHighlighter.sync(box)
	end
	local function applyEditorPreferences()
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			applyEditorStyle(box)
		end
	end
	addRestorer(function()
		if executorImage and executorImage.Parent then
			executorImage.AnchorPoint = originalEditorAnchor
			executorImage.Position = originalEditorPosition
			executorImage.Size = originalEditorSize
		end
		if editorSideMenu and editorSideMenu.Parent then
			editorSideMenu.Visible = originalSideVisible
		end
		for tab, size in originalTabSizes do
			if tab and tab.Parent then
				tab.Size = size
			end
		end
		for box, values in originalEditorText do
			if box and box.Parent then
				box.TextSize = values.TextSize
				box.TextWrapped = values.TextWrapped
			end
		end
		syntaxHighlighter.restore()
		editorCanvas.restore()
	end)
	connect(tabsFrame.ChildAdded, function(tab)
		task.defer(applyTabStyle, tab)
	end)
	local function createCycleSetting(name, titleText, descText, values, getValue, setValue, formatValue)
		local row
		local button
		local function refresh()
			if button and button.Parent then
				setButtonTitle(button, formatValue(getValue()))
			end
		end
		row, button = createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, "", function()
			local current = getValue()
			local index = table.find(values, current) or 0
			local nextValue = values[(index % #values) + 1]
			setValue(nextValue)
			refresh()
		end)
		refresh()
		return row
	end


	local newUi = {
		enabled = readBool("NewDeltaUI", false),
		open = true,
		activePage = "Executor",
		applying = false,
		railCollapsed = false,
		originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		created = {},
		connections = {},
		tabConnections = {},
		locks = {},
		detached = {},
		pageNames = { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Music", "Console", "Settings" },
		pageButtons = {},
		codeBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	}

	newUi.colors = {
		panelTop = Color3.fromRGB(32, 48, 59),
		panelMiddle = Color3.fromRGB(27, 38, 45),
		panelBottom = Color3.fromRGB(22, 32, 38),
		railTop = Color3.fromRGB(31, 46, 57),
		railBottom = Color3.fromRGB(22, 33, 40),
		stroke = Color3.fromRGB(67, 91, 108),
		button = Color3.fromRGB(34, 48, 61),
		buttonStroke = Color3.fromRGB(67, 91, 108),
		active = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255),
		text = Color3.fromRGB(247, 249, 252),
		muted = Color3.fromRGB(218, 225, 232),
	}

	newUi.pageSet = {}
	for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
		newUi.pageSet[pageName] = true
	end

	newUi.getIconApi = function()
		local iconApi = rawget(__dcm_env, "DeltaIcon")
		if type(iconApi) == "table" then
			return iconApi
		end
		return nil
	end

	newUi.getCurrentSectionName = function()
		local iconApi = newUi.getIconApi()
		if iconApi and type(iconApi.getCurrentSectionName) == "function" then
			local ok, pageName = pcall(iconApi.getCurrentSectionName)
			if ok and type(pageName) == "string" and newUi.pageSet[pageName] then
				return pageName
			end
		end
		for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
			local page = newUi.getPage and newUi.getPage(pageName)
			if page and page.Visible then
				return pageName
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	newUi.setIconHidden = function(hidden)
		local iconApi = newUi.getIconApi()
		if iconApi and type(iconApi.setForcedHidden) == "function" then
			local ok = pcall(iconApi.setForcedHidden, hidden and true or false)
			if ok then
				return
			end
		end
		if iconApi and type(iconApi.getButton) == "function" then
			local ok, button = pcall(iconApi.getButton)
			if ok and button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
				button.Visible = not hidden
			end
		end
	end

	newUi.setClassicOpen = function(open)
		local iconApi = newUi.getIconApi()
		local callback = iconApi and (open and iconApi.openClassic or iconApi.closeClassic)
		if type(callback) == "function" then
			local ok = pcall(callback)
			if ok then
				return
			end
		end
		for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
			local page = newUi.getPage and newUi.getPage(pageName)
			if page then
				page.Visible = open and pageName == newUi.activePage
			end
		end
		newUi.setIconHidden(open)
	end

	newUi.capture = function(object, properties)
		if not object then
			return
		end
		local state = newUi.originals[object]
		if not state then
			state = {}
			newUi.originals[object] = state
		end
		for _, property in properties do
			if state[property] == nil then
				local ok, value = pcall(function()
					return object[property]
				end)
				if ok then
					state[property] = { value = value }
				end
			end
		end
	end

	newUi.connect = function(signal, callback)
		local ok, connection = pcall(function()
			return signal:Connect(callback)
		end)
		if ok and connection then
			table.insert(newUi.connections, connection)
		end
		return connection
	end

	newUi.connectTab = function(signal, callback)
		local ok, connection = pcall(function()
			return signal:Connect(callback)
		end)
		if ok and connection then
			table.insert(newUi.tabConnections, connection)
		end
		return connection
	end

	newUi.bindClick = function(button, callback)
		if not (button and button:IsA("GuiButton") and type(callback) == "function") then
			return nil
		end
		local locked = false
		return newUi.connect(button.Activated, function()
			if locked or not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
				return
			end
			locked = true
			callback()
			task.delay(0.08, function()
				locked = false
			end)
		end)
	end

	newUi.bindTabClick = function(button, callback)
		if not (button and button:IsA("GuiButton") and type(callback) == "function") then
			return nil
		end
		local locked = false
		return newUi.connectTab(button.Activated, function()
			if locked or not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
				return
			end
			locked = true
			callback()
			task.delay(0.08, function()
				locked = false
			end)
		end)
	end

	newUi.make = function(className, name, parent)
		local object = Instance.new(className)
		object.Name = name
		object.Parent = parent
		table.insert(newUi.created, object)
		track(object)
		return object
	end

	newUi.makeTransient = function(className, name, parent)
		local object = Instance.new(className)
		object.Name = name
		object.Parent = parent
		return object
	end

	newUi.ensureCorner = function(object, radius)
		local corner = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if corner then
			newUi.capture(corner, { "CornerRadius" })
		else
			corner = newUi.make("UICorner", "LT_NewUICorner", object)
		end
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
		return corner
	end

	newUi.ensureStroke = function(object, color, transparency, thickness)
		local stroke = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if stroke then
			newUi.capture(stroke, { "Color", "Transparency", "Thickness", "Enabled" })
		else
			stroke = newUi.make("UIStroke", "LT_NewUIStroke", object)
		end
		stroke.Color = color
		stroke.Transparency = transparency
		stroke.Thickness = thickness
		stroke.Enabled = true
		return stroke
	end

	newUi.makeCorner = function(object, radius, transient)
		local corner = transient and newUi.makeTransient("UICorner", "Corner", object)
			or newUi.make("UICorner", "Corner", object)
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
		return corner
	end

	newUi.makeStroke = function(object, color, transparency, thickness, transient)
		local stroke = transient and newUi.makeTransient("UIStroke", "Stroke", object)
			or newUi.make("UIStroke", "Stroke", object)
		stroke.Color = color
		stroke.Transparency = transparency
		stroke.Thickness = thickness
		return stroke
	end

	newUi.lock = function(object, property, resolver)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end
		newUi.capture(object, { property })
		local state = {
			object = object,
			property = property,
			resolver = resolver,
			busy = false,
		}
		state.apply = function()
			if state.busy or not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and object.Parent) then
				return
			end
			local value = type(resolver) == "function" and resolver() or resolver
			local ok, current = pcall(function()
				return object[property]
			end)
			if ok and current ~= value then
				state.busy = true
				pcall(function()
					object[property] = value
				end)
				state.busy = false
			end
		end
		table.insert(newUi.locks, state)
		newUi.connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
			if not state.busy then
				task.defer(state.apply)
			end
		end)
		state.apply()
		return state
	end

	newUi.applyLocks = function()
		for _, state in newUi.locks do
			state.apply()
		end
	end

	newUi.getPage = function(pageName)
		local page = v2Main:FindFirstChild(pageName)
		if page and page:IsA("GuiObject") then
			return page
		end
		return nil
	end

	newUi.getOrderedPages = function()
		local result = {}
		local used = {}
		for _, pageName in sidebarOrder do
			if newUi.pageSet[pageName] and newUi.getPage(pageName) and not used[pageName] then
				used[pageName] = true
				table.insert(result, pageName)
			end
		end
		for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
			if newUi.getPage(pageName) and not used[pageName] then
				used[pageName] = true
				table.insert(result, pageName)
			end
		end
		return result
	end

	newUi.findImage = function(object)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end
		for _, descendant in object:GetDescendants() do
			if
				(descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") or descendant:IsA("ImageButton"))
				and type(descendant.Image) == "string"
				and descendant.Image ~= ""
			then
				return descendant
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	newUi.findSourceIcon = function(pageName)
		local sourceButton = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild(pageName)
		return newUi.findImage(sourceButton)
	end

	newUi.copyIcon = function(source, parent, size, zIndex, transient)
		local icon = transient and newUi.makeTransient("ImageLabel", "Icon", parent)
			or newUi.make("ImageLabel", "Icon", parent)
		icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
		icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		icon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		icon.ImageTransparency = 0
		icon.ZIndex = zIndex
		if source then
			pcall(function()
				icon.Image = source.Image
			end)
			pcall(function()
				icon.ImageRectOffset = source.ImageRectOffset
				icon.ImageRectSize = source.ImageRectSize
			end)
			pcall(function()
				icon.ResampleMode = source.ResampleMode
			end)
		end
		local constraint = transient and newUi.makeTransient("UIAspectRatioConstraint", "Aspect", icon)
			or newUi.make("UIAspectRatioConstraint", "Aspect", icon)
		constraint.AspectRatio = 1
		constraint.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Height
		return icon
	end

	newUi.makeXIcon = function(parent, size, color, zIndex, transient)
		local holder = transient and newUi.makeTransient("Frame", "Icon", parent)
			or newUi.make("Frame", "Icon", parent)
		holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		holder.ZIndex = zIndex
		for index, rotation in { 45, -45 } do
			local line = transient and newUi.makeTransient("Frame", "Line" .. index, holder)
				or newUi.make("Frame", "Line" .. index, holder)
			line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, math.floor(size * 0.72))
			line.BackgroundColor3 = color
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.Rotation = rotation
			line.ZIndex = zIndex
			if transient then
				newUi.makeCorner(line, 1, true)
			else
				newUi.makeCorner(line, 1, false)
			end
		end
		return holder
	end

	newUi.setChevronDirection = function(holder, pointsRight)
		if not holder then
			return
		end
		local first = holder:FindFirstChild("Line1")
		local second = holder:FindFirstChild("Line2")
		if first then
			first.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.37)
			first.Rotation = pointsRight and -42 or 42
		end
		if second then
			second.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.63)
			second.Rotation = pointsRight and 42 or -42
		end
	end

	newUi.makeActionIcon = function(kind, parent, size, color, zIndex, transient)
		if kind == "Execute" then
			return newUi.makePlayIcon(parent, size, color, zIndex, transient, true)
		elseif kind == "Clear" then
			return newUi.makeTrashIcon(parent, size, color, zIndex, transient)
		elseif kind == "ExecuteClipboard" then
			return newUi.makeClipboardIcon(parent, size, color, zIndex, transient, true)
		elseif kind == "Copy" then
			return newUi.makeCopyIcon(parent, size, color, zIndex, transient)
		end
		return newUi.makeClipboardIcon(parent, size, color, zIndex, transient, false)
	end

	newUi.createNavButton = function(pageName)
		local button = newUi.make("ImageButton", "LT_NewUINav_" .. pageName, newUi.navBar)
		button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
		button.BackgroundColor3 = newUi.colors.active
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.AutoButtonColor = false
		button.Image = ""
		button.ZIndex = 12002
		newUi.makeCorner(button, 32, false)
		local source = newUi.findSourceIcon(pageName)
		local icon
		if source then
			icon = newUi.copyIcon(source, button, 25, 12003, false)
		else
			if pageName == "Music" then
				icon = newUi.makeMusicIcon(button, 27, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 12003, false)
			else
				icon = newUi.make("TextLabel", "Icon", button)
				icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
				icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				icon.Font = pageName == "Executor" and Enum.Font.Code or Enum.Font.GothamBold
				icon.Text = pageName == "Executor" and ">_" or pageName:sub(1, 1)
				icon.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				icon.TextSize = pageName == "Executor" and 18 or 20
				icon.ZIndex = 12003
			end
		end
		newUi.pageButtons[pageName] = {
			button = button,
			icon = icon,
		}
		newUi.bindClick(button, function()
			newUi.showPage(pageName)
		end)
		return button
	end

	newUi.refreshOrder = function()
		if not (newUi.navBar and newUi.navBar.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local ordered = newUi.getOrderedPages()
		for index, pageName in ordered do
			local entry = newUi.pageButtons[pageName]
			if entry and entry.button then
				entry.button.LayoutOrder = index
			end
		end
		local width = (#ordered * 64) + (math.max(#ordered - 1, 0) * 4) + 24
		newUi.navBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 80)
		if newUi.closeButton then
			newUi.closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.53, -(math.floor(width / 2) + 49), 0.015, 0)
		end
	end

	newUi.refreshNav = function()
		local visible = newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and newUi.open
		if newUi.navBar then
			newUi.navBar.Visible = visible
		end
		if newUi.closeButton then
			newUi.closeButton.Visible = visible
		end
		if newUi.rail then
			newUi.rail.Visible = visible and newUi.activePage == "Executor"
		end
		for pageName, entry in newUi.pageButtons do
			local active = visible and newUi.activePage == pageName
			entry.button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1
			if entry.icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				entry.icon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				entry.icon.ImageTransparency = active and 0 or 0.1
			elseif entry.icon:IsA("TextLabel") then
				entry.icon.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				entry.icon.TextTransparency = active and 0 or 0.1
			end
		end
	end

	newUi.syncPages = function()
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
			return
		end
		newUi.applying = true
		for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
			local page = newUi.getPage(pageName)
			if page then
				page.Visible = newUi.open and pageName == newUi.activePage
			end
		end
		if sidebar and sidebar.Parent then
			sidebar.Visible = false
		end
		newUi.applying = false
		newUi.refreshNav()
		newUi.setIconHidden(newUi.open)
	end

	newUi.showPage = function(pageName)
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and newUi.pageSet[pageName]) then
			return
		end
		newUi.activePage = pageName
		newUi.open = true
		newUi.syncPages()
		newUi.applyLocks()
		if pageName == "Executor" then
			newUi.rebuildTabs()
			task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
			task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		end
	end

	newUi.setOpen = function(open)
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
			return
		end
		newUi.open = open and true or false
		newUi.syncPages()
		newUi.applyLocks()
	end

	newUi.updateLineNumbers = function()
		if not (newUi.lineGutter and newUi.lineNumbers and newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
			return
		end
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			newUi.lineNumbers.Text = ""
			return
		end
		local text = box.Text or ""
		local _, breaks = text:gsub("\n", "\n")
		local count = math.min(breaks + 1, 5000)
		local numbers = table.create(count)
		for index = 1, count do
			numbers[index] = tostring(index)
		end
		local lineHeight = math.max(1, box.LineHeight)
		newUi.lineNumbers.Text = table.concat(numbers, "\n")
		newUi.lineNumbers.TextSize = box.TextSize
		newUi.lineNumbers.LineHeight = lineHeight
		newUi.lineNumbers.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6 - codeFrame.CanvasPosition.Y)
		newUi.lineNumbers.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, math.max(newUi.lineGutter.AbsoluteSize.Y, math.ceil(count * box.TextSize * lineHeight) + 20))
	end

	newUi.clearTabConnections = function()
		for i = #newUi.tabConnections, 1, -1 do
			pcall(function()
				newUi.tabConnections[i]:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(newUi.tabConnections)
	end

	newUi.updateTabCanvas = function()
		if not (newUi.tabBar and newUi.tabLayout) then
			return
		end
		newUi.tabBar.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(newUi.tabLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.X + 4, 0)
	end

	newUi.getNativeTabTitle = function(tab)
		local title = tab and (tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or tab:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true))
		local value = title and title:IsA("TextLabel") and title.Text ~= "" and title.Text or tab and tab.Name or "New tab"
		local index = tostring(value):match("^script(%d+)%.lua$")
		if index then
			return tonumber(index) == 1 and "New tab" or "New tab " .. index
		end
		return value
	end

	newUi.getNativeClose = function(tab)
		if not tab then
			return nil
		end
		for _, descendant in tab:GetDescendants() do
			if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") then
				return descendant
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	newUi.rebuildTabs = function()
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and newUi.tabBar and newUi.tabBar.Parent) then
			return
		end
		newUi.clearTabConnections()
		for _, child in newUi.tabBar:GetChildren() do
			if child:GetAttribute("LT_CustomTab") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local nativeTabs = {}
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(nativeTabs, tab)
			end
		end
		table.sort(nativeTabs, function(a, b)
			return (a.LayoutOrder ~= b.LayoutOrder and a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder)
				or (a.LayoutOrder == b.LayoutOrder and a.Name < b.Name)
		end)
		for index, nativeTab in nativeTabs do
			local box = codeFrame:FindFirstChild(nativeTab.Name, true)
			local active = box and box:IsA("TextBox") and box.Visible
			local button = newUi.makeTransient("ImageButton", nativeTab.Name, newUi.tabBar)
			button:SetAttribute("LT_CustomTab", true)
			button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(184, 54)
			button.LayoutOrder = index
			button.BackgroundColor3 = active and newUi.colors.active or newUi.colors.button
			button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 0.12
			button.BorderSizePixel = 0
			button.AutoButtonColor = false
			button.Image = ""
			button.ZIndex = 12010
			newUi.makeCorner(button, 16, true)
			if not active then
				newUi.makeStroke(button, newUi.colors.buttonStroke, 0.5, 1, true)
			end
			local documentHolder = newUi.makeTransient("Frame", "DocumentHolder", button)
			documentHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			documentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0)
			documentHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
			documentHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			documentHolder.ZIndex = 12011
			newUi.makeDocumentIcon(documentHolder, 22, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 12012, true, true)
			local title = newUi.makeTransient("TextLabel", "Title", button)
			title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0.5, 0)
			title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 1, 0)
			title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			title.Text = newUi.getNativeTabTitle(nativeTab)
			title.TextColor3 = newUi.colors.text
			title.TextSize = 15
			title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			title.ZIndex = 12011
			local close = newUi.makeTransient("ImageButton", "Close", button)
			close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
			close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
			close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			close.BorderSizePixel = 0
			close.AutoButtonColor = false
			close.Image = ""
			close.ZIndex = 12012
			newUi.makeXIcon(close, 15, Color3.fromRGB(214, 223, 231), 12013, true)
			newUi.bindTabClick(button, function()
				selectTabByName(nativeTab.Name)
				task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
				task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
			end)
			newUi.bindTabClick(close, function()
				local nativeClose = newUi.getNativeClose(nativeTab)
				if nativeClose then
					activateOriginal(nativeClose)
				else
					local nativeBox = codeFrame:FindFirstChild(nativeTab.Name, true)
					if nativeBox then
						nativeBox:Destroy()
					end
					nativeTab:Destroy()
				end
				task.delay(0.08, function()
					local activeBox = getActiveCodeBox()
					if not activeBox then
						local first = tabsFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
						if first and first.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
							selectTabByName(first.Name)
						end
					end
					newUi.rebuildTabs()
				end)
			end)
		end
		newUi.updateTabCanvas()
		newUi.updateLineNumbers()
	end

	newUi.refreshTabs = newUi.rebuildTabs

	newUi.bindCodeBox = function(box)
		if not (box and box:IsA("TextBox") and box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") and not newUi.codeBound[box]) then
			return
		end
		newUi.codeBound[box] = true
		newUi.connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
		end)
		newUi.connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"), function()
			task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
		end)
		for _, property in { "Text", "TextSize", "LineHeight" } do
			newUi.connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
				task.defer(newUi.updateLineNumbers)
			end)
		end
	end

	newUi.buildPages = function()
		for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
			local page = newUi.getPage(pageName)
			if page then
				newUi.capture(page, { "Visible", "Position", "Size", "AnchorPoint", "ClipsDescendants" })
				newUi.lock(page, "AnchorPoint", Vector2.zero)
				newUi.lock(page, "Position", UDim2.new(0.012, 0, 0.16, 0))
				newUi.lock(page, "Size", UDim2.new(0.976, 0, 0.828, 0))
				newUi.lock(page, "ClipsDescendants", false)
				newUi.connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
					if not newUi.applying then
						task.defer(newUi.syncPages)
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end

		newUi.railToggle = newUi.make("TextButton", "LT_NewUIRailToggle", newUi.rail)
		newUi.railToggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		newUi.railToggle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		newUi.railToggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)
		newUi.railToggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		newUi.railToggle.Text = ""
		newUi.railToggle.ZIndex = 11902
		newUi.railToggleIcon = newUi.makeChevronIcon(
			newUi.railToggle,
			20,
			newUi.colors.muted,
			11903,
			false
		)
		newUi.bindClick(newUi.railToggle, function()
			newUi.railCollapsed = not newUi.railCollapsed
			newUi.applyRailState()
			task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
		end)
		newUi.connect(tabsFrame.ChildAdded, function(object)
			if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
				task.delay(0.05, newUi.rebuildTabs)
			end
		end)
		newUi.connect(tabsFrame.ChildRemoved, function()
			task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
		end)
		newUi.connect(codeFrame.DescendantAdded, function(object)
			if object:IsA("TextBox") then
				task.defer(newUi.bindCodeBox, object)
			end
		end)
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			newUi.bindCodeBox(box)
		end
		newUi.applyRailState()
		newUi.rebuildTabs()
	end

	newUi.bindIcon = function()
		__dcm_env.__NewDeltaUIToggle = function()
			if newUi.enabled and newUi.applied then
				newUi.setOpen(not newUi.open)
				return true
			end
			return false
		end
		local iconApi = rawget(__dcm_env, "DeltaIcon")
		if type(iconApi) == "table" and type(iconApi.rebindToggle) == "function" then
			pcall(iconApi.rebindToggle)
		end
	end

	newUi.enable = function()
		if newUi.applied then
			newUi.enabled = true
			newUi.setOpen(newUi.open)
			return
		end
		local visiblePage = newUi.getCurrentSectionName()
		newUi.enabled = true
		newUi.applied = true
		newUi.open = visiblePage ~= nil
		if visiblePage and newUi.pageSet[visiblePage] then
			newUi.activePage = visiblePage
		else
			for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
				local page = newUi.getPage(pageName)
				if page and page.Visible then
					newUi.activePage = pageName
					newUi.open = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("Sidebar_NormalizeGeometry")
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarGesture")
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedIcon_Toggle")
		local gesture = v2Main:FindFirstChild("SidebarGestureZone", true)
		if gesture and gesture:IsA("GuiObject") then
			newUi.capture(gesture, { "Visible", "Active" })
			gesture.Visible = false
			gesture.Active = false
		end
		newUi.buildShell()
		newUi.buildPages()
		newUi.buildExecutor()
		newUi.bindIcon()
		newUi.syncPages()
		newUi.applyLocks()
		newUi.refreshOrder()
		newUi.refreshNav()
		task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
		task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
	end

	newUi.disable = function(fullUnload)
		if not newUi.applied then
			newUi.enabled = false
			return
		end
		local wasOpen = newUi.open
		local lastPage = newUi.activePage
		newUi.enabled = false
		newUi.applied = false
		newUi.clearTabConnections()
		for i = #newUi.connections, 1, -1 do
			pcall(function()
				newUi.connections[i]:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(newUi.connections)
		for i = #newUi.created, 1, -1 do
			local object = newUi.created[i]
			if object and object.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					object:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(newUi.created)
		for object, state in newUi.originals do
			if object then
				local parentState = state.Parent
				if parentState then
					pcall(function()
						object.Parent = parentState.value
					end)
				end
				for property, wrapped in state do
					if property ~= "Parent" then
						pcall(function()
							object[property] = wrapped.value
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		table.clear(newUi.detached)
		newUi.originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		newUi.pageButtons = {}
		newUi.codeBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		newUi.locks = {}
		newUi.navBar = nil
		newUi.closeButton = nil
		newUi.tabBar = nil
		newUi.tabLayout = nil
		newUi.lineGutter = nil
		newUi.lineNumbers = nil
		newUi.addButton = nil
		newUi.toolbar = nil
		newUi.rail = nil
		newUi.railTop = nil
		newUi.railToggle = nil
		newUi.railToggleIcon = nil
		__dcm_env.__NewDeltaUIToggle = nil
		if not fullUnload then
			if lastPage and newUi.pageSet[lastPage] then
				local iconApi = newUi.getIconApi()
				if iconApi and type(iconApi.setCurrentSection) == "function" then
					pcall(iconApi.setCurrentSection, lastPage)
				end
			end
			newUi.setClassicOpen(wasOpen)
			local iconApi = rawget(__dcm_env, "DeltaIcon")
			if type(iconApi) == "table" and type(iconApi.rebindToggle) == "function" then
				task.defer(iconApi.rebindToggle)
			end
			task.defer(applySidebarOrder)
			task.defer(applyWideEditor)
			task.defer(applyCompactTabs)
			task.defer(applyToolbarLayout)
			task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
			task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		end
	end

	local baseApplySidebarOrder = applySidebarOrder
	applySidebarOrder = function()
		baseApplySidebarOrder()
		if newUi.enabled and newUi.applied then
			newUi.refreshOrder()
		end
	end

	addRestorer(function()
		newUi.disable(true)
	end)
	local newUiSettingRow = createToggleSetting(
		"LT_NewDeltaUI",
		"Recreated new Delta UI (BETA)",
		"BETA: Rebuilds Delta around the unreleased full-screen layout while retaining its native page and executor handlers",
		newUi.enabled,
		function(enabled)
			saveBool("NewDeltaUI", enabled)
			if enabled then
				newUi.enable()
			else
				newUi.disable()
			end
		end
	)
	if newUiSettingRow then
		local betaStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		betaStroke.Name = "LT_NewUIBetaStroke"
		betaStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 145, 255)
		betaStroke.Transparency = 0.25
		betaStroke.Thickness = 1.5
		betaStroke.Parent = newUiSettingRow
		local newBadge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		newBadge.Name = "LT_NewUIBadge"
		newBadge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		newBadge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 8)
		newBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 21)
		newBadge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
		newBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		newBadge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		newBadge.Text = "NEW!"
		newBadge.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		newBadge.TextSize = 11
		newBadge.ZIndex = newUiSettingRow.ZIndex + 4
		newBadge.Parent = newUiSettingRow
		local badgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		badgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
		badgeCorner.Parent = newBadge
	end

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_AutoRestoreTabs",
		"Auto restore saved tabs",
		"Creates missing Delta tabs and loads their saved code automatically",
		autoRestoreEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			autoRestoreEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("AutoRestoreTabs", enabled)
			if enabled then
				task.spawn(restoreSavedTabs, true)
			end
		end
	)

			editorToolbarEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorToolbar", enabled)
			buildToolbar()
			applyToolbarLayout()
		end
	)

	createSettingRow(
		"LT_SidebarButtonOrder",

		"Reorders the classic sidebar and the recreated top navigation, including Music",
		"SORT",
