			local menu = ensureSidebarSortMenu()
			refreshSidebarSortMenu()
			menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_EditorStatusSetting",
		"Editor statistics",
		"Shows the active tab, line count, character count and autosave state",
		editorStatusEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			editorStatusEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorStatus", enabled)
			queueStatusUpdate()
		end
	)

	createSettingRow(
		"LT_RestoreTabsNow",
		"Restore saved tabs now",
		"Rebuilds any missing tabs from DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs",
		"RESTORE",
		function()
			task.spawn(restoreSavedTabs, true)
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_WideEditor",
		"Wide editor",
		"Hides the executor side cards and gives the code editor more room",
		wideEditorEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			wideEditorEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("WideEditor", enabled)
			applyWideEditor()
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_CompactTabs",
		"Compact editor tabs",
		"Fits more script tabs across the executor tab bar",
		compactTabsEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			compactTabsEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("CompactTabs", enabled)
			applyCompactTabs()
		end
	)


	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_SyntaxHighlight",
		"Lua/Luau syntax highlighting",
		"Highlights Luau keywords, strings, numbers, comments, globals and built-in APIs",
		syntaxHighlightEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			syntaxHighlightEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorSyntaxHighlight", enabled)
			syntaxHighlighter.applyAll()
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_ExploitSyntaxHighlight",
		"Executor API highlighting",
		"Highlights common executor globals, filesystem, hook, debug and clipboard functions",
		exploitSyntaxEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			exploitSyntaxEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("ExploitSyntaxHighlight", enabled)
			syntaxHighlighter.applyAll()
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_EditorWordWrap",
		"Editor word wrap",
		"Wraps long code lines inside the editor viewport",
		editorWordWrapEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			editorWordWrapEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorWordWrap", enabled)
			applyEditorPreferences()
		end
	)

	createSettingRow(
		"LT_UnloadCustomization",
		"Unload customization",
		"Restores Delta's original interface and removes the active customization",
		"UNLOAD",
		function()
			local master = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime")
			if type(master) == "table" and type(master.stop) == "function" then
				task.defer(master.stop)
			else
				task.defer(runtime.stop)
			end
		end
	)

	createCycleSetting(
		"LT_EditorFontSize",
		"Editor font size",
		"Cycles the code editor font size",
		{ 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24 },
		function()
			return editorFontSize
		end,
		function(value)
			editorFontSize = value
			saveNumber("EditorFontSize", value)
			applyEditorPreferences()
		end,
		function(value)
			return tostring(value) .. " PX"
		end
	)

	connect(codeFrame.DescendantAdded, function(object)
		if object:IsA("TextBox") then
			task.defer(function()
				hookCodeBox(object)
				applyEditorStyle(object)
				queueStatusUpdate()
			end)
			task.delay(0.12, normalizeTabSequence)
		end
	end)
	local addTabButton = tabsFrame:FindFirstChild("AddTab")
	if addTabButton and addTabButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(addTabButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			local before = #getCodeBoxes()
			task.delay(0.18, function()
				if runtime.alive and #getCodeBoxes() == before then
					createFallbackTab(nextAvailableTabName())
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
	connect(codeFrame.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
		queueStatusUpdate()
		task.delay(0.12, normalizeTabSequence)
		if not object:IsA("TextBox") or not object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
			return
		end
		local name = object.Name
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			if
				not runtime.alive
				or not v2Main.Parent
				or not tabsFrame.Parent
				or not codeFrame.Parent
			then
				return
			end
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				if box.Name == name then
					return
				end
			end
			if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
				local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. name
				if isfile(path) then
					pcall(delfile, path)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
	connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"), updateStatusPosition)
	connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"), updateStatusPosition)
	connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), updateStatusPosition)
	connect(buttonsFrame.ChildAdded, function(object)
		if not object:IsA("GuiButton") then
			return
		end
		if object.Name == "Execute" or object.Name == "Clear" or object.Name == "ExecuteClipboard" then
			object:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
			runtime.originalButtons[object] = true
			object.Visible = true
			task.defer(function()
				if runtime.alive and object.Parent == buttonsFrame then
					buildToolbar()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	task.wait(0.7)
	if not runtime.alive then
		return
	end
	normalizeTabSequence()
	buildToolbar()
	applyToolbarLayout()
	buildStatus()
	applyWideEditor()
	applyCompactTabs()
	applyEditorPreferences()
	syntaxHighlighter.applyAll()
	if newUi.enabled then
		newUi.enable()
	end
	if autoRestoreEnabled then
		task.spawn(restoreSavedTabs, false)
	end
end

--[[
    Delta Customizer - Immersive UI Upgrade
    Adds:
      * 10 ambient UI animations
      * 10 transition styles
      * transition-only depth blur
      * 5 visual style presets
      * persistent customization controls
      * lightweight runtime + cleanup hooks
]]
do
    local __iuiParent = mainGui or root
    if not __iuiParent then
        return
    end

    local __oldIUI = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime")
    if type(__oldIUI) == "table" and type(__oldIUI.stop) == "function" then
        pcall(__oldIUI.stop)
    end

    local __iui = {
        alive = true,
        objects = {},
        connections = {},
        pageConnections = {},
        styled = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
        original = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
        scales = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
        currentPage = nil,
        transitionBusy = false,
        transitionToken = 0,
        animationTime = 0,
        parallax = Vector2.zero,
        defaultsCaptured = false,
    }

    __dcm_env.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = __iui
    __dcm_shared.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = __iui

    local function track(obj)
        if obj then
            __iui.objects[obj] = true
            if __dcm_masterRuntime and type(__dcm_masterRuntime.registerCustom) == "function" then
                pcall(__dcm_masterRuntime.registerCustom, obj)
            end
        end
        return obj
    end

    local function connect(signal, callback)
        if not signal then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, c = pcall(function()
            return signal:Connect(callback)
        end)
        if ok and c then
            table.insert(__iui.connections, c)
            return c
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function disconnect(c)
        if c then
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
    end

    local function hasParent(obj)
        return obj and obj.Parent ~= nil
    end

    local function isUiObject(obj)
        return obj and typeof(obj) == "Instance" and obj:IsA("GuiObject")
    end

    local function clamp01(v)
        return math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
    end

    local function lerpColor(a, b, alpha)
        alpha = clamp01(alpha)
        return Color3.new(
            a.R + (b.R - a.R) * alpha,
            a.G + (b.G - a.G) * alpha,
            a.B + (b.B - a.B) * alpha
        )
    end

    local function readImmersiveConfig()
        local config = {}
        if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile("DeltaCustom/ImmersiveUI.json") then
            local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, "DeltaCustom/ImmersiveUI.json")
            if ok and type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
                local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
                    if HS and HS.JSONDecode then
                        return HS:JSONDecode(raw)
                    end
                    return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
                end)
                if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" then
                    config = decoded
                end
            end
        end
        return config
    end

    local function saveImmersiveConfig(config)
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            ensureDir("DeltaCustom")
            local encoded = HS and HS.JSONEncode and HS:JSONEncode(config) or __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONEncode", config)
            writefile("DeltaCustom/ImmersiveUI.json", encoded)
        end)
    end

    local __iuiConfig = readImmersiveConfig()

    local styles = {
        Obsidian = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(9, 11, 15),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 29),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 29, 37),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(27, 32, 42),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(76, 169, 255),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(118, 97, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(159, 171, 190),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(69, 82, 104),
            corner = 12,
            transparency = 0.02,
        },
        Aurora = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(9, 14, 24),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(17, 25, 39),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 34, 53),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(27, 39, 58),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(83, 218, 255),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(162, 115, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(246, 250, 255),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(170, 187, 210),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(77, 112, 146),
            corner = 15,
            transparency = 0.04,
        },
        Glass = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 23),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(25, 31, 42),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(37, 45, 59),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(48, 57, 72),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(152, 214, 255),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(197, 174, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(250, 252, 255),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(187, 197, 212),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(133, 156, 186),
            corner = 18,
            transparency = 0.16,
        },
        Crimson = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(14, 8, 11),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(30, 14, 19),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 19, 27),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(52, 22, 31),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 78, 104),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 142, 79),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 249),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(208, 165, 174),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(126, 61, 75),
            corner = 11,
            transparency = 0.03,
        },
        Neon = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(4, 9, 12),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(7, 17, 21),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 24, 29),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(10, 31, 36),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 214),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(89, 143, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(236, 255, 252),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(136, 191, 184),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(28, 123, 111),
            corner = 9,
            transparency = 0.015,
        },
    }

    local styleNames = { "Obsidian", "Aurora", "Glass", "Crimson", "Neon" }
    local animationNames = {
        "Breathing",
        "Floating",
        "Pulse",
        "Aurora Sweep",
        "Shimmer",
        "Icon Drift",
        "Orbit Glow",
        "Scanline",
        "Parallax",
        "Cinematic",
    }
    local transitionNames = {
        "Fade Through",
        "Slide Left",
        "Slide Right",
        "Slide Up",
        "Slide Down",
        "Zoom In",
        "Zoom Out",
        "Flip",
        "Wipe",
        "Pulse Burst",
    }

    local function findIndex(list, value, fallback)
        local n = table.find(list, value)
        return n or fallback or 1
    end

    local styleIndex = findIndex(styleNames, __iuiConfig.style, 1)
    local animationIndex = findIndex(animationNames, __iuiConfig.animation, 1)
    local transitionIndex = findIndex(transitionNames, __iuiConfig.transition, 1)
    local transitionBlurEnabled = __iuiConfig.transitionBlur ~= false
    local animationIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(__iuiConfig.intensity) or 0.75, 0.25, 1.25)
    local uiEnabled = __iuiConfig.enabled ~= false

    local style = styles[styleNames[styleIndex]]

    local function saveState()
        saveImmersiveConfig({
            enabled = uiEnabled,
            style = styleNames[styleIndex],
            animation = animationNames[animationIndex],
            transition = transitionNames[transitionIndex],
            transitionBlur = transitionBlurEnabled,
            intensity = animationIntensity,
        })
    end

    local function findDescendant(name)
        if __iuiParent and __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
            return __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function capture(object, property)
        if not object then
            return
        end
        local values = __iui.original[object]
        if not values then
            values = {}
            __iui.original[object] = values
        end
        if values[property] ~= nil then
            return
        end
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return object[property]
        end)
        if ok then
            values[property] = value
        end
    end

    local function setTracked(object, property, value)
        if not object then
            return
        end
        capture(object, property)
        pcall(function()
            object[property] = value
        end)
    end

    local function ensureCorner(object, radius)
        if not isUiObject(object) then
            return nil
        end
        local corner = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUICorner")
        if not corner then
            corner = track(Instance.new("UICorner"))
            corner.Name = "LT_IUICorner"
            corner.Parent = object
        end
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
        return corner
    end

    local function ensureStroke(object, color, thickness)
        if not isUiObject(object) then
            return nil
        end
        local stroke = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
        if not stroke then
            stroke = track(Instance.new("UIStroke"))
            stroke.Name = "LT_IUIStroke"
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Parent = object
        end
        stroke.Color = color
        stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
        stroke.Transparency = 0.42
        return stroke
    end

    local function ensureGradient(object, c1, c2)
        if not isUiObject(object) then
            return nil
        end
        local gradient = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIGradient")
        if not gradient then
            gradient = track(Instance.new("UIGradient"))
            gradient.Name = "LT_IUIGradient"
            gradient.Parent = object
        end
        gradient.Rotation = 135
        gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, lerpColor(c1, c2, 0.45)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c2),
        })
        gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.16),
        })
        return gradient
    end

    local function isCodeObject(object)
        if not object then
            return false
        end
        local n = string.lower(object.Name or "")
        return n == "code"
            or n:find("editor", 1, true) ~= nil
            or n:find("syntax", 1, true) ~= nil
            or n:match("^script%d+%.lua$") ~= nil
    end

    local function shouldStyle(object)
        if not isUiObject(object) or isCodeObject(object) then
            return false
        end
        if object:GetAttribute("LT_NoImmersiveStyle") then
            return false
        end
        return object:IsA("Frame")
            or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
            or object:IsA("TextButton")
            or object:IsA("ImageButton")
            or object:IsA("TextLabel")
            or object:IsA("ImageLabel")
    end

    local function styleObject(object)
        if not shouldStyle(object) then
            return
        end
        __iui.styled[object] = true

        if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") then
            setTracked(object, "TextColor3", style.text)
            if object:IsA("TextButton") then
                setTracked(object, "AutoButtonColor", false)
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.button)
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", style.transparency + 0.01)
                ensureCorner(object, math.max(7, style.corner - 3))
                ensureStroke(object, style.stroke, 1)
            end
        elseif object:IsA("ImageButton") then
            setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.button)
            setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", style.transparency + 0.01)
            ensureCorner(object, math.max(7, style.corner - 3))
            ensureStroke(object, style.stroke, 1)
        elseif object:IsA("Frame") or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            local n = string.lower(object.Name or "")
            local isPanel = n == "sidebar"
                or n == "executor"
                or n == "scripthub"
                or n == "settings"
                or n == "home"
                or n == "console"
                or n == "music"
                or n:find("overlay", 1, true) ~= nil
                or n:find("panel", 1, true) ~= nil
                or n:find("card", 1, true) ~= nil
                or n:find("holder", 1, true) ~= nil
            if isPanel then
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.panel)
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", style.transparency)
                ensureCorner(object, style.corner)
                local stroke = ensureStroke(object, style.stroke, 1)
                if stroke then
                    stroke.Transparency = style == styles.Neon and 0.22 or 0.42
                end
                ensureGradient(object, style.panel, style.panel2)
            end
        end

        if object:IsA("ImageLabel") and object.Name ~= "Code" then
            pcall(function()
                object.ImageColor3 = lerpColor(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), style.accent, 0.18)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function collectStyleTargets()
        local targets = {}
        local importantNames = {
            Sidebar = true,
            Executor = true,
            Home = true,
            Scripthub = true,
            Settings = true,
            Console = true,
            Music = true,
        }
        for name in importantNames do
            local target = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if target then
                table.insert(targets, target)
                for _, descendant in target:GetDescendants() do
                    table.insert(targets, descendant)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, object in __iuiParent:GetDescendants() do
            if object.Name:sub(1, 4) == "LT_" then
                continue
            end
            if object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
                table.insert(targets, object)
            end
        end
        return targets
    end

    local function applyStyle()
        style = styles[styleNames[styleIndex]]
        for _, object in collectStyleTargets() do
            pcall(styleObject, object)
        end
        local rootStroke = ensureStroke(__iuiParent, style.stroke, 1)
        if rootStroke then
            rootStroke.Transparency = 0.86
        end
    end

    local function getAnimationTargets()
        local current = {}
        local sidebar = findDescendant("Sidebar")
        local executor = findDescendant("Executor")
        local currentPage
        for _, name in { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" } do
            local p = findDescendant(name)
            if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.Visible then
                currentPage = p
                break
            end
        end
        if sidebar then
            table.insert(current, sidebar)
        end
        if currentPage and currentPage ~= sidebar then
            table.insert(current, currentPage)
        elseif executor then
            table.insert(current, executor)
        end
        return current
    end

    local function ensureScale(target)
        if not isUiObject(target) then
            return nil
        end
        local scale = target:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIScale")
        if not scale then
            scale = track(Instance.new("UIScale"))
            scale.Name = "LT_IUIScale"
            scale.Scale = 1
            scale.Parent = target
        end
        return scale
    end

    local function getAnimatedStroke(target)
        return target and target:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
    end

    local function updateAnimation(dt)
        if not __iui.alive or not uiEnabled then
            return
        end
        __iui.animationTime += dt
        local t = __iui.animationTime * animationIntensity
        local targets = getAnimationTargets()
        local name = animationNames[animationIndex]

        for index, target in targets do
            if hasParent(target) then
                local scale = ensureScale(target)
                local stroke = getAnimatedStroke(target)
                local phase = t * (1 + index * 0.08)
                local s = 1
                local offsetY = 0
                local rotation = 0

                if name == "Breathing" then
                    s = 1 + math.sin(phase * 1.5) * 0.009
                elseif name == "Floating" then
                    offsetY = math.sin(phase * 1.2 + index) * 2.6
                elseif name == "Pulse" then
                    local wave = (math.sin(phase * 3.0) + 1) * 0.5
                    s = 1 + wave * 0.012
                    if stroke then
                        stroke.Thickness = 1 + wave * 1.3
                        stroke.Transparency = 0.58 - wave * 0.27
                    end
                elseif name == "Aurora Sweep" then
                    local gradients = {}
                    for _, d in target:GetDescendants() do
                        if d:IsA("UIGradient") and d.Name == "LT_IUIGradient" then
                            gradients[#gradients + 1] = d
                        end
                    end
                    for _, g in gradients do
                        g.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(phase * 0.55) * 0.3, 0)
                        g.Rotation = 125 + math.sin(phase * 0.3) * 12
                    end
                elseif name == "Shimmer" then
                    if stroke then
                        local q = (math.sin(phase * 2.1) + 1) * 0.5
                        stroke.Color = lerpColor(style.stroke, style.accent, q * 0.72)
                    end
                elseif name == "Icon Drift" then
                    for _, d in target:GetDescendants() do
                        if d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then
                            d.Rotation = math.sin(phase + d.AbsolutePosition.X * 0.003) * 1.7
                        end
                    end
                elseif name == "Orbit Glow" then
                    if stroke then
                        stroke.Rotation = math.sin(phase * 0.8) * 12
                        stroke.Thickness = 1.15 + ((math.sin(phase * 2) + 1) * 0.5) * 1.55
                    end
                elseif name == "Scanline" then
                    for _, d in target:GetDescendants() do
                        if d:IsA("UIGradient") and d.Name == "LT_IUIGradient" then
                            d.Offset = Vector2.new(0, math.sin(phase * 1.3) * 0.18)
                        end
                    end
                elseif name == "Parallax" then
                    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera then
                        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
                        local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                        local nx = viewport.X > 0 and (mouse.X / viewport.X - 0.5) or 0
                        local ny = viewport.Y > 0 and (mouse.Y / viewport.Y - 0.5) or 0
                        __iui.parallax = Vector2.new(nx, ny)
                        offsetY = ny * 2.6
                    end
                    rotation = __iui.parallax.X * (index == 1 and 1.2 or -1.0)
                elseif name == "Cinematic" then
                    local wave = (math.sin(phase * 0.8) + 1) * 0.5
                    s = 1 + wave * 0.006
                    offsetY = math.sin(phase * 0.7) * 1.35
                    rotation = math.sin(phase * 0.9) * 0.42
                    if stroke then
                        stroke.Transparency = 0.54 - wave * 0.18
                    end
                end

                if scale then
                    scale.Scale = s
                end

                local base = __iui.original[target]
                if base and base.Position then
                    local basePos = base.Position
                    target.Position = UDim2.new(
                        basePos.X.Scale,
                        basePos.X.Offset,
                        basePos.Y.Scale,
                        basePos.Y.Offset + offsetY
                    )
                end
                target.Rotation = ((base and base.Rotation) or 0) + rotation
            end
        end
    end

    local function getTransitionBlur()
        local lighting = Svc("Lighting") or game:GetService("Lighting")
        if not lighting then
            return nil
        end
        local blur = lighting:FindFirstChild("LT_DeltaTransitionBlur")
        if not blur then
            blur = track(Instance.new("BlurEffect"))
            blur.Name = "LT_DeltaTransitionBlur"
            blur.Size = 0
            blur.Enabled = false
            blur.Parent = lighting
        end
        return blur
    end

    local blurEffect = getTransitionBlur()

    local transitionOverlay = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
    transitionOverlay.Name = "LT_ImmersiveTransition"
    transitionOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = style.bg
    transitionOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
    transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
    transitionOverlay.Visible = false
    transitionOverlay.ZIndex = 30000
    transitionOverlay.Parent = __iuiParent
    ensureGradient(transitionOverlay, style.panel, style.accent2)

    local transitionGlow = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
    transitionGlow.Name = "Glow"
    transitionGlow.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
    transitionGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
    transitionGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    transitionGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 1.3)
    transitionGlow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.25, -0.15)
    transitionGlow.Rotation = 12
    transitionGlow.ZIndex = 30001
    transitionGlow.Parent = transitionOverlay
    ensureCorner(transitionGlow, 999)

    local function cancelTransition()
        __iui.transitionToken += 1
        __iui.transitionBusy = false
        pcall(function()
            transitionOverlay.Visible = false
        end)
        if blurEffect then
            pcall(function()
                blurEffect.Size = 0
                blurEffect.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
    end

    local function playTransition(kind)
        if not uiEnabled or not transitionOverlay or not hasParent(transitionOverlay) then
            return
        end
        cancelTransition()
        __iui.transitionBusy = true
        __iui.transitionToken += 1
        local token = __iui.transitionToken
        local name = kind or transitionNames[transitionIndex]
        local duration = 0.36
        transitionOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = style.bg
        transitionGlow.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
        transitionOverlay.Visible = true
        transitionGlow.Visible = true
        transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)

        if blurEffect and transitionBlurEnabled then
            pcall(function()
                blurEffect.Enabled = true
                blurEffect.Size = 6
            end)
        end

        local function makeTween(object, ti, props)
            if not TS then
                for k, v in props do
                    pcall(function()
                        object[k] = v
                    end)
                end
                return nil
            end
            local ok, tw = pcall(function()
                return TS:Create(object, ti, props)
            end)
            if ok and tw then
                tw:Play()
                return tw
            end
            return nil
        end

        transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
        transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        transitionOverlay.Rotation = 0
        transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        transitionGlow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.25, -0.15)
        transitionGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 1.3)

        local easeOut = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local easeIn = TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.82, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

        if name == "Fade Through" then
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 })
            task.delay(duration * 0.46, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Left" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 0)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(-1.08, 0) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Right" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-1.08, 0)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 0) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Up" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1.08)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -1.08) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Down" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -1.08)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1.08) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Zoom In" then
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.68)
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 1.05),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
            })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
            end)
        elseif name == "Zoom Out" then
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2)
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
            })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, 0.74),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
            end)
        elseif name == "Flip" then
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Rotation = 0
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Rotation = 180, BackgroundTransparency = 0.18 })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Rotation = 360, BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            end)
        elseif name == "Wipe" then
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-1.08, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 1.24)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.5, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 0.5) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Pulse Burst" then
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.04)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.35, 1.35),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
            })
            task.delay(duration * 0.48, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 1.5),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
            end)
        end

        task.delay(duration + 0.12, function()
            if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then
                return
            end
            __iui.transitionBusy = false
            transitionOverlay.Visible = false
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            if blurEffect then
                pcall(function()
                    blurEffect.Size = 0
                    blurEffect.Enabled = false
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function currentVisiblePage()
        for _, name in { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" } do
            local p = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.Visible then
                return p
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function watchPages()
        local pageNames = { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" }
        for _, name in pageNames do
            local page = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if page and page:IsA("GuiObject") then
                local c = connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
                    if not __iui.alive or not uiEnabled then
                        return
                    end
                    task.defer(function()
                        local visible = currentVisiblePage()
                        if visible and visible ~= __iui.currentPage then
                            __iui.currentPage = visible
                            playTransition()
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                if c then
                    table.insert(__iui.pageConnections, c)
                end
            end
        end
        __iui.currentPage = currentVisiblePage()
    end

    local function bindStyleHover(button)
        if not (button and button:IsA("GuiButton")) then
            return
        end
        if button:GetAttribute("LT_IUIHoverBound") then
            return
        end
        button:SetAttribute("LT_IUIHoverBound", true)
        local stroke = ensureStroke(button, style.stroke, 1)
        local baseColor = button.BackgroundColor3
        connect(button.MouseEnter, function()
            if not hasParent(button) or not uiEnabled then return end
            local hover = lerpColor(baseColor, style.accent, 0.28)
            pcall(function() button.BackgroundColor3 = hover end)
            if stroke then stroke.Transparency = 0.12 end
        end)
        connect(button.MouseLeave, function()
            if not hasParent(button) then return end
            pcall(function() button.BackgroundColor3 = baseColor end)
            if stroke then stroke.Transparency = 0.42 end
        end)
    end

    local function buildControlPanel()
        local old = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild("LT_ImmersiveCustomizer")
        if old then
            old:Destroy()
        end

        local panel = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
        panel.Name = "LT_ImmersiveCustomizer"
        panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
        panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -18)
        panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 0)
        panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        panel.BackgroundColor3 = style.panel
        panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(style.transparency + 0.02, 0.32)
        panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        panel.ZIndex = 25000
        panel.Parent = __iuiParent
        ensureCorner(panel, style.corner + 2)
        ensureStroke(panel, style.stroke, 1)
        ensureGradient(panel, style.panel, style.panel2)
        uiLib.draggerV2(panel, panel)

        local padding = track(Instance.new("UIPadding"))
        padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
        padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
        padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 13)
        padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 13)
        padding.Parent = panel

        local list = track(Instance.new("UIListLayout"))
        list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
        list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        list.Parent = panel

        local title = track(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
        title.Name = "Title"
        title.LayoutOrder = 1
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.Text = "IMMERSIVE UI"
        title.TextColor3 = style.text
        title.TextSize = 15
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.ZIndex = 25001
        title.Parent = panel

        local subtitle = track(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
        subtitle.LayoutOrder = 2
        subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
        subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        subtitle.Text = "Depth, motion and transition controls"
        subtitle.TextColor3 = style.muted
        subtitle.TextSize = 10
        subtitle.TextWrapped = true
        subtitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        subtitle.ZIndex = 25001
        subtitle.Parent = panel

        local function makeButton(name, text, order, callback)
            local b = track(Instance.new("TextButton"))
            b.Name = name
            b.LayoutOrder = order
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = style.button
            b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
            b.Text = text
            b.TextColor3 = style.text
            b.TextSize = 11
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.ZIndex = 25002
            b.Parent = panel
            ensureCorner(b, math.max(7, style.corner - 4))
            ensureStroke(b, style.stroke, 1)
            bindStyleHover(b)
            connect(b.Activated, callback)
            return b
        end

        local styleButton = makeButton("Style", "STYLE: " .. styleNames[styleIndex], 3, function()
            styleIndex = (styleIndex % #styleNames) + 1
            applyStyle()
            title.TextColor3 = style.text
            subtitle.TextColor3 = style.muted
            styleButton.Text = "STYLE: " .. styleNames[styleIndex]
            animationButton.BackgroundColor3 = style.button
            transitionButton.BackgroundColor3 = style.button
            blurButton.BackgroundColor3 = transitionBlurEnabled and style.accent or style.button
            saveState()
        end)

        local animationButton = makeButton("Animation", "ANIMATION: " .. animationNames[animationIndex], 4, function()
            animationIndex = (animationIndex % #animationNames) + 1
            animationButton.Text = "ANIMATION: " .. animationNames[animationIndex]
            __iui.animationTime = 0
            saveState()
        end)

        local transitionButton = makeButton("Transition", "TRANSITION: " .. transitionNames[transitionIndex], 5, function()
            transitionIndex = (transitionIndex % #transitionNames) + 1
            transitionButton.Text = "TRANSITION: " .. transitionNames[transitionIndex]
            saveState()
            playTransition()
        end)

        local blurButton = makeButton("Blur", "TRANSITION BLUR: " .. (transitionBlurEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"), 6, function()
            transitionBlurEnabled = not transitionBlurEnabled
            blurButton.Text = "TRANSITION BLUR: " .. (transitionBlurEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
            blurButton.BackgroundColor3 = transitionBlurEnabled and style.accent or style.button
            saveState()
        end)
        blurButton.BackgroundColor3 = transitionBlurEnabled and style.accent or style.button

        local intensityButton = makeButton("Intensity", string.format("ANIMATION INTENSITY: %d%%", math.floor(animationIntensity * 100 + 0.5)), 7, function()
            local values = { 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.15, 1.25 }
            local idx = 1
            for i, v in values do
                if math.abs(v - animationIntensity) < 0.02 then
                    idx = i
                    break
                end
            end
            idx = (idx % #values) + 1
            animationIntensity = values[idx]
            intensityButton.Text = string.format("ANIMATION INTENSITY: %d%%", math.floor(animationIntensity * 100 + 0.5))
            saveState()
        end)

        local preview = makeButton("Preview", "PREVIEW TRANSITION", 8, function()
            playTransition()
        end)

        local toggle = makeButton("Toggle", "IMMERSION: " .. (uiEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"), 9, function()
            uiEnabled = not uiEnabled
            toggle.Text = "IMMERSION: " .. (uiEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
            if not uiEnabled then
                cancelTransition()
            end
            saveState()
        end)
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = uiEnabled and style.accent or style.button

        local hint = track(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
        hint.Name = "Hint"
        hint.LayoutOrder = 10
        hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
        hint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        hint.Text = "Tap the controls to cycle presets."
        hint.TextColor3 = style.muted
        hint.TextSize = 9
        hint.TextWrapped = true
        hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        hint.ZIndex = 25001
        hint.Parent = panel

        __iui.controlPanel = panel
        return panel
    end

    local function patchStyleOnNewObjects()
        connect(__iuiParent.DescendantAdded, function(object)
            if not __iui.alive then
                return
            end
            if object.Name:sub(1, 4) == "LT_" then
                return
            end
            task.defer(function()
                if hasParent(object) then
                    styleObject(object)
                    if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
                        bindStyleHover(object)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function addCleanupHook()
        local oldStop = __dcm_masterRuntime.stop
        if type(oldStop) == "function" and not __dcm_masterRuntime.__iuiWrapped then
            __dcm_masterRuntime.__iuiWrapped = true
            __dcm_masterRuntime.stop = function(...)
                if __iui.alive then
                    pcall(function()
                        __iui.stop()
                    end)
                end
                return oldStop(...)
            end
        end
    end

    __iui.stop = function()
        if not __iui.alive then
            return
        end
        __iui.alive = false
        cancelTransition()
        for _, c in __iui.connections do
            disconnect(c)
        end
        for _, c in __iui.pageConnections do
            disconnect(c)
        end
        table.clear(__iui.connections)
        table.clear(__iui.pageConnections)
        if blurEffect and blurEffect.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                blurEffect.Size = 0
                blurEffect.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
        for object in __iui.objects do
            if object and object.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    if object.Name:sub(1, 4) == "LT_" then
                        object:Destroy()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        for object, values in __iui.original do
            if object and object.Parent then
                for property, value in values do
                    pcall(function()
                        object[property] = value
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        __dcm_env.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = nil
        __dcm_shared.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = nil
    end

    __iui.applyStyle = applyStyle
    __iui.playTransition = playTransition
    __iui.styles = styleNames
    __iui.animations = animationNames
    __iui.transitions = transitionNames

    applyStyle()
    if uiEnabled then
        buildControlPanel()
        watchPages()
        patchStyleOnNewObjects()
        for _, object in __iuiParent:GetDescendants() do
            if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
                bindStyleHover(object)
            end
        end
        connect(RS and RS.RenderStepped or nil, updateAnimation)
    end
    addCleanupHook()
    saveState()
end

local StylizedObjs = {}
local function Stylize(obj, options)
	options = options or {}
	local Cor = Util.Instance("UICorner", obj)
	Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Util.FX.Cfg.UIRound)
	local Out = Util.Instance("UIStroke", obj)
	Out.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	Out.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Out.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
	Out.Thickness = Util.FX.Cfg.UIBorder
	Out.Transparency = 0
	Out.Enabled = true
	obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local Glos = {}
	if options.Glow == true then
		local GloF = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainFrame)
		Util.LinkDestroyI2I(obj, GloF)
		GloF.Interactable = false
		GloF.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local function update()
			GloF.AnchorPoint = obj.AnchorPoint
			GloF.Position = obj.Position - Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset((obj.AnchorPoint * 2 - Vector2.one) * 5)
			GloF.Size = obj.Size - UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
			GloF.Visible = obj.Visible
			GloF.ZIndex = obj.ZIndex - 2
		end
		update()
		obj.Changed:Connect(update)
		local tex = Util.GetCDNAsset("lightinursoul.graphic.png")
		for x=0, 2 do
			for y=0, 2 do
				local Glo = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", GloF)
				Glo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1 - math.min(x, 1), 1 - math.min(y, 1))
				Glo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(x - 1, 0), math.max(y - 1, 0))
				Glo.Size = UDim2.new(1 - math.abs(x - 1), x == 1 and 0 or 32, 1 - math.abs(y - 1), y == 1 and 0 or 32)
				Glo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				Glo.Image = tex
				Glo.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(math.min(x, 1) * 256, math.min(y, 1) * 256)
				Glo.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(x == 1 and 0 or 256, y == 1 and 0 or 256)
				table.insert(Glos, Glo)
			end
		end
	end
	table.insert(StylizedObjs, {
		obj = obj,
		Cor = Cor,
		Out = Out,
		Glos = Glos,
		options = options,
	})
end
local ForceUIColor = nil
local ForceUIBGColor = nil
local function GetUIColor(t)
	if ForceUIColor then
		local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
		local h, s, v = ForceUIColor:ToHSV()
		if s < 0.2 then
			v *= 0.8 + si * 0.2
		else
			h += si * 0.01
		end
		return Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
	end
	return Util.DiscoColor(t / 2) -- [v48] default theme cycles the disco palette (was the full rainbow)
end
local function GetUIBGColor(t)
	if ForceUIBGColor then
		local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
		local h, s, v = ForceUIBGColor:ToHSV()
		if s < 0.2 then
			if v > 0.5 then
				v *= 0.95 + si * 0.05
			else
				v *= 1.05 + si * 0.05
			end
		else
			h += si * 0.01
		end
		return Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
	end
	return Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
local UITextColor = Util.Instance("Color3Value")
UITextColor.Value = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
if Util.UhAdmin then Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme = function(t) return GetUIColor(t), GetUIBGColor(t), UITextColor.Value end end
local function RegisterTextLabel(obj)
	if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
		obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
			obj.TextColor3 = val
		end))
	end
	if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
		local h, s, v = UITextColor.Value:ToHSV()
		obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
		obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
			h, s, v = val:ToHSV()
			obj.TextColor3 = val
			obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
		end))
	end
end
local function UpdateGrads(t)
	local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
	local c = Util.Color.Resolve(t, GetUIColor(t)) -- [v24] dynamic colour system (modes, harmony, picker)
	local bgc = GetUIBGColor(t)
	local h, s, v = bgc:ToHSV()
	local bgcd = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v * 0.9)
	local h2, s2, v2 = c:ToHSV()
	local glc = c
	if v > v2 then
		glc = bgc
	end
	for _,grad in StylizedObjs do
		local obj, Out, Glos, options = grad.obj, grad.Out, grad.Glos, grad.options
		Out.Color = c
		if grad.thick ~= CFG.UIBorder then
			grad.thick = CFG.UIBorder
			Out.Thickness = CFG.UIBorder
		end
		if grad.Cor and grad.round ~= CFG.UIRound then
			grad.round = CFG.UIRound
			grad.Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, CFG.UIRound)
		end
		if options.BgTr and grad.btr ~= CFG.UIBgTr then
			grad.btr = CFG.UIBgTr
			obj.BackgroundTransparency = CFG.UIBgTr
		end
		if options.Depthed then
			obj.BackgroundColor3 = bgcd
		else
			obj.BackgroundColor3 = bgc
		end
		for _,v in Glos do
			v.ImageColor3 = glc
			v.Visible = CFG.UIGlow
		end
	end
end

		local tick12 = part(face, 2, 2, 0.5, 0, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 1))
		local txtParts = {
			part(face, 2, 2, 1, 0.5, UDim2.new(1, -1, 0.5, 0)),
			part(face, 2, 2, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1)),
			part(face, 2, 2, 0, 0.5, UDim2.new(0, 1, 0.5, 0)),
		}
		local hP, hB = hand(4, 2)
		local mP, mB = hand(6, 2)
		local sP, sB = hand(8, 1)
		table.insert(txtParts, hB)
		table.insert(txtParts, mB)
		local hub = part(face, 4, 4, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), true)
		local accParts = {tick12, sB, hub}
		local function label(y)
			local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", info)
			l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(FACE + 4, y)
			l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TXT, 11)
			l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
			l.TextSize = 10
			l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			RegisterTextLabel(l)
			return l
		end
		local dateL, memL = label(0), label(11)
		memL.TextTransparency = 0.2
		TopBarText.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		local TITLE_W = UDim2.new(1, -(44 + INFO_W), 1, 0)
		local function layout() -- the minimised pill (112 wide) keeps its original look: extras hidden, title gets its full width back
			local pill = UIMainWindow.Size.X.Offset < 250
			info.Visible = not pill
			TopBarText.Size = pill and UDim2.new(1, -35, 1, 0) or TITLE_W
		end
		layout()
		UIMainWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(layout)
		local lastDay, n = -1, 0
		local function update()
			local t = DateTime.now():ToLocalTime()
			local tc, ac = UITextColor.Value, stroke and stroke.Color or UITextColor.Value
			sP.Rotation = t.Second * 6
			mP.Rotation = t.Minute * 6 + t.Second * 0.1
			hP.Rotation = (t.Hour % 12) * 30 + t.Minute * 0.5
			rim.Color = ac
			for _, f in ipairs(txtParts) do f.BackgroundColor3 = tc end
			for _, f in ipairs(accParts) do f.BackgroundColor3 = ac end
			if t.Day ~= lastDay then
				lastDay = t.Day
				local ok, s = pcall(function() return DateTime.now():FormatLocalTime("ddd MMM D", "en-us") end)
				dateL.Text = ok and s or os.date("%a %b %d")
			end
			n += 1
			if n % 2 == 1 then
				local ok, mb = pcall(Stats.GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, Stats)
				if ok then memL.Text = string.format("MEM %.0fMB", mb) end
			end
		end
		update()
		while info.Parent do
			task.wait(1.02 - (DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis % 1000) / 1000)
			if Util.IsGuiVisible(info) then update() end
		end
	end)
	
	WindowContent = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainWindow)
	WindowContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
	WindowContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -35)
	WindowContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	WindowContent.ClipsDescendants = true
	WindowContent.ZIndex = 0
	
	local MainWindowClosed = false
	local MainWindowTweening = false
	local MainWindowPosOpen = nil
	local MainWindowPosClose = nil
	if SaveData.WindowClosedPosition then
		MainWindowPosClose = UDim2.new(unpack(SaveData.WindowClosedPosition))
	end
	if MainWindowPosClose and (MainWindowPosClose.X.Scale < 0 or MainWindowPosClose.X.Scale > 1) then
		MainWindowPosClose = nil
	end
	if MainWindowPosClose and (MainWindowPosClose.Y.Scale < 0 or MainWindowPosClose.Y.Scale > 1) then
		MainWindowPosClose = nil
	end
	TopBarClose.Activated:Connect(function()
		if MainWindowTweening then return end
		MainWindowTweening = true
		MainWindowClosed = not MainWindowClosed
		if MainWindowClosed then
			MainWindowPosOpen = UIMainWindow.Position
			local okF, foldT = pcall(Util.FX.WindowFold, UIMainWindow, WindowContent, true, MainWindowPosClose, UDim2.fromOffset(360, 240)) -- [v41]
			if not okF then foldT = nil end
			if not foldT then
				TweenService:Create(UIMainWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					Position = MainWindowPosClose,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 30)
				}):Play()
			end
			TweenService:Create(TopBarClose.A, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Rotation = 180
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(TopBarClose.A.B, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 16)
			}):Play()
			task.delay(foldT or 0.6, function()
				if foldT then UIMainWindow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 30) end -- [v41] failsafe: land exactly on the pill
				WindowContent.Visible = false
				MainWindowTweening = false
			end)
		else
			WindowContent.Visible = true
			MainWindowPosClose = UIMainWindow.Position
			SaveData.WindowClosedPosition = {MainWindowPosClose.X.Scale, MainWindowPosClose.X.Offset, MainWindowPosClose.Y.Scale, MainWindowPosClose.Y.Offset}
			local okF, foldT = pcall(Util.FX.WindowFold, UIMainWindow, WindowContent, false, MainWindowPosOpen, UDim2.fromOffset(360, 240)) -- [v41]
			if not okF then foldT = nil end
			if not foldT then
				TweenService:Create(UIMainWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					Position = MainWindowPosOpen,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 240)
				}):Play()
			end
			TweenService:Create(TopBarClose.A, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Rotation = 0
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(TopBarClose.A.B, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
			}):Play()
			task.delay(foldT or 0.6, function()
				if foldT then UIMainWindow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 240) end -- [v41] failsafe: land exactly on full size
				MainWindowTweening = false
			end)
		end
		WindowContent.Active = not MainWindowClosed
		WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
	end)
	
	local dragref = nil
	local offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	TopBarFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if dragref then return end
		if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			WindowContent.Interactable = false
			local screen = Util.GetScreenSize()
			local ch = (Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) + SCREENGUI.AbsolutePosition) / screen
			offset = Util.UDim2ToVector2Scale(UIMainWindow.Position) - ch
			dragref = input
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragref then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and dragref == input) then
				local screen = Util.GetScreenSize()
				local ch = (Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) + SCREENGUI.AbsolutePosition) / screen
				local pos = ch + offset
				local dowsize = Util.UDim2ToVector2Offset(UIMainWindow.Size)
				local imjollx = (dowsize.X * 0.5 - 100) / screen.X
				local imjolly = dowsize.Y * -0.5 / screen.Y
				local boxy = 31 / screen.Y
				pos = Vector2.new(
					math.clamp(pos.X, -imjollx, 1 + imjollx),
					math.clamp(pos.Y, -imjolly, 1 - imjolly - boxy)
				)
				UIMainWindow.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Scale(pos)
			end
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local same = dragref and (dragref == input or (dragref.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1))
		if same then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
				dragref = nil
			end
		end
	end)
	-- if focus is lost mid-drag the content must not stay Interactable=false (that froze every button)
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		if dragref then
			dragref = nil
			WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
		end
	end)
end

local _funcrefreshes = {}
local function AddToRenderStep(func, linkto)
	table.insert(_funcrefreshes, func)
	if linkto then
		linkto.Destroying:Connect(function()
			local i = table.find(_funcrefreshes, func)
			if i then
				table.remove(_funcrefreshes, i)
			end
		end)
	end
	return func
end
local _totalrendertime = 0
local _lowAcc = 0
RunService:BindToRenderStep("Uhhhhhh_Render" .. Util.RandomString(), Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value - 69, function(dt)
	_totalrendertime += dt
	-- [v34] LOW END UI MODE: the theme colours and every UI hook (AddToRenderStep) update at a capped rate
	-- (Util.FX.LowEndUIFPS, default 30) instead of on every rendered frame.
	if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then
		_lowAcc += dt
		if _lowAcc < 1 / Util.FX.LowEndUIFPS then
			WindowContent.Visible = UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset > 35
			return
		end
		dt, _lowAcc = _lowAcc, 0
	else
		_lowAcc = 0
	end
	UpdateGrads(_totalrendertime)
	WindowContent.Visible = UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset > 35
	for _,func in _funcrefreshes do
		local s, e = pcall(func, _totalrendertime, dt)
		if not s then warn(e) end
	end
end)
-- [v54] INSTANT THEME: SetUITheme calls this the moment a theme is picked, so every themed surface (Stylize()d frames,
-- text, widget hooks, dropdown lists) repaints in the same frame instead of on the next render step, then a soft pulse plays.
Util.ThemeApplied = function()
	local t = _totalrendertime
	pcall(UpdateGrads, t)
	for _, func in _funcrefreshes do
		pcall(func, t, 1 / 60)
	end
	if Util.FX and Util.FX.ThemePulse then pcall(Util.FX.ThemePulse) end
end

			end
			return
		end
		uinotif.Text, uinotif.Progress = text, prog or 1
		uinotif.LastNotif = _totalrendertime
		if CFG.NotifSound and (prog == nil or prog >= 1) then

	AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
		local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
		if CFG.NotifMode >= 3 then
			UINotifyFrame.Visible = false
			return
		end
		if t - uinotif.LastNotif < CFG.NotifDuration or uinotif.Progress < 1 then
			uinotif.Animation = math.max(0, uinotif.Animation - dt * 2 * CFG.NotifSpeed)
		else
			uinotif.Animation = math.min(1, uinotif.Animation + dt * 2 * CFG.NotifSpeed)
		end
		if uinotif.Animation < 1 then
			UINotifyFrame.Visible = true
			local nh = math.max(30, CFG.NotifSize + 12)
			UINotifyFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, CFG.NotifWidth, 0, nh)
			NotifyText.TextSize = CFG.NotifSize
			NotifyText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, nh)
			local slide = math.pow(uinotif.Animation, 3)
			local pos = CFG.NotifPos
			if pos == 2 then -- above the window
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UIMainWindow.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset / 2 - 10 - nh + slide * (nh + 10))
			elseif pos == 3 then -- top of the screen
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10 - slide * (nh + 20))
			elseif pos == 4 then -- bottom of the screen
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -(nh + 10) + slide * (nh + 20))
			else -- below the window (default)
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UIMainWindow.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset / 2 + 10 + slide * -(nh + 10))
			end
			if uinotif.Progress >= 1 then
				Progress.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(t - uinotif.LastNotif, 0.5) * 2 * 0.3 + 0.7
			else
				Progress.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			local c = GetUIColor(t)
			if CFG.NotifColor ~= "" then
				c = Util.ParseHex(CFG.NotifColor) or c
			end
			local s = math.sin(t * 3) * 0.5 + 0.5
			if uinotif.Progress > 0 then
				uinotif.ProgressSm = uinotif.Progress + (uinotif.ProgressSm - uinotif.Progress) * math.exp(-16 * dt)
				ProgressTop.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				ProgressBot.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				ProgressTop.Size = UDim2.new(uinotif.ProgressSm, 0, 0, 4)
				ProgressBot.Size = UDim2.new(uinotif.ProgressSm, 0, 0, 4)
			else
				uinotif.ProgressSm = 1
				ProgressTop.BackgroundTransparency = s
				ProgressBot.BackgroundTransparency = s
				ProgressTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
				ProgressBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
			end
			ProgressTop.BackgroundColor3 = c
			ProgressBot.BackgroundColor3 = c
			if not CFG.NotifProgress then
				Progress.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				ProgressTop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				ProgressBot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			NotifyText.Text = uinotif.Text
			NotifyText.TextTransparency = math.clamp(slide * 1.5, 0, 1) -- [v54] text fades with the slide
		else
			UINotifyFrame.Visible = false
		end
	end, UINotifyFrame)
end

	local PositionProcessor = {
		function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
			local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
			local d = pos.Magnitude
			if d > 0 then
				local r = math.atan2(pos.X / d, pos.Y / d)
				local a = math.pi * 0.375
				local out = Vector2.new(math.sin(r + a), math.cos(r + a))

				vel = tv:Lerp(vel, math.exp(-2 * dt))
				if math.random() < 0.01 then
					vel += Vector2.new(math.random(-64, 64), math.random(-64, 64))
				end
				if spike > 64 then
					vel += out * 64 * math.random()
				end
				pos += vel * dt
			else
				pos += Vector2.new(0, 10)
			end
			v[2], v[3] = pos, vel
			return Vector3.new(zind * pos.Magnitude / 6, pos.Y, pos.X)
		end,
		function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
			local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
			local a = i / ps
			local s = (a * 6) % 1
			local r = (a + s / 8) * 2 * math.pi + os.clock() * 2 + zind * math.pi * 0.125 * (pbl / 200) * (1 - s)
			pos = Vector2.new(math.sin(r), math.cos(r)) * s * (100 + pbl / 15)
			v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
			return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
		end,
		function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
			local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
			local a = i / ps
			local b = 1 / 3
			local c = math.sqrt(3) / 2
			local d = {
				{Vector2.new(0, b + c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(-1, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(-1, b - c), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(1, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(1, b - c), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b + c)},
			}
			local t = a * #d
			local i = math.floor(t) + 1
			local u = t % 1
			if i > #d then
				i = #d
				u = 1
			end
			pos = d[i][1]:Lerp(d[i][2], u) * 150
			local r = os.clock() * 2
			pos = Vector2.new(
				pos.X * math.cos(r) - pos.Y * math.sin(r),
				pos.X * math.sin(r) + pos.Y * math.cos(r)
			)
			v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
			return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
		end,
	}
	local currentprocessor = 1
	local lastLowScene = false -- [v34] low end: the 128 orbiting particles of the cool scene are not simulated
	local NOPARTICLES = {}

	AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
		if Util.IsGuiVisible(CracktroFrame) then
			local pp = PositionProcessor[currentprocessor]
			local CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize = CracktroFrame.AbsoluteSize
			Glowy.ImageColor3 = UITextColor.Value
			Glowy.ImageTransparency = 0.75 + math.sin(((os.clock() / 10) % 2) * math.pi) * 0.05
			local pbl = UISound.Music.PlaybackLoudness
			local spike = math.max(0, (pbl - oldpbl) - 16)
			oldpbl = pbl
			local trivelt = pbl * 2 * dt
			trivel = trivelt + (trivel - trivelt) * math.exp(-8 * dt)
			Triforce.Rotation = (Triforce.Rotation + trivel) % 360
			local ring = CFrame.Angles(
				0,
				math.cos(((t / 5) % 2) * math.pi) * math.pi * 0.5,
				(1 - math.cos(((t / 7) % 2) * math.pi)) * math.pi * 0.5
			)
			local fov = 220
			local lowScene = Util.FX.IsLowEnd()
			if lowScene ~= lastLowScene then
				lastLowScene = lowScene
				if lowScene then
					for _, pv in particles do
						pv[1].Visible = false
						pv[5] = false
					end
				end
			end
			for i,v in (lowScene and NOPARTICLES or particles) do
				local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
				local sp = ring:VectorToWorldSpace(pp(i, v, dt, pbl, spike))
				local z = sp.Z
				local sc = fov / (z + fov)
				sp = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) * sc
				local nvis, nzind = lvis, lzind
				if z > 1 - fov then
					inst.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset(sp + CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize / 2)
					inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sc * 2.5, sc * 2.5)
					--inst.BackgroundColor3 = psc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), math.clamp(z / (fov * 2), 0, 1))
					nvis = true
					if z > 0 then
						nzind = -1
					else
						nzind = 1
					end
				else
					nvis = false
				end
				if lvis ~= nvis then
					inst.Visible = nvis
					v[5] = nvis
				end
				if lzind ~= nzind then
					inst.ZIndex = nzind
					v[6] = nzind
				end
			end
			local textsel = t % 9
			if IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded then
				textsel = t % 12
			end
			textsel //= 3
			if text3mustchange ~= (textsel == 3) then
				text3mustchange = (textsel == 3)
				if text3mustchange then changequote() end
			end
			if textsel == 0 then
				text0.Visible = true
				text1.Visible = false
				text2.Visible = false
				text3.Visible = false
			elseif textsel == 1 then
				text0.Visible = false
				text1.Visible = true
				text2.Visible = false
				text3.Visible = false
			elseif textsel == 2 then
				text0.Visible = false
				text1.Visible = false
				text2.Visible = false
				text3.Visible = true
			else
				text0.Visible = false
				text1.Visible = false
				text2.Visible = true
				text3.Visible = false
			end
		else
			currentprocessor = math.random(1, #PositionProcessor)
		end
	end, CracktroFrame)
end
task.wait()

local UI = {}
function UI.CreatePage()
	local Frame = Util.Instance("ScrollingFrame", WindowContent)
	Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 205)
	Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	Frame.BorderSizePixel = 1
	Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Frame.Visible = true
	Frame.ZIndex = 0
	Frame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	Frame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	Frame.ClipsDescendants = true
	AddToRenderStep(function(t)
		Frame.BorderColor3 = GetUIColor(t)
		Frame.BackgroundColor3 = GetUIBGColor(t)
		Frame.BackgroundTransparency = Util.FX.Cfg.UIBgTr
	end, Frame)
	Frame.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	Frame.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	Frame.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Always
	Frame.TopImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png"
	Frame.MidImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png"
	Frame.BottomImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png"
	Frame.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5
	Frame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = UITextColor.Value
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Frame, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		Frame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = val
	end))
	local Padding = Util.Instance("UIPadding", Frame)
	Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0)
	Padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 0)
	Padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 0)
	local UIList = Util.Instance("UIListLayout", Frame)
	UIList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	UIList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	UIList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
	UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
	UIList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	return Frame
end
function UI.CreateText(parent, text, size, alignment)
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65536)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
	Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
	Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 1, -margin + 1)
	Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Text.RichText = true
	Text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	Text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Text.TextTransparency = 0
	Text.TextXAlignment = alignment
	Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	Text.TextWrapped = true
	Text.TextSize = size
	RegisterTextLabel(Text)
	local function update()
		local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
		local size = TextService:GetTextSize(Text.ContentText, Text.TextSize, Text.Font, Vector2.new(x - margin * 2, math.huge))
		Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size.Y + margin)
	end
	Text.Text = text
	update()
	Text.Changed:Connect(update)
	return Text
end
